intro.heading: Start with the annual figure, not the hourly rate
paragraphs: Families comparing chemistry tutors almost always compare hourly rates, which is the least informative number available. The figure that decides whether a plan is sensible is the annual one. A weekly hour with a qualified online tutor across a thirty-week school year lands at roughly AED 4,500 to 9,000 using the published Dubai bands. Specialist exam-year support at a weekly hour runs roughly AED 7,500 to 15,000 or more. A bounded ten-week block of two sessions a week comes in nearer AED 3,000 to 6,000 in total.

Chemistry deserves this framing more than any other Diploma science, because it is the subject where hours multiply quietly. A student who cannot explain a periodic trend needs weeks, not sessions. A student who has memorised equations and cannot account for why a reaction is spontaneous is a two-month job. Organic mechanisms, once they have gone wrong, absorb more tutoring time than any other single area of the Diploma sciences in our experience of this catchment. A family budgeting for six sessions of chemistry on the basis of the hourly rate is usually budgeting for the wrong engagement.

The good news is the other half of the arithmetic. Several parts of the chemistry course are genuinely cheap to fix, and they are worth a surprising number of marks. The data-based section inside Paper 1 rewards uncertainty handling and graph interpretation, which are independent of content confidence. Command-term discipline costs marks that cost almost nothing to recover. And the investigation, at 20% of the grade and marked out of 24 across four criteria, is almost entirely within the student's control for the months it is live.

So the structure of a sensible chemistry budget in this catchment is usually: a small amount spent early on the investigation question and on technique, both of which transfer across two years, and then a bounded block on the specific content area that is genuinely broken, bought only after a marked script has identified it. The expensive pattern is the reverse: an open-ended weekly slot bought in the second year, with no stated target, renewed monthly out of anxiety.

On delivery, plainly: IB Gram does not send tutors to homes in the UAE. Home visiting is a service we run only in India, and the published Dubai market rate for in-home visits is roughly AED 180 to 500 an hour with travel included if that is what you are comparing against. Part of what that premium pays for is a drive into Muhaisnah through the afternoon peak. Our lessons are live one-to-one over video, which means the money buys teaching rather than travel, and a Higher Level chemistry specialist rather than whoever lives nearby.

A last framing note. Nothing on this page is a price list for our own service, and no figure here is a promise about a grade. The papers are marked externally, the investigation is marked by the school and moderated by the IB, and what a tutor genuinely controls is how many marks are lost for reasons unconnected to chemistry. That number is what a budget should be aimed at, and in this subject it is usually larger than families assume.

dubai/ib-chemistry-tutor-in-muhaisnah.programmesIntro: Chemistry spend behaves differently at each stage, and the cheapest effective intervention is almost always earlier than families expect.

programmes.name: Diploma chemistry
programmes.description: Two years across six content strands, Structure 1 to 3 and Reactivity 1 to 3, with additional higher-level material inside each. Examined across two written papers plus a scientific investigation worth 20%. Paper 1 contains a multiple-choice section and a data-based section; Paper 2 is extended response.
programmes.countryNote: Chemistry is the second most requested Diploma science from this catchment after mathematics-adjacent subjects, and most enquiries are Higher Level students in the first year who have hit energetics or organic chemistry. Starting there rather than in the second year is both cheaper and more effective.

programmes.name: Middle Years sciences
programmes.description: Integrated sciences assessed against four criteria out of 8 each, with inquiry and design and processing and evaluating building the investigative skills the Diploma later assesses formally. Rates at this stage sit at the lower end of every published band because the specialism required is less.
programmes.countryNote: The cheapest useful chemistry intervention available to a Muhaisnah family is quantitative work at this stage: moles, proportional reasoning and balancing. Students from Mirdif and Festival City continuum schools often arrive in Diploma chemistry strong on method and weak on arithmetic.

programmes.name: IGCSE chemistry as the route in
programmes.description: Cambridge 0620 or Pearson 4CH1, tiered, with practical skills assessed by a practical test or an alternative-to-practical written paper. Moles and electrolysis are the two areas where IGCSE performance predicts Diploma difficulty most reliably.
programmes.countryNote: A student who found moles uncomfortable at IGCSE will find Diploma chemistry expensive, because mole reasoning underpins stoichiometry, energetics and equilibrium. Fixing it in the summer before the Diploma starts costs a fraction of fixing it in the second year, and almost nobody does.

programmes.name: A Level chemistry, for comparison
programmes.description: The alternative offered by several eastern Dubai schools, with more depth in fewer subjects and practical skills assessed differently by board. Universities quote offers in either currency and neither route is universally preferred for chemistry-dependent courses.
programmes.countryNote: Families sometimes ask whether A Level chemistry would be cheaper to support. It is not systematically cheaper; it is a different shape. Switching mid-course also forfeits investigation work already completed, so it is a conversation for the school rather than for a tutor.

dubai/ib-chemistry-tutor-in-muhaisnah.subjectsIntro: Chemistry divides into areas with very different cost profiles. These are the ones Muhaisnah enquiries name, with an honest note on how many hours each typically absorbs.

subjects.name: Models of the particulate nature of matter
subjects.description: Atomic structure, the mole concept, electron configuration and the ideal gas relationship. Mole reasoning underpins everything later, so a gap here is the most expensive one in the course and the one most worth paying to fix early.

subjects.name: Models of bonding and structure
subjects.description: Ionic, covalent and metallic bonding, intermolecular forces, and at Higher Level more formal treatment of hybridisation and molecular geometry. Students draw structures competently and lose marks explaining the property that follows from them.

subjects.name: Classification of matter
subjects.description: Periodicity, the organic families and spectroscopic identification. Periodic trends are the area where recall most commonly substitutes for understanding, and the longer questions ask for an account rather than a statement.

subjects.name: What drives chemical reactions
subjects.description: Energetics, entropy and spontaneity, with Gibbs energy at Higher Level. Conceptually the hardest strand for most students in this catchment and a reliable consumer of tutoring hours once it has gone wrong.

subjects.name: How much, how fast and how far
subjects.description: Stoichiometry, kinetics and equilibrium including acid-base and redox treatment. Equilibrium questions reward reasoning about shift and extent rather than recalling a rule, and that is a teachable distinction.

subjects.name: Mechanisms of chemical change
subjects.description: Organic reaction mechanisms and electrochemistry. The single largest consumer of tutoring time in Diploma chemistry, because a student who has learned mechanisms as sequences to memorise has to unlearn before they can learn.

subjects.name: Uncertainty and data handling
subjects.description: Absolute and percentage uncertainty, propagation, significant figures and graph interpretation. Cheap to teach, worth a predictable number of marks, and largely independent of whether the student understands equilibrium.

subjects.name: Command-term discipline
subjects.description: State, deduce, explain, outline, discuss and justify each want a different answer. Among the lowest-cost gains available: a student writing explanations where deductions were requested is doing extra work for fewer marks.

subjects.name: The scientific investigation
subjects.description: Twenty per cent of the grade, marked out of 24 across four criteria. Most of the mark is decided by the research question before any data is collected, which makes the first session the cheapest and most valuable on the whole course.

subjects.name: Spectroscopic and analytical techniques
subjects.levels: SL and HL, deeper at HL
subjects.description: Mass spectrometry, infrared and nuclear magnetic resonance used to deduce structure. Pattern-recognition work that responds quickly to practice, which makes it good value in a short block before a series.

subjects.name: Calculations under time pressure
subjects.description: Multi-step stoichiometry and energetics arithmetic done accurately at speed. Students who can do the chemistry untimed and not timed have a pacing problem, which needs timed sections rather than more content.

subjects.name: Higher Level extension content
subjects.description: Additional material within each strand rather than as a separate unit, examined in the same papers. Students who over-revise the shared content and under-revise the extension are capped, and that is a planning error that costs nothing to correct.

sections.heading: Published Dubai rates, read as an annual commitment
paragraphs: Here is the market expressed the way a family actually experiences it. The hourly figures are other providers' published rates, collected in October 2026, and the third column converts each into what a weekly hour costs across a thirty-week school year. That conversion is the number worth arguing about, because it is the one that lands on a household budget.

Reading it this way changes the comparison. The gap between a qualified online tutor and a budget one is roughly AED 2,700 to 4,500 across a year, which is a real sum and buys a genuinely different lesson. The gap between a qualified tutor and a premium examiner-branded provider is far larger and buys scarcity and brand rather than a demonstrably different outcome, which is worth saying plainly because nobody in this market says it.

The in-home row is the one to study if you are weighing formats. The published band of AED 180 to 500 an hour includes travel, and monthly in-home packages of four two-hour visits have been published at AED 1,599 to 1,799, which is roughly AED 12,000 to 13,500 across a year for eight hours a month. Compare that against a weekly online hour at qualified rates and the difference is substantial, and most of it is a car journey.

Our own figure is agreed at the consultation once the level, the diagnosed problem and the cadence are known, because a first-year investigation block and a second-year organic rebuild are not the same product and a single number would mislead most readers. We sit in the qualified-specialist part of this table rather than the budget part. The trial lesson is free, nothing is charged before it, and if the marked script says a bounded block will do we quote the block rather than the year.

sections.heading: Where chemistry money is actually wasted in this catchment
paragraphs: Five patterns, all specific to this subject. First, buying content coverage when the marked script shows a technique problem. A student losing marks on command terms, uncertainty and timing does not need more equilibrium teaching, and a term of it is several thousand dirhams aimed at the wrong target. Chemistry is particularly prone to this because content feels like the obvious explanation for a chemistry grade.

Second, starting organic chemistry support late. Mechanisms learned as memorised sequences have to be unlearned before they can be understood, and the unlearning takes longer than the learning would have. A student who began the topic badly in the first year and seeks help in the spring of the second is buying the most expensive version of this fix available. Starting the same work twelve months earlier is materially cheaper.

Third, paying specialist rates for mole arithmetic. If the real gap is proportional reasoning and balancing, that is Key Stage 4 content and a qualified tutor at the middle band can fix it. Buying a Higher Level Diploma specialist to rebuild mole reasoning is paying for scarcity you do not need.

Fourth, leaving the investigation until the second year. It carries 20% of the grade, it is marked out of 24 across four criteria, and most of the available marks are determined by the research question. Reaching it late means paying for sessions on a write-up whose ceiling was set months earlier. Fifth, buying two sciences at once. A Diploma student carrying chemistry and physics support simultaneously, on top of six subjects and the core, usually produces two mediocre efforts at double the cost.

sections.heading: Structure and Reactivity: what the current guide contains
paragraphs: The current Diploma chemistry guide organises content into two groups of three strands: Structure 1 to 3 and Reactivity 1 to 3, with additional higher-level material inside each rather than as a separate block. That matters for a tutoring budget because the cost of help is not uniform across them. Two strands reliably absorb hours and four do not, and knowing which is which before you buy changes the quote you should accept.

The table sets out each strand with what it covers, how expensive it typically is to fix once it has gone wrong, and why. Read the cost column as a planning tool rather than a verdict: a strand marked expensive is not harder in some abstract sense, it is more interconnected, so a gap there propagates into later work and the repair involves revisiting more ground.

The two expensive strands are energetics and spontaneity, and mechanisms of chemical change. Energetics is conceptually demanding and underpins equilibrium reasoning later. Organic mechanisms are expensive for a different reason: students commonly learn them as sequences to reproduce, which works until a paper asks them to predict an unfamiliar one, and the correction requires rebuilding how they think about the topic rather than adding to what they know.

The cheap strands are worth naming too, because families rarely ask for them. Analytical and spectroscopic techniques respond quickly to pattern practice. Periodicity responds to being taught as explanation rather than recall. And classification of matter rewards structured note-making more than tutoring. If your budget is limited, spend it on the expensive strands and on technique, and let the school's teaching carry the rest. Confirm the current structure against your child's subject guide, which the IB coordinator can supply.

sections.heading: What your child sits, and which components are cheap to improve
paragraphs: Chemistry is examined across two written papers plus the scientific investigation. Paper 1 carries 36% and contains a multiple-choice section and a data-based section. Paper 2 is extended response and carries 44%. The investigation carries the remaining 20%. Higher Level sits longer papers covering the extension content in the same components; there is no separate third paper, which distinguishes chemistry from Higher Level mathematics.

Expressed as a budget question, this structure has a clear implication. The data-based section and the investigation together account for a meaningful share of the grade and both reward skills that are independent of content confidence: uncertainty handling, significant figures, graph interpretation, research design, evaluation. Those are the cheap marks. Paper 2 extended response rewards content understanding and command-term discipline, and the content half of that is where the expensive work sits.

So a family with a limited budget should buy the cheap marks first. It feels counterintuitive to spend on uncertainty arithmetic when a student is struggling with energetics, but the arithmetic is recoverable in a handful of sessions and the energetics is not. A student who secures the technique marks while the school continues teaching content frequently moves a grade without any content tutoring at all.

The table below sets out each component with what it rewards and an honest note on how responsive it is to a short intervention. Confirm weightings and durations against the current subject guide for your child's cohort, because they are revised when a guide is reissued, and ask any prospective tutor to recite them from memory before you book.

sections.heading: Organic chemistry: why it costs more than anything else
paragraphs: If a Muhaisnah family tells us their child is struggling with organic chemistry, we quote a longer block than for any other strand, and it is worth explaining why rather than simply charging for it. Organic chemistry is the one area of the Diploma sciences where the commonest way of learning it actively obstructs the assessment. Students learn mechanisms as sequences of arrows to reproduce. That works on a familiar reaction and fails completely when a paper presents an unfamiliar one and asks what will happen.

Repairing it means rebuilding the student's model: electron density, nucleophiles and electrophiles, why a particular bond is the vulnerable one, what makes a leaving group leave. Until that is in place, every additional mechanism is another thing to memorise, and the memory load grows faster than the understanding. The work is slow because it is genuinely conceptual, and a tutor who promises to fix organic chemistry in four sessions is either exceptional or guessing.

The practical budget consequence is that organic chemistry is the strongest argument in the subject for starting in the first year. A student who learns mechanisms correctly the first time needs no repair at all. A student who learns them as sequences and seeks help eighteen months later is buying both the unlearning and the learning, at specialist rates, during the term when the investigation and the mocks are also competing for their time.

If you are already in the expensive version of this situation, the honest advice is to narrow rather than to buy more hours. Pick the mechanism families that actually appear most in the papers your child will sit, secure those properly, and accept that complete coverage is not available in the time remaining. A tutor who will prioritise with you is worth more than one who proposes to cover everything, because the second plan will not finish and the student will have paid for the part that did.

sections.heading: The investigation: 24 marks and the cheapest hour on the course
paragraphs: Twenty per cent of the chemistry grade is submitted before any examination, is marked out of 24 across four criteria of six marks each, and is almost entirely within the student's control while it is in progress. There is no cheaper source of marks in the subject, and no component more consistently neglected until it is too late to influence.

The four criteria are research design, data analysis, conclusion and evaluation. The decisive one is the first, because the quality of everything that follows is capped by the question chosen and the variables identified. A question with no cleanly measurable independent variable produces data with nothing to analyse, which caps the second criterion, which caps the third. A single session on question viability therefore protects most of the available marks, and it is one session.

The boundary on help is firm. A tutor may explain what each criterion asks for, interrogate the research question and the control of variables, check that uncertainties have been propagated correctly, and read the student's own draft to say which descriptor is not yet met. A tutor may not write, restructure or complete any part of the submission, supply data, or perform the analysis. After a useful session the student holds three specific problems and the document contains nothing the tutor produced.

This is also where the market's worst behaviour sits. One provider found in the research for these pages sells completed internal assessments at a published price. Buying one is not a shortcut, it is an academic-honesty breach that triggers IB malpractice procedures against the student rather than the seller, and the consequence lands on a sixteen-year-old. We will not produce assessed work at any price and we would rather say so on the page than in terms and conditions.

sections.heading: How many hours a chemistry grade actually needs
paragraphs: This is the question families ask last and should ask first. The honest answer depends entirely on what the marked script says, and the range is wide enough to matter: some chemistry problems are a four-session fix and some are a two-term rebuild. Quoting an average would be useless, so the table below sets out the scenarios we actually see from this catchment with a realistic session count for each.

Use it to sanity-check any quote you are given, including ours. If a provider proposes thirty sessions for a command-term and timing problem, they are overselling. If a provider proposes six sessions to rebuild organic mechanisms from a memorised-sequence starting point, they are underselling and the engagement will quietly extend. Both are common and both are detectable with this table in hand.

The scenarios assume a specialist at the qualified or specialist band working one-to-one, with problems set and marked between sessions. Without work between sessions, add roughly half again to every row: most of the consolidation in chemistry happens between lessons, and a tutor who sets nothing is selling an hour of company rather than a course of study.

The last column is the one that should drive the purchase. Where a problem is diagnosable and bounded, buy the block and stop. Where it is a rebuild, accept the length upfront and plan the budget around it rather than discovering it in month four. And where the diagnosis is uncertain, buy three sessions to establish it before buying anything longer, because the cheapest money in this subject is the money spent working out what to spend the rest on.

sections.heading: Higher Level chemistry, university routes and the cost of getting it wrong
paragraphs: Higher Level chemistry is required or strongly expected for medicine, dentistry, pharmacy and several biological and chemical engineering routes across most destinations, usually alongside biology or physics depending on the programme. That makes it one of the highest-stakes Higher Level choices a Diploma student makes, and it is also one of the most demanding in content volume, which is why the tutoring demand for it in this catchment is steady.

Requirements are stated by subject and level on each university's own admissions page, and that is the only place to check them. A tutoring page cannot responsibly generalise about medicine admission across countries, and we will not: the requirement is institutional, it changes, and a wrong generalisation could shape a subject choice badly. If the intended destination is unclear, the lower-risk position for a chemistry-dependent route is Higher Level chemistry taken seriously from the first term.

What this means for a budget is that chemistry is often the subject where a family is least willing to economise and most likely to overspend as a result. The remedy is not spending less, it is spending in the right order: technique and investigation first because they are cheap and transferable, then the diagnosed content strand as a bounded block, and nothing at all on strands the school is teaching adequately.

One caution that belongs on a page about cost. No tutoring is required for a university application, for Ministry of Education equivalency, or for school progression, and any provider implying otherwise is selling urgency rather than teaching. Equivalency is a Ministry process with published requirements, and for the British track those are five accredited GCSE or IGCSE subjects at no less than grade E or 3, excluding Arabic and Islamic Education, plus A Level or AS Level passes. No IB points threshold should be quoted to you without a source on the Ministry's own site.

sections.heading: Starting chemistry support from Muhaisnah, at a known cost
paragraphs: Send the level, the most recent marked script and the school's weekly timetable. The script is what makes a quote honest: it tells a chemistry specialist whether this is a four-session technique fix or a two-term organic rebuild, and those two differ by an order of magnitude in cost. A description in words almost always points at content when the marks point at technique.

If the diagnosis is genuinely unclear, buy the three-session block and nothing more. It ends with a written view of what the problem is and what it will take, and it quite often concludes that a short bounded block is sufficient, which is a smaller sale than a weekly slot and the right recommendation. We would rather give that advice than take a monthly payment nobody is measuring.

After the diagnosis, agree the block with a fixed number of sessions and a stated target so the total cost is known in advance. For chemistry a good target is narrow: propagating percentage uncertainty without prompting, matching answer length to the command term, or predicting an unfamiliar mechanism from electron density rather than recall. Each is checkable on a marked paper, which makes the review at the end of the block evidence rather than conversation.

And if you are reading this in the first year rather than the second, the cheapest intervention available to you is the investigation question and uncertainty technique, bought now, as a short block. Both transfer across two years, neither depends on content confidence, and together they protect a substantial share of the grade for a fraction of what a second-year rescue costs. Families who do this rarely need us again; families who do not usually pay more later.

faqs.question: What does a year of IB chemistry tutoring actually cost in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Using the published bands, a weekly hour with a qualified online tutor across a thirty-week school year lands at roughly AED 4,500 to 9,000. A specialist at AED 200 to 450 and above comes out nearer AED 6,000 to 13,500 or more. In-home monthly packages of four two-hour visits have been published at AED 1,599 to 1,799, which is roughly AED 12,000 to 13,500 annually for eight hours a month. A bounded ten-week block of two sessions a week is roughly AED 3,000 to 6,000 in total. Those figures belong to the providers named, collected October 2026.

faqs.question: Why is chemistry more expensive to tutor than other Diploma sciences?
faqs.answer: Not because the hourly rate differs, but because the hours multiply. Two strands in particular absorb time: energetics and spontaneity, which is conceptually demanding and underpins equilibrium reasoning later, and organic mechanisms, where students commonly learn reactions as sequences to reproduce and have to unlearn that before they can predict an unfamiliar one. A gap in mole reasoning compounds the problem because stoichiometry, energetics and equilibrium all rest on it. Other parts of the course are genuinely cheap to fix, which is why diagnosis before purchase matters so much here.

faqs.question: Which parts of IB chemistry are cheapest to improve?
faqs.answer: Three, and they are worth a surprising number of marks. The data-based section inside Paper 1 rewards uncertainty handling, significant figures and graph interpretation, all of which drill to automaticity in four to six sessions and none of which depend on content confidence. Command-term discipline is similar: a student writing explanations where deductions were requested is doing extra work for fewer marks. And the investigation research question, while it is still open, protects a fifth of the grade for the price of a single session.

faqs.question: How many chemistry sessions does a diagnosed gap usually take?
faqs.answer: It depends on what the marked script shows and the range is wide. Command terms and answer structure: four to six. Uncertainty and graph work: four to six. Pacing problems: six to eight. Insecure mole and stoichiometry arithmetic: eight to twelve. Energetics not understood: ten to fourteen. Organic mechanisms learned as memorised sequences: fourteen to twenty or more. If the diagnosis is unclear, buy three sessions to establish it before buying anything longer. Any quote that ignores this range in either direction is overselling or underselling.

faqs.question: Is a cheaper tutor enough for Standard Level chemistry?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, and it depends on the task. If the requirement is consolidation of content the school has already taught, a qualified tutor in the AED 150 to 300 band does that competently. If the requirement is investigation coaching, data-based technique or anything involving the assessment model rather than the chemistry, the specialist band earns its premium because assessment literacy is what you are paying for. The budget tier, at roughly AED 33 to 65 an hour as published, is homework support and should be bought as such rather than as Diploma preparation.

faqs.question: What are the six strands of the current chemistry course?
faqs.answer: Structure 1, the particulate nature of matter, covering atomic structure, the mole and gases. Structure 2, bonding and structure. Structure 3, classification of matter including periodicity and organic families. Reactivity 1, what drives chemical reactions, covering energetics and spontaneity. Reactivity 2, how much, how fast and how far, covering stoichiometry, kinetics and equilibrium. Reactivity 3, mechanisms of chemical change, covering organic mechanisms and electrochemistry. Additional higher-level material sits inside each strand rather than separately. Confirm against your child's subject guide, which the IB coordinator can supply.

faqs.question: Can we fix organic chemistry in a few weeks before the exams?
faqs.answer: Partly, and only by narrowing. If the student learned mechanisms as sequences to memorise, the repair involves rebuilding how they think about electron density, nucleophiles and leaving groups, and that is slow conceptual work rather than revision. In a short window the honest plan is to secure the mechanism families that appear most in the papers they will sit and accept that complete coverage is not available. A tutor proposing to cover everything in six weeks has a plan that will not finish, and your child will have paid for the part that did.

faqs.question: How much of the chemistry grade can we influence before any exam?
faqs.answer: Twenty per cent, through the scientific investigation, which is marked out of 24 across four criteria of six marks each and submitted before the papers are sat. It is the only component entirely within the student's control while it is in progress, and most of its mark is determined by the research question rather than by the write-up, because a question with no cleanly measurable independent variable caps the analysis and therefore the conclusion. One session on question viability early is the best-value hour in the subject.

faqs.question: Will a tutor help write up the chemistry investigation?
faqs.answer: No, and nobody honest will. A tutor may explain what each of the four criteria asks for, interrogate the research question and the control of variables, check that uncertainties have been propagated correctly, and read the student's own draft to say which descriptor is not yet met. After a useful session the student holds specific problems to fix and the document contains nothing the tutor produced. One provider in this market sells completed internal assessments; using it triggers IB malpractice procedures against the student rather than the seller.

faqs.question: Should we tutor chemistry and physics at the same time?
faqs.answer: Rarely, and it is one of the five ways families here overspend. A Diploma student is carrying six subjects, Theory of Knowledge, an Extended Essay and CAS, plus mandatory Arabic, Islamic Education and Social or Moral Studies in a Dubai school. Two tutored sciences a week on top of that usually produces two mediocre efforts at double the cost. Pick the science where the marked script shows the larger and more fixable gap, run a bounded block, review it, and only then consider the second.

faqs.question: Is it cheaper to start chemistry support in the first year?
faqs.answer: Substantially, and organic chemistry is the clearest case. A student who learns mechanisms correctly the first time needs no repair at all; a student who learns them as sequences and seeks help eighteen months later pays for the unlearning and the learning, at specialist rates, during the term when the investigation and mocks are also competing. The same logic applies to mole arithmetic: fixed in the summer before the Diploma it is cheap and at the mid band, fixed in the second year it is expensive and urgent.

faqs.question: Why does an in-home chemistry tutor cost more for the same hour?
faqs.answer: Because the published band of roughly AED 180 to 500 includes travel to your address, and from Muhaisnah that journey crosses Al Awir Road and the wider afternoon peak. You also pay in delivered minutes, since arrival slippage of ten to fifteen minutes is normal and is not refunded. IB Gram does not offer home visits in the UAE at all, so for us this is a comparison rather than an option: home visiting is a service we run only in India, and in the UAE every lesson is live one-to-one over video.

faqs.question: Do we need Higher Level chemistry for medicine or pharmacy?
faqs.answer: It is required or strongly expected for medicine, dentistry, pharmacy and several biological and chemical engineering routes across most destinations, usually alongside biology or physics depending on the programme. Requirements are stated by subject and level on each university's own admissions page and that is the only place to check them; a tutoring page cannot responsibly generalise across countries. What we will say is that no tutoring is required for an application, and any provider implying otherwise is selling urgency rather than teaching.

faqs.question: How do we know the money is working rather than just being spent?
faqs.answer: Agree a narrow target at the start of the block and check it on a marked paper at the end. For chemistry good targets are specific: propagating a percentage uncertainty without prompting, matching answer length to the command term, or predicting an unfamiliar mechanism from electron density rather than from recall. Bad targets are improve in chemistry and cover the syllabus, because neither can be checked and both lead to monthly renewal out of uncertainty. That renewal habit, rather than the hourly rate, is where families here lose the most.

dubai/ib-chemistry-tutor-in-muhaisnah.closingHeading: Diagnose first, then buy a block
dubai/ib-chemistry-tutor-in-muhaisnah.closingBody: Chemistry is the Diploma science where an unexamined weekly slot costs the most and achieves the least, because the same symptom can mean a four-session fix or a two-term rebuild. Send us the level, the most recent marked script and the school's weekly timetable, and we will tell you which it is, quote a block with a fixed length and a stated target, and offer a free trial lesson first. Nothing is charged before that lesson. If three sessions of diagnosis are all you should buy, that is what we will recommend, and if a cheaper band of tutor would serve the actual problem we will say so.

intro.heading: Chemistry fails in two places and both have a deadline
paragraphs: The first failure is organic chemistry, and it arrives late enough in most schemes to be genuinely dangerous. Up to that point a capable student can carry chemistry on recall and careful arithmetic. Organic asks for something different: a mental model of how a functional group behaves, why a reaction proceeds in one direction, and at Higher Level the mechanisms and the spectroscopic evidence that identify a structure. Students who have been scoring well suddenly cannot, and they conclude that chemistry has become impossible rather than that it has changed shape.

The second failure is calculation accuracy, and it is invisible in classwork. Moles, concentration, limiting reagents, percentage yield, enthalpy changes by Hess's law or bond enthalpies, equilibrium constants, pH on a logarithmic scale, and at Higher Level rate equations and electrochemical calculations. Each is straightforward in isolation and each attracts a specific error under examination pressure. A student loses one mark here and one there, and the total is a grade.

Both failures sit on a calendar. Organic can be rebuilt in the autumn term of DP2 and not usefully in April, because it is content rather than technique. Calculation accuracy is the opposite: it is a habit, so it responds to drilling right up to the week before a paper, and it is the right thing to buy late. Knowing which of the two problems a student has decides what you should be purchasing and when, and a marked paper answers it in minutes.

Running alongside both is the internal assessment, one independent investigation carrying twenty per cent of the chemistry grade, marked by the school and moderated. In chemistry the risk concentrates in whether the chosen question can generate enough quantitative variation to analyse, which many plausible-sounding chemistry questions cannot. That is decided before any solution is made up, which makes a single screening session in the DP1 spring the most valuable hour on offer.

Nad Al Hamar is a residential district on the eastern side of Dubai between the Ras Al Khor sanctuary and the Dubai-Al Ain Road, and its children travel out to schools in Festival City, Mirdif, Al Warqa, Al Qusais and Academic City. There is no Diploma school inside the district and a resident Higher Level chemistry specialist would be a coincidence. Teaching is one-to-one over live video, on Gulf Standard Time. IB Gram does not offer home visits in Dubai or anywhere else in the UAE; home tutoring is a service we run in India only, and for chemistry a shared screen carrying a mechanism, a spectrum and the student's own titration data is the better tool anyway. The rest of this page names every calculation type and its characteristic error, tests investigation questions for feasibility, and sets the DP2 terms against what school is teaching.

subjects.name: Stoichiometry and the mole
subjects.description: Molar mass, moles from mass and from concentration, limiting reagents, percentage yield and gas volumes. The arithmetic foundation of the whole subject, and the place where a single careless conversion invalidates a multi-mark answer that was otherwise correct.

subjects.description: Enthalpy changes by calorimetry, Hess's law and bond enthalpies, with entropy and Gibbs free energy at Higher Level. Sign conventions are the reliable error: students compute the magnitude correctly and then state exothermic when they mean endothermic.

subjects.name: Chemical kinetics
subjects.description: Collision theory and activation energy at both levels, then rate equations, orders of reaction, rate-determining steps and the Arrhenius relationship at Higher Level. Determining order from data is a graph-handling skill and is examined as one.

subjects.name: Equilibrium
subjects.description: Le Chatelier reasoning at both levels and equilibrium constant calculations at Higher Level. Students reason about shifts confidently and then lose marks writing the equilibrium expression with the wrong powers or including a pure solid.

subjects.name: Acids and bases
subjects.description: Strong and weak acid behaviour, pH on a logarithmic scale, buffers and titration curves, with the weak acid dissociation calculations at Higher Level. Logarithms are the obstacle rather than the chemistry, which makes this a mathematics problem for many students.

subjects.name: Redox and electrochemistry
subjects.description: Oxidation states, half-equations, electrolysis and cells, with cell potential and electrolytic quantification at Higher Level. Balancing half-equations in acidic or basic conditions is a procedure that students half-remember and that rewards a fixed routine.

subjects.name: Organic chemistry
subjects.description: Functional groups, nomenclature and reaction types at both levels, then mechanisms including nucleophilic substitution pathways, elimination and electrophilic addition at Higher Level. The dividing line between a 5 and a 7 at Higher Level, and the part that needs a model rather than recall.

subjects.name: Spectroscopy and structure determination
subjects.description: Infrared absorptions, mass spectrometry fragmentation and nuclear magnetic resonance interpretation, used together to identify an unknown structure. A puzzle-solving skill that improves rapidly with volume of practice and barely at all with explanation.

subjects.description: One independent investigation worth twenty per cent of the grade, marked against four criteria and externally moderated. sections.heading: Organic chemistry, and why it separates Higher Level students
paragraphs: Everything in chemistry before organic can be carried on two things: careful arithmetic and reliable recall. Organic withdraws both supports. Nomenclature is recall, so students start comfortably, and then the course asks why a particular reagent attacks a particular carbon, what the intermediate looks like, and which of two pathways a given substrate will follow. That is a model of behaviour rather than a list of facts, and a student who has succeeded by memorising is suddenly working without their main tool.

At Higher Level this intensifies. Mechanisms must be drawn with correct arrow placement, intermediates must be shown, and the choice between substitution pathways has to be justified from the structure of the substrate. Alongside that sits structure determination, where infrared absorptions, a mass spectrum and nuclear magnetic resonance data are used together to identify an unknown compound. That is a puzzle-solving skill, and it improves with volume of practice far more than with explanation.

The practical teaching consequence is that organic has to be rebuilt from behaviour rather than patched from past questions. A student who cannot say why a nucleophile is a nucleophile will not be rescued by twenty more mechanism questions. Six to eight hours on electron availability, polarity and what makes a leaving group leave does more than a term of question practice, and it transfers across the whole of the topic rather than to the specific questions drilled.

The calendar consequence is that this is autumn work. Organic is content, and content needs time to settle, which means the DP2 autumn term is the last honest window. A parent offered an organic rebuild in April should ask what will be dropped to make room, because the answer is usually revision in the other five subjects. Where the spring can still help is in structure determination practice, which is pattern recognition and responds to late drilling.

sections.heading: Every calculation type, and the error it reliably attracts
paragraphs: Chemistry marks leak one at a time through calculations, and the leaks are predictable enough to be listed. That is unusually good news, because a predictable error is a fixable one. Moles from mass invites a molar mass computed from the wrong formula. Moles from concentration invites a volume left in millilitres. Limiting reagent questions invite the student to use the reagent named first rather than the one that runs out. Percentage yield invites a theoretical yield based on the wrong stoichiometric ratio.

Enthalpy calculations invite sign errors, and specifically a correct magnitude attached to the wrong direction, which is the most frustrating single mark in the subject. Hess's law cycles invite a reversed arrow left unreversed in the arithmetic. Bond enthalpy calculations invite the student to forget that bonds broken and bonds formed enter with opposite signs. pH work invites logarithm handling errors rather than chemistry errors. Equilibrium expressions invite wrong powers and the inclusion of pure solids.

At Higher Level, rate equations invite an order read off a graph without checking the axes, and electrochemical calculations invite the wrong number of electrons in a half-equation. None of these is a conceptual failure. Each is a specific mechanical slip, each recurs in the same student across papers, and each is eliminated by naming it and then drilling that one type until it is automatic.

The diagnostic a parent can run without any chemistry is to take a marked paper and sort the lost marks into calculation slips, sign and unit errors, command-term misreadings and genuine content gaps. If the first two categories dominate, the problem is drilling rather than teaching, and it can be fixed in weeks at any point in the calendar, including the last fortnight before a paper.

sections.heading: Chemistry investigation questions that work, and ones that cannot
paragraphs: The chemistry internal assessment carries twenty per cent of the grade and its ceiling is set at the question. The requirement that catches students is quantitative range: the independent variable must be variable across a span wide enough that the measured quantity changes by substantially more than its own uncertainty. Plenty of chemically interesting questions fail that test, and the failure is invisible until the data comes back flat.

Concentration-dependence questions usually work, because concentration can be varied across an order of magnitude and the effect on rate or on equilibrium position is measurable. Temperature-dependence questions usually work, with the caveat that the accessible range in a school laboratory is narrow. Questions comparing two or three named substances usually struggle, because three data points do not permit analysis of a relationship, only a comparison, and the processing marks have nowhere to go.

Questions about something that cannot be measured accurately with school apparatus fail for a different reason: the uncertainty swamps the effect. A mass change of a few hundredths of a gram measured on a two-decimal balance gives an uncertainty of the same order as the result. Students pick these because the chemistry sounds sophisticated. A single screening conversation before the laboratory is booked prevents it, and after the data exists nothing can.

Where a tutor's role is legitimate and valuable: discussing feasibility, explaining what the marking rewards, demonstrating a complete worked analysis on an entirely different data set, and reading your child's own draft to ask questions about range, repeats, uncertainty and whether the conclusion follows from the processing. Choosing the question, designing the method, processing the data or writing any section is not on the list, and it is a malpractice exposure that falls on the candidate rather than on us.

sections.heading: The three terms of DP2 chemistry, matched to what school is teaching
paragraphs: A chemistry plan only works if it sits alongside the school's scheme rather than running its own. In most eastern-suburb Diploma schools the DP2 autumn term carries the remaining content, frequently including the Higher Level organic and spectroscopic material, and also carries the internal assessment deadline. That double load is the reason this term produces the most distress calls, and the reason the investigation design should have been done the previous spring.

The term from the winter break to the spring break is mock-driven. Mocks are sat, marked and converted into predicted grades. The marked script is the most useful document of the whole year, and it should be read for its error pattern rather than its total. A chemistry script dominated by sign errors, unit slips and logarithm mistakes describes a different student from one dominated by blank organic mechanism questions, and the two need opposite plans.

The final term is revision only. Timed papers, mark-scheme logic, the calculation types drilled one by one, and structure determination practised in volume because it is pattern recognition and improves late. Content is not rebuilt here. A parent being sold a content programme in April should ask which other subject's revision it will displace, and the honest answer is usually one that matters.

The table below sets what the school is likely doing against what a tutor should add. The value of the exercise is that it stops a tutor from teaching in parallel. A session that repairs the misunderstanding in this week's school topic is worth several that cover a different part of the syllabus competently, and in a subject as cumulative as chemistry that gap compounds.

sections.heading: Accuracy as a grade: significant figures, units and the mole
paragraphs: Chemistry is the Diploma subject where carelessness is most expensive, because almost every question ends in a number. The conventions are simple and the discipline is not. Work to full precision throughout and round once, at the end, to three significant figures unless the question says otherwise. Carry units through every line, including through rearrangement. State whether a process is exothermic or endothermic before writing the magnitude, so the sign cannot drift. Convert volumes to the units the formula expects before any arithmetic starts.

The reason students resist this is that each individual rule is worth one mark, and one mark feels negligible. Across a paper with twenty numerical answers it is not negligible at all, and across two papers it is a grade. The honest framing for a student is arithmetic rather than moral: count the marks lost to these conventions on a marked paper, and the number is usually larger than the marks lost to any single content topic.

The remedy is a routine rather than a lesson. A fixed thirty-second check at the end of every numerical question: have I converted the units, is the sign right, is the number of figures justified, does the magnitude look physically sensible. Practised until automatic, it costs ten minutes a paper and returns several marks. It is the single highest-return habit available in the subject, and it can be installed at any point, including the week before a paper.

The mole deserves its own mention because it underpins everything. A student who is not automatic with moles from mass, moles from concentration and the stoichiometric ratio will be slow in every calculation question and will run short of time on the extended paper. Automaticity here is not a conceptual achievement; it is drilling, and six to eight short sessions produce it. For a student arriving from MYP integrated science rather than IGCSE chemistry, this is usually the first thing to buy.

sections.heading: Chemistry for medicine, and the route questions behind the subject
paragraphs: A large share of Higher Level chemistry students in Dubai are taking it because of where they intend to apply rather than because of the subject. Medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, veterinary science, biochemistry and chemical engineering all commonly require chemistry, frequently at Higher Level, and sometimes with a stated grade. That changes the nature of the conversation: the target is not a good grade but a specific one, and the gap between a 5 and a 6 may matter more than anything else in the student's results.

Two cautions follow. The first is that entry requirements are published by individual universities for individual courses and vary more than general advice suggests. The only reliable method is to open the entry-requirements page for the exact course at the exact university and read the chemistry line. A general rule read on a tutoring page is not a substitute, and this page will not offer one.

The second is that tutoring is not required for admission anywhere and nobody can promise a grade. No provider can promise a particular grade, a points total or a university place, and one that does is making a claim it cannot stand behind, and in a market where that promise is common it is the clearest available signal to walk away. What can honestly be offered is work on the specific components where marks are currently being lost.

For UAE-based routes there is a separate administrative matter. UAE certificate equivalency is a Ministry of Education process with published requirements for the British and American tracks, and for the International Baccalaureate no points threshold appears in the sourced guidance we have read, so we publish none. A family needing equivalency should check moe.gov.ae or the emirate attestation authority directly. We describe the process; we do not perform, expedite or guarantee any part of it.

Calculation drilling is mechanical and does not require a tutor at the top of the range; a qualified subject tutor at the AED 150 to 300 band does it perfectly well and twice a week is affordable in the middle monthly band. An organic rebuild at Higher Level, including mechanisms and spectroscopy, does need somebody who has taught that material, and that sits in the specialist band.

sections.heading: Anomalous results, and the line that must not be crossed
paragraphs: Chemistry has its own particular honesty hazard, and it is not plagiarism. It is data. An investigation produces a point that does not fit, or a whole set that shows no trend, and the temptation is to tidy it: drop the awkward reading without justification, adjust a value toward the expected answer, or quietly repeat only the measurements that behaved. Each of those is falsification, and it is the kind of malpractice that a moderator who has seen a thousand write-ups can often detect.

The legitimate treatment is better for the mark anyway. An anomalous result that is identified, discussed and excluded with a stated reason earns credit under evaluation; the same result silently deleted earns nothing and risks everything. A data set showing no trend is a genuine finding that can be written up honestly, with the uncertainty discussed and the method critiqued, and it scores considerably better than a fabricated trend badly disguised. Students do not know this, and it is worth telling them early rather than after they have been tempted.

Our boundary is the same here as everywhere. A tutor may teach the content, explain what the marking rewards, advise on whether a question is feasible, demonstrate a full worked analysis on an entirely different data set, and read the student's own draft to ask questions about range, repeats, uncertainty and whether the conclusion follows. A tutor may not choose the question, design the method, process the student's data, write or rewrite any section, or edit a draft into shape.

We also do not supply syllabus documents, past papers, mark schemes or grade-boundary tables as downloads, because they belong to the IB and your child's school has legitimate access to the assessment material. A tutor working from them in a session is ordinary practice. At least one site ranking for these searches sells completed internal assessments outright; the consequence of buying one falls on the candidate, who can lose the diploma.

faqs.question: Why has our child's chemistry collapsed since organic chemistry started?
faqs.answer: Because organic asks for a different kind of thinking from everything before it. Until then, chemistry can be carried on recall and careful arithmetic. Organic asks why a reagent attacks a particular carbon, what the intermediate looks like, and at Higher Level which of two pathways a substrate will follow. A student who has succeeded by memorising loses their main tool. The remedy is six to eight hours on electron availability, polarity and leaving groups, which transfers across the whole topic rather than to drilled questions.

faqs.question: Which chemistry calculation does our child most likely get wrong?
faqs.answer: Statistically, enthalpy signs and unit conversion. A correct magnitude attached to the wrong direction is the most common single-mark loss in the subject, and a volume left in millilitres is the second. After those come limiting reagent questions answered using the reagent named first, percentage yields built on an unbalanced equation, and logarithm slips in pH work. Take a marked paper, count the losses by type, and the largest category is the next month's drilling rather than a guess.

faqs.question: Is it too late to rebuild organic chemistry in the spring of DP2?
faqs.answer: For the conceptual rebuild, largely yes. Organic is content and content needs time to settle, so the DP2 autumn term is the last honest window, and a provider selling an organic programme in April should be asked which other subject's revision it will displace. What the spring can still do is structure determination practice, where infrared, mass spectrometry and nuclear magnetic resonance data are used together to identify unknowns. That is pattern recognition, improves with volume, and responds well to late drilling.

faqs.question: What makes a chemistry investigation question actually workable?
faqs.answer: The independent variable has to be variable across a real span, and the measured quantity has to change by substantially more than its own uncertainty on school apparatus. Concentration-dependence and temperature-dependence questions usually satisfy both. Comparing three named substances gives only three discrete points, which permits a comparison and not an analysis, so the processing marks have nowhere to go. Questions resting on mass changes of a few hundredths of a gram fail on the balance rather than on the chemistry.

faqs.question: Our data shows no trend at all. What do we do now?
faqs.answer: Write it up honestly, because that scores considerably better than the alternative. A data set with no trend is a genuine finding: the uncertainty can be discussed, the method critiqued, and specific improvements proposed, all of which earns credit under evaluation. What must not happen is tidying, which means dropping an awkward reading without justification, adjusting values toward the expected answer, or repeating only the measurements that behaved. That is falsification, moderators often detect it, and a malpractice finding falls on the candidate.

faqs.question: How do we stop losing single marks to significant figures and units?
faqs.answer: Install a routine rather than learn a rule. Work to full precision throughout and round once at the end to three significant figures unless the question specifies otherwise. Convert units before any arithmetic begins rather than during it. State exothermic or endothermic before writing the enthalpy magnitude so the sign cannot drift. Then run a fixed thirty-second check at the end of every numerical question. Count the marks these conventions cost on a marked paper; the total usually exceeds any single content topic.

faqs.question: What do we buy if our child came from MYP rather than IGCSE chemistry?
faqs.answer: Mole automaticity, first and cheaply. A student from MYP integrated science typically arrives with better investigation instincts, because the MYP criteria rehearse design and processing, and with lighter quantitative practice than a separate IGCSE chemistry course provides. Six to eight short sessions on moles from mass, moles from concentration and the stoichiometric ratio removes the handicap. A student arriving from IGCSE chemistry has the reverse profile and needs method design rather than arithmetic.

faqs.question: Does Higher Level chemistry need to be paired with a particular maths course?
faqs.answer: It helps, and the pairing matters most in acids and bases and in Higher Level kinetics. Logarithm handling for pH, graph interpretation for order of reaction and algebraic rearrangement throughout are mathematics skills examined inside chemistry questions. Analysis and Approaches builds them; Applications and Interpretation trims some of them in favour of statistics. A student in the second pairing is not disadvantaged conceptually and is handicapped mechanically, and a short block on logarithms and rearrangement fixes most of it.

faqs.question: What does a chemistry specialist cost monthly in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Using market figures: Bestimate estimates a weekly one-hour arrangement at AED 600 to 1,200 a month in the middle band and AED 1,000 to 2,000 or more for an examination-year specialist. An online package of eight sessions appears at about AED 799 a month, and in-home packages at AED 1,599 to 1,799 for four two-hour visits. Hourly, qualified online tutors are quoted at AED 150 to 300 and specialists at AED 200 to 450 and above. Those are others' published figures, read in October 2026.

faqs.question: Which schools near Nad Al Hamar run Diploma chemistry at Higher Level?
faqs.answer: The Dubai Festival City cluster, including Deira International School and Universal American School Dubai, and the Mirdif belt, including Uptown International School, with other eastern-suburb schools taking students to IGCSE before a Diploma or A Level split. Whether Higher Level chemistry runs in a given year can depend on cohort size, so ask the coordinator rather than assume. Schools are named here as local context only, with no affiliation, partnership or endorsement implied.

faqs.question: Our child needs chemistry for medicine. Can you guarantee the grade?
faqs.answer: No, and no honest provider can. Medicine, dentistry, pharmacy and veterinary courses commonly require chemistry, often at Higher Level and sometimes at a stated grade, but entry requirements are published course by course and university by university and vary more than general advice implies. Read the chemistry line on the exact course page. What we can offer is work on the components where marks are currently being lost. Nobody should promise you a particular grade or a university place, and an offer to do either is not worth considering.

faqs.question: How often should chemistry sessions run in the final term?
faqs.answer: Twice a week in short sessions if the problem is calculation accuracy, because that is habit work and frequency beats depth. Once a week at ninety minutes if the problem is structure determination or extended-response technique, where a full set of questions plus a proper review needs a longer sitting. Beyond two sessions a week the limiting factor becomes the student's own practice time across six subjects, and additional taught hours start displacing the consolidation they depend on.

faqs.question: Will you check our write-up before it goes to the teacher?
faqs.answer: We will read your child's own draft and ask questions about it: why this range, what justifies that number of repeats, where does this uncertainty come from, does the conclusion follow from the processing, is this section at the level you are claiming. We will not write, rewrite or edit any part of it, process the data, design the method or choose the question. If your child cannot explain every line of the write-up to their teacher without hesitation, the help went too far and that is their exposure, not ours.

faqs.question: Can a chemistry tutor also cover biology or physics for the same child?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, and the overlap is real in specific places: uncertainty handling and graph work transfer across all three sciences, and the mathematics inside physics and chemistry is largely the same mathematics. What does not transfer is Higher Level content. A tutor claiming Higher Level depth in chemistry, physics and biology at once is claiming three specialisms. For a student whose problem is a single weak subject, one specialist beats one generalist; for a student whose problem is processing data, one tutor across the sciences can work well.

dubai/ib-chemistry-tutor-in-nad-al-sheba.tutorsIntro: These tutors teach IB Chemistry at Higher and Standard Level to students across Dubai's central corridor. Each works to the current Structure and Reactivity syllabus rather than the previous topic-numbered one, and will ask which theme the school is on and which paper the last marks were lost on before teaching anything.

intro.heading: Chemistry marks are lost in specific places, and they are nameable
paragraphs: Chemistry is the Diploma science where a student can understand the material well and still score two grades below their ability, because the subject punishes imprecision more than it punishes ignorance. A sign the wrong way round in an enthalpy calculation. A state symbol missing from an ionic equation. An explanation of a trend that describes the trend instead of explaining it. A mechanism drawn correctly with an arrow starting from the wrong place. Each of those costs one or two marks, and a paper contains a dozen opportunities for them.

That is why this page is written from the syllabus outward. Rather than describing what a chemistry tutor does in general, it sets out the specific places where marks go missing in the current Structure and Reactivity course, what the mark scheme is actually looking for in each case, what the data booklet supplies and what has to be in the student's head, and how to use the limited stock of past papers that exist for a syllabus with only a few sittings behind it.

Nad Al Sheba sits in a dense school corridor. Repton School Dubai, Kings' School Nad Al Sheba and GEMS Modern Academy are inside the district; Hartland International School and North London Collegiate School Dubai are in Sobha Hartland; Swiss International Scientific School Dubai is at Al Jaddaf. Dubai held 387,441 private-school students across 227 schools in 2024-25, with the IB at around 7% of enrolment among seventeen licensed curricula. Chemistry Higher Level is one of the more popular Diploma sciences, which means class sizes are reasonable and individual attention on mechanism detail is still scarce.

A syllabus note that matters for tutoring. The course was restructured into two organising themes, Structure and Reactivity, replacing the older numbered-topic and options arrangement, and Higher Level extension content is examined inside those themes alongside the core rather than in a separate paper. A tutor still teaching from the old structure will cover the right chemistry in the wrong order and will leave a Higher Level student thinking the extension material is a later problem. It is not: it appears in the same questions.

IB Gram delivers tuition to UAE families as one-to-one lessons over live video, and does not send tutors to addresses in the UAE; home visits are a service we run only in India. Chemistry gains something specific from that format. Mechanisms, lattice diagrams, titration curves and energy profiles are drawings, and a shared screen keeps the student's own drawing, the examiner's wording and a corrected version side by side without anything being redrawn or passed across a table.

One instruction worth following before any of it. Bring the most recent marked piece of written chemistry — a topic test, a mock paper, a returned equation question — rather than a report card. A grade says how large the gap is; the annotations say whether the student is losing marks to content they never met, to wording the scheme does not accept, or to running out of minutes on the back page of Paper 2. In chemistry the second of those is by far the most common, and it is also the cheapest to fix.

programmes.name: MYP Sciences

The chemistry-relevant warning sign is a student who scores well on knowing and understanding and poorly on communicating: chemistry marks turn on precise written explanation more than any other science, and a student who can do the chemistry but writes loosely will lose marks from DP1 onwards.
programmes.countryNote: In several schools around Nad Al Sheba, MYP runs straight into the Diploma, so the school controls pacing and the transition is invisible from outside. programmes.name: IGCSE Chemistry as the alternative route
programmes.description: Cambridge 0620 or Pearson 4CH1 depending on the school. Students arriving in DP1 from IGCSE chemistry have met bonding, the mole and basic organic chemistry, and have been trained to give more detail than an IB mark scheme awards. They also arrive with no exposure to the sign conventions in energetics, which is the first real trap of DP1.
programmes.countryNote: Students in this corridor arrive in Diploma chemistry from both IGCSE and MYP, often in the same class. The two groups fail differently: IGCSE students over-write and over-rely on remembered phrases, MYP students under-specify. A tutor should ask which route the student came by in the first session, because the correction runs in opposite directions.

programmes.name: IB Chemistry, Diploma Programme

Reactivity covers what drives reactions, how much and how fast and how far, and the mechanisms of chemical change. Paper 1 carries 36%, Paper 2 carries 44% and the investigation carries 20%. Standard Level runs 150 teaching hours, Higher Level 240.

No specific IB date appears on this page; confirm each with your school's IB coordinator or on ibo.org.

That makes chemistry the Diploma subject where a one-grade shortfall most often changes an outcome, and it is why families in this corridor treat it with more urgency than they treat other subjects.

dubai/ib-chemistry-tutor-in-nad-al-sheba.subjectsIntro: Chemistry is one subject with two themes and a short list of places where marks reliably disappear. Below are the syllabus areas Nad Al Sheba students bring, each described by the trap rather than by the content list.

subjects.name: Structure 1: Models of the particulate nature of matter
subjects.levels: HL and SL, HL extension included
subjects.description: The mole, concentration, gas behaviour and the ideal gas equation, plus atomic structure and electron configuration. The trap is unit handling: a concentration in grams per cubic decimetre fed into a calculation expecting moles produces a confident wrong answer that the method marks cannot rescue.

subjects.name: Structure 2: Models of bonding and structure
subjects.levels: HL and SL, HL extension included
subjects.description: Ionic, covalent and metallic bonding, intermolecular forces, shapes of molecules and at Higher Level formal charge and hybridisation. Students lose marks by naming a force rather than explaining its strength relative to another, which is almost always what the question asked for.

subjects.name: Structure 3: Classification of matter
subjects.levels: HL and SL, HL extension included
subjects.description: The periodic table, periodicity, trends, and organic and inorganic classification. Trend questions are where description substitutes for explanation most often: stating that atomic radius decreases across a period scores nothing without the nuclear charge and shielding reasoning behind it.

subjects.name: Reactivity 1: What drives chemical reactions?
subjects.levels: HL and SL, HL extension included
subjects.description: Enthalpy, Hess cycles, bond enthalpies, entropy and Gibbs free energy at Higher Level. The sign convention is the single most expensive trap in the course: exothermic negative, bond breaking endothermic, and a Hess cycle traversed the wrong way producing an answer correct in magnitude and wrong in sign.

subjects.name: Reactivity 2: How much, how fast and how far?
subjects.levels: HL and SL, HL extension included
subjects.description: Reaction rates, collision theory, equilibrium, the equilibrium constant and at Higher Level rate laws and the Arrhenius relationship. Le Chatelier questions reward naming which way the position shifts and why in terms of the system's response, not merely restating the stress applied.

subjects.name: Reactivity 3: Mechanisms of chemical change
subjects.levels: HL and SL, HL extension included
subjects.description: Proton transfer, acids and bases, electron transfer and redox, electrochemical cells, and organic mechanisms. Mechanism marks are awarded for curly arrows starting from the correct electron source and ending at the correct destination, so a correct product drawn with sloppy arrows scores partially at best.

subjects.name: Organic chemistry
subjects.levels: HL and SL, substantially extended at HL
subjects.description: Functional groups, nomenclature, reaction pathways, and at Higher Level nucleophilic substitution routes, elimination and stereochemistry. Conditions and reagents carry marks: a correct transformation without the reagent and condition named is an incomplete answer, and students routinely learn the pathway and not the conditions.

subjects.name: Acids, bases and pH calculations
subjects.levels: HL and SL, HL extension included
subjects.description: Strong and weak behaviour, pH and pKa, buffers and titration curves at Higher Level. The common loss is treating a weak acid as fully dissociated, and the second is reading a titration curve without identifying the half-equivalence point, which is where the pKa is read from.

subjects.name: Redox and electrochemistry
subjects.levels: HL and SL, HL extension included
subjects.description: Oxidation states, half-equations, voltaic and electrolytic cells and at Higher Level electrode potentials and the Nernst-style reasoning. Half-equations must balance for charge as well as atoms, and most lost marks here are charge imbalance rather than conceptual error.

subjects.name: The data-based section of Paper 1
subjects.description: Experimental data, graphs, uncertainty and evaluation of method, structurally predictable and under-practised in most schools. Uncertainty propagation and reading a gradient with error are mechanical once taught, which makes this the best return on tutoring time in the subject.

subjects.name: The scientific investigation
subjects.description: An individual experimental or data-based investigation marked on four criteria over 24 marks with a 3,000-word limit. In chemistry the recurring weakness is a research question that cannot be answered by the method chosen, which is a design fault no amount of good data collection repairs.

subjects.name: Spectroscopy and instrumental analysis
subjects.levels: HL and SL, extended at HL
subjects.description: Infrared, mass spectrometry and proton nuclear magnetic resonance used together to deduce a structure. The data booklet supplies the reference values, so the examined skill is interpretation and combination rather than recall — which makes it one of the most learnable mark sources in the course.

sections.heading: Structure and Reactivity: what the current syllabus actually contains
paragraphs: The course is organised into two themes rather than numbered topics with options, and understanding that shape changes how revision should be built. Structure covers three areas: models of the particulate nature of matter, models of bonding and structure, and the classification of matter. Reactivity covers three more: what drives chemical reactions, how much and how fast and how far, and the mechanisms of chemical change.

The organising idea is that reactivity is explained by structure, so questions deliberately cross between the two. A question about why one compound reacts faster than another is a Reactivity question answered with Structure content. Students who revise the six areas as six separate blocks find the papers harder than they should, because the papers were written on the assumption that the connections are the point.

Higher Level extension content sits inside these themes and is examined alongside the core, which has a scheduling consequence worth stating plainly. A Higher Level student cannot secure the core and then add the extension, because a single Paper 2 question can require both. Any revision plan that treats extension material as a separate later block is building in a failure mode, and that is still a common way for it to be taught.

For a tutoring plan the practical reading of the table below is this: find which theme the student's lost marks cluster in, then find whether the loss is content or precision. The two have different remedies, and chemistry produces far more precision losses than any other Diploma science. A student losing marks across all six areas evenly almost always has a precision problem rather than six content problems.

sections.heading: The mark-scheme traps, named one by one
paragraphs: Chemistry examiners mark to very specific wording, and the gap between an answer a teacher would accept and an answer the scheme awards is wider in this subject than in physics or biology. Most students in Nad Al Sheba lose a consistent set of marks across every paper they sit, and the set is small enough to list and drill.

The expensive ones share a feature: the chemistry is right and the expression is incomplete. An enthalpy value correct in magnitude and wrong in sign. An ionic equation without state symbols. A trend described rather than explained. A mechanism whose product is correct but whose arrows begin in the wrong place. A half-equation balanced for atoms and not for charge. None of these indicate a student who does not understand chemistry; all of them cost marks every single time.

Drilling them works because they are habits. The method is to mark the student's own written answers strictly, against the actual scheme, with the student watching, and to award nothing where the scheme awards nothing. That lands harder than any explanation. A student who has watched a correct answer score two out of four because a state symbol was missing does not omit state symbols again.

The table below is the list worth working through in the first month of any chemistry support, whatever the student's level. It takes three or four sessions and it applies to every paper they will ever sit, which makes it unusually good value compared with another pass through a theme.
