sections.heading: What Chemistry support costs a Lakes family per month, not per hour
paragraphs: Hourly rates are the wrong unit for a household budget. Families commit to a term, so the number that matters is the monthly one, and in Dubai the monthly figures are published. Bestimate's 2026 Dubai rate work puts a weekly one-hour arrangement at roughly AED 240 to 600 a month at the budget end, AED 600 to 1,200 in the middle, and AED 1,000 to 2,000 and above for specialist exam-year support. Packages advertised locally include around AED 799 a month for eight online sessions and AED 1,599 to 1,799 a month for four two-hour visiting sessions.

Read those two package figures next to each other and the travel premium is no longer abstract. Roughly twice the monthly outlay buys half the number of contacts, because a visiting tutor's drive across Emirates Living is billed inside the hour. For a subject examined on technique rather than knowledge alone, contact frequency is what moves a grade, so the arrangement that looks more premium is often the one that delivers less practice. That is the comparison a Lakes parent is actually making, and no page ranking for these searches lays it out.

The underlying hourly bands, for reference and with their sources: budget online tutoring from roughly AED 45 to 150, with EdFlik advertising from AED 45 to 65 and Tutopiya from AED 33 to 52; a qualified subject tutor online at AED 150 to 300, with Unitors publishing IGCSE from AED 150 and IB from AED 200; specialist IB or IGCSE tutoring at AED 200 to 450 and above, with TutorChase quoting around AED 270; visiting one-to-one at AED 180 to 500; and premium named tutors higher again, with BartyED publishing AED 650. Every figure here is another provider's published rate as of the October 2026 research, not an IB Gram price. sections.heading: Arabic, Islamic Education and Social Studies in the same crowded week
paragraphs: Any Chemistry schedule for a Dubai child competes with subjects that are not optional. Arabic, Islamic Education and Social or Moral Studies are mandatory in all Dubai private schools regardless of the licensed international curriculum, and KHDA's requirements were to be implemented by the start of the 2025-26 academic year, or April 2026 for schools whose year begins in April. For a Lakes family that means the school week already contains lessons that sit outside the IB or British framework, and often homework alongside them.

The rules are specific in ways parents rarely hear. KHDA requires separate classes by group: for Arabic as a first language, Islamic Education and Social Studies, schools must organise separate classes for Arabs and non-Arabs, and combined classes for both groups are prohibited because the curriculum expectations and language of instruction differ. Standard Arabic is required as the main language of instruction for Islamic Education for Arabs and for Arabic as a first language, with the school's licensed-curriculum language used for non-Arabs in Islamic Education and in Moral, Social and Cultural studies. Instructional time is calculated on a 40-minute lesson unit, schools may vary lesson length provided weekly totals are met, and lessons for any mandatory subject are advised to run at least 25 minutes.

Two consequences follow for a Chemistry plan. The first is purely practical: the week is fuller than the IB subject list suggests, so a realistic schedule accounts for Arabic homework as well as science homework. The second is about support. Schools are required to ensure that teachers of Islamic Education and Arabic hold the appropriate KHDA approval for those subjects, and for the mandatory subjects the use of any different or additional content without prior permission from the Ministry of Education is prohibited. Tutoring in those subjects therefore works differently from tutoring in Chemistry, and should be arranged with the school's guidance rather than around it.

sections.heading: Booking from The Lakes when the school run already owns your afternoon
paragraphs: The enquiry that gets answered fastest contains four things: the level, the unit where the trouble starts, the most recent paper mark, and the two evening windows that are genuinely free. The last one matters more than parents expect. Availability is the binding constraint on matching a Higher Level Chemistry specialist, and a family that can offer 6:30pm Tuesday or 7pm Thursday is far easier to place than a family that can only say 'after school'.

After that comes a free trial lesson, one per student and bookable without card details, taught by the tutor who would take the course. A good Chemistry trial does real chemistry: a question at the real level, the data booklet open, and the tutor naming the unit and the command term rather than discussing motivation. If the match is wrong, say so and ask for another. That costs nothing, and it is a better outcome than discovering it in February.

The honest caveat concerns the slots everybody wants. The 6:30pm to 8:30pm weekday band is the most contested on the platform, and there are weeks when no Higher Level Chemistry specialist is free inside it. When that happens you will be told, with a date, rather than matched to a generalist. The usual alternatives are a Friday morning or weekend slot, which for investigation work is better anyway, or a UAE-timed session with an IB Chemistry specialist based outside the UAE, delivered in the same format at the same Gulf Standard Time hour. Nobody will be sent to your address, because that is not a service offered here.

process.title: Send the level, the unit and two free evenings
process.description: Tell us Standard or Higher Level, which of the six units the trouble starts in, the last paper mark, and the two weekday windows that are genuinely free after activities. Those four details let us check real availability against your real week rather than quoting a plan that collapses in the first fortnight.

process.title: A trial lesson in a slot you would keep
process.description: One free trial per student, no card details needed, scheduled in the slot you intend to use so you can test the time as well as the tutor. Expect a genuine question at the right level with the data booklet open. A trial that avoids chemistry has told you something useful about the match.

process.title: Map the school's sequence before the plan
process.description: The tutor asks for your child's scheme of work and the school's internal deadlines, including the investigation dates, then plans backwards from them. Working on Reactivity 2 while the class is being assessed on Structure 3 produces no visible benefit, which is how families conclude tuition is not working.

process.title: Hold the slot for the term
process.description: The session is booked for the term rather than week by week, which is what makes it survive a busy fortnight. A short written note follows each session naming what was covered, what was set and what is still weak, so you can tell progress from attendance without asking your child.

process.title: Agree in advance what moves and when
process.description: Mock weeks, investigation deadlines, Ramadan and the summer all change the usable window. Deciding now whether the slot shifts earlier, moves to a Friday morning or pauses entirely means the plan bends at those points instead of breaking, and it is the main reason some arrangements last two years.

whyPoints.title: Built around the hour you actually have
whyPoints.description: Slots run from 5pm to 8:30pm in Gulf Standard Time plus Friday mornings and weekends, with no travel at either end. A session starts when your child sits down rather than when a tutor finishes a drive across Emirates Living, which is why a late weekday slot survives a full term here.

whyPoints.title: Siblings in sequence on one evening
whyPoints.description: Two children at different schools and different stages can take back-to-back sessions on the same night, with different tutors if they need different specialisms. Nothing has to be rearranged around one person's route, and a ninety-minute block can be split unevenly when one child needs maintenance rather than teaching.

whyPoints.title: Rates quoted monthly, with sources
whyPoints.description: Monthly figures are how a term is budgeted, so this page publishes monthly bands in AED with the survey or competitor that published each one, as of the October 2026 research. Three of the six strongest pages in this search publish no price at all, and two quote in US dollars.

whyPoints.title: Taught by unit, not by year group
whyPoints.description: A tutor is matched to the unit your child is stuck in, whether that is mole arithmetic in Structure 1 or organic mechanisms in Reactivity 3 at Higher Level. The relevant question is what they teach, not how far away they live, and that is the filter a distance-based search cannot apply.

whyPoints.title: The investigation stays the student's work
whyPoints.description: A tutor may teach the chemistry, explain what each criterion rewards, question a research design and give feedback on a draft the student has written. A tutor may not supply text or produce the analysis. One site competing in this search sells completed internal assessments; the risk of that sits with the candidate, not the seller.

whyPoints.title: Regulator rules explained, never claimed
whyPoints.description: KHDA's mandatory-subject requirements and the MoHRE private tuition permit are set out here with links to the government sources, because they change what a week looks like. IB Gram holds no KHDA, Ministry of Education, IB or Cambridge accreditation and claims none.

faqs.question: What time does the school day end for children living in The Lakes?
faqs.answer: Most secondary schools in and around Emirates Living finish the academic day between 2:30pm and 3:30pm. A child at a school inside the community is usually home by about 3:15pm; a child commuting back from Al Barsha or Al Sufouh lands closer to four because the return drive coincides with the afternoon peak. Co-curricular activities then run to roughly five on the days they are scheduled. Confirm the exact bell time with your own school, because it differs by campus and by year group, and it is the single number that decides which tuition slot will survive the term.

faqs.question: Can a Chemistry session fit between the school run and dinner?
faqs.answer: It can, but it is the slot most likely to be cancelled. The window from five to six-thirty holds the second school run, dinner and set homework, and it is also when a teenager is least able to absorb new material. Families in The Lakes get better results from a 6:30pm to 8:30pm weekday slot, a Friday morning when many Dubai schools finish early, or a weekend morning booked as a standing appointment. Because lessons are delivered over live video there is no travel at either end, so a later start costs nothing in logistics.

faqs.question: Which schools near The Lakes actually teach IB Chemistry?
faqs.answer: Within a few minutes, Emirates International School Meadows runs the IB continuum through to the Diploma and Dubai International Academy Emirates Hills runs the Diploma, so DP Chemistry is taught at both. Regent International School and Dubai British School Emirates Hills follow the British route, where chemistry is examined at IGCSE and then A Level. Fifteen to twenty minutes east the Al Barsha cluster adds further options. Schools are named here as neighbourhood context only; check current programme availability with the school and the published record with KHDA, which oversees private education quality in Dubai.

faqs.question: How is the IB Chemistry course divided between Structure and Reactivity?
faqs.answer: There are six units. Structure 1 covers models of the particulate nature of matter, including the nuclear atom, electron configuration, the mole and ideal gases. Structure 2 covers models of bonding and structure. Structure 3 covers classification, meaning the periodic table and organic functional groups. Reactivity 1 covers what drives reactions, through enthalpy and energy cycles. Reactivity 2 covers how much, how fast and how far, where equilibrium sits. Reactivity 3 covers mechanisms, organised by electron behaviour. Higher Level adds roughly seventy taught hours inside those same six units rather than a seventh unit.

faqs.question: Is organic chemistry genuinely the hardest part of the IB course?
faqs.answer: For most students it is the part where the kind of thinking changes, which is not quite the same thing. Reactivity 3 asks a student to draw and justify a mechanism rather than recall a fact, and at Higher Level the range of electron-pair chemistry widens considerably. Students who have coasted on memory until that point find it abrupt. The predictable remedy is to learn the organising logic, which is electron behaviour, rather than a list of named reactions. Structure 1 mole work is the quieter risk, because it feels straightforward and therefore goes unpractised for two years.

faqs.question: What is in the Chemistry data booklet, and what does my child still have to memorise?
faqs.answer: A data booklet is available in both written papers. It carries the periodic table, constants, standard relationships and reference values, so those need recognition speed rather than recall. What it does not carry is judgement: definitions, mechanisms, the reasoning that links structure to a property, and the answer structure a command term demands. Revision should split into those two piles. Students who try to memorise everything waste weeks, and students who assume the booklet will carry them cannot start Paper 2. Practising lookup speed against a timed past paper is the fix.

faqs.question: What does Chemistry tutoring cost per month for a family in The Lakes?
faqs.answer: Published Dubai figures for a weekly one-hour arrangement run roughly AED 240 to 600 a month at the budget end, AED 600 to 1,200 mid-range, and AED 1,000 to 2,000 and above for specialist exam-year support, per Bestimate's 2026 rate work. Advertised packages include around AED 799 a month for eight online sessions against AED 1,599 to 1,799 for four two-hour visiting sessions. Those are other providers' published figures as of the October 2026 research, not IB Gram prices. Compare the two packages and you can see what travel costs: double the money, half the contacts.

faqs.question: My child takes Chemistry and Physics at Higher Level. Can both fit into one week?
faqs.answer: Yes, provided they are separated by day rather than by week. Alternating weeks halves contact frequency in both subjects at exactly the point when frequency is what builds exam technique. A workable pattern from The Lakes is Chemistry on one weekday evening, Physics on another, and longer investigation or revision work on a Friday morning when many Dubai schools finish early. Because there is no travel involved, two separate specialists can be used rather than one tutor stretched across both subjects, which is usually the better outcome at Higher Level.

faqs.question: Do Chemistry sessions move during Ramadan?
faqs.answer: Usually, because school hours shorten across the UAE during Ramadan and the shape of the day changes at home as well. Two patterns work. The first moves the session earlier, into the gap created by the shorter school day, which suits younger students and anyone fasting. The second moves it to a post-Iftar slot, which suits DP2 students who prefer a late, quiet hour. The useful thing is to decide which before Ramadan begins rather than during it, and to hold the alternative slot in advance so the weekly rhythm is not lost for a month.

faqs.question: Can two children in the same Lakes household use the same evening?
faqs.answer: They can, and sequential slots on one evening are the most common arrangement in this neighbourhood. Nobody is travelling between the two sessions, so a 6:30pm and a 7:45pm can sit back to back without a gap for a drive. The two children can have different tutors if they are at different stages, which is often better than one tutor covering both. A ninety-minute block can also be split unevenly, with the longer part going to whichever child is closer to an assessment that term.

faqs.question: How different is Higher Level from Standard Level inside the same unit?
faqs.answer: The difference is depth and quantity inside the same six units rather than extra topics at the end. Higher Level runs 180 taught hours against 110, and the additional material is folded in: entropy and spontaneity extend Reactivity 1, equilibrium and rate analysis go further in Reactivity 2, and organic and electron-pair chemistry widen in Reactivity 3. The weightings are identical, with Paper 1 at 36%, Paper 2 at 44% and the investigation at 20%, but Higher Level papers are longer, so stamina and pacing become genuine variables rather than afterthoughts.

faqs.question: When in DP1 should Chemistry support start for the best value?
faqs.answer: October of DP1 is the point at which support is cheapest in total hours, because the first assessed work has been returned and the gaps are visible while the course is still short. Families who wait until January of DP2, after mock results, are buying the same outcome under time pressure and usually need a higher session frequency to get there. The other high-value entry point is the fortnight before the investigation topic is chosen, since a controllable research question is worth more marks than any amount of polishing later.

faqs.question: Does the mandatory Arabic requirement affect how we schedule Chemistry?
faqs.answer: Indirectly, yes, because it makes the school week fuller than the subject list implies. Arabic, Islamic Education and Social or Moral Studies are mandatory in all Dubai private schools whatever the licensed curriculum, with instructional time calculated on a 40-minute lesson unit and separate classes required for Arab and non-Arab groups. That brings homework alongside the IB or British workload. Account for it when choosing a Chemistry slot, and arrange any Arabic or Islamic Education support with the school's guidance, since content for those subjects is tightly specified.

faqs.question: How late can we move a weekday Chemistry session if an activity overruns?
faqs.answer: Within reason, a same-day shift of thirty to sixty minutes is straightforward because no one is travelling to you. The practical limit is the tutor's own evening and your child's capacity to think after a long day; past about nine in the evening a session stops being productive regardless of goodwill. The more durable fix is to place the standing slot late enough that fixtures do not reach it, which in The Lakes usually means starting at 6:30pm or later, and to keep a Friday morning in reserve for the weeks when the evening is lost entirely.

dubai/ib-chemistry-tutor-in-the-lakes.closingHeading: Pick the hour first, then the tutor
dubai/ib-chemistry-tutor-in-the-lakes.closingBody: Most Chemistry plans in this neighbourhood fail on scheduling rather than on teaching, so settle the hour before anything else. Look at your actual week, find the two evenings that survive activities and the second school run, and treat those as the constraint. A tutor who does not have to drive anywhere can meet them, hold them for a term, and move by half an hour on the day a fixture overruns. Send us the level, the unit your child is stuck in and those two windows, and the trial lesson can be booked into the slot you intend to keep rather than into whatever happens to be free.

intro.heading: The rate is the small decision; the sequence is the large one
paragraphs: Two Diploma families in The Meadows can spend the same amount on chemistry across two years and end up two grades apart. The difference is almost never the hourly rate. It is when the money was spent, on which component, and whether anybody checked first where the marks were actually being lost. A family that spends AED 250 an hour from the autumn of Year 12, aimed at the quantitative spine and the investigation, gets considerably more than a family that spends AED 450 an hour from January of Year 13 on whatever topic the student mentions.

Chemistry has a specific cost structure that makes this worse than in other subjects. The course is built on a quantitative spine, the mole and everything that follows from it, which runs through almost every topic. A student shaky on that spine loses marks that look like energetics marks, equilibrium marks or organic marks, and a tutor who treats each of those as a separate content problem will teach three topics and fix none of them. That is how twelve weeks of competent teaching produces no movement at all, and it is the single most expensive pattern in this subject.

There is also a component that behaves differently from everything else. The scientific investigation carries twenty per cent of the final grade, is marked out of twenty-four across four criteria, and is produced over months outside lesson time. Those are the cheapest marks in the course per hour of effort, because they can be earned calmly with a deadline and a plan rather than under examination conditions. They are also the marks most often left to chance while a family pays for weekly content sessions, which is the second most expensive pattern.

So this page is a pricing page rather than a prospectus. It carries the published Dubai market rates with the provider and date attached to each one, a straight answer on what the in-home travel premium buys, a term-by-term profile of when chemistry spending is worth most, the three ways the money goes nowhere, the Higher Level content load priced in hours rather than adjectives, and a short list of things a parent should decline to pay for at any rate.

IB Gram delivers chemistry support as one-to-one live video tuition on Gulf Standard Time. We do not send tutors to addresses in The Meadows or anywhere in the UAE, because in-home visiting is a service our India operation runs; the in-home figures quoted below belong to other providers in this market. Removing the drive is also a cost decision: at Higher Level chemistry the specialist pool is narrow everywhere, and a family that insists on a tutor who will drive to Emirates Living is choosing from the subset willing to spend an hour in traffic, then paying for that hour in the rate.

dubai/ib-chemistry-tutor-in-the-meadows.programmesIntro: Chemistry appears under different names and different assessment rules along the route through a Dubai international school, and the cost of support changes sharply between them. These are the four stages behind enquiries from Emirates Living.

programmes.name: IB Middle Years Programme sciences
programmes.description: Criterion-assessed science in which chemistry content is distributed rather than taught as a standalone subject in most schools. The criteria reward investigation skills and communication, which is valuable, and do not specifically test the arithmetic fluency that the Diploma's quantitative spine assumes. A comfortable MYP science profile is therefore a weak predictor of Diploma chemistry performance.
programmes.countryNote: Emirates International School Meadows and Dubai International Academy Emirates Hills both run MYP. For a family here the cheapest useful purchase at this stage is a short diagnostic on arithmetic and proportional reasoning in Year 10 or 11, which nobody buys because the criterion scores look fine and nothing appears to be wrong.

programmes.name: IB Diploma Programme Chemistry
programmes.description: Six topics across two organising themes, Structure and Reactivity, assessed by two written papers worth eighty per cent between them plus an internally assessed scientific investigation worth twenty. A data booklet is provided in the examinations, which changes what is worth memorising and what is worth practising. Higher Level sits longer papers with additional content in each topic.
programmes.countryNote: The IB carried 7 per cent of Dubai private-school enrolment in 2024-25, with three further IB schools in the emirate's 2026-27 intake. Higher Level chemistry specialists are among the narrowest supply in this market, and that scarcity rather than any local cost of living is what sits behind the upper rate bands quoted in Dubai.

programmes.name: IGCSE and International GCSE Chemistry
programmes.description: Cambridge 0620 with a separate practical or alternative-to-practical paper, or Pearson 4CH1 which assesses practical skills inside the written papers. The usual feeder into Diploma chemistry locally, and the stage at which moles, electrolysis and organic nomenclature either become secure or stay permanently approximate.
programmes.countryNote: Most schools serving The Meadows run IGCSE rather than MYP, so the majority of local Diploma chemistry students arrive from 0620 or 4CH1. A grade 8 earned on scaffolded questions is a weaker signal than parents expect: the Diploma asks the same chemistry in unfamiliar contexts, and that is a different skill.

programmes.name: A Level Chemistry
programmes.description: The alternative post-16 route in the British-curriculum schools nearby, with no internally assessed component carrying a fifth of the grade and a practical endorsement assessed separately. Students choosing between it and Diploma chemistry are choosing between three subjects in depth and six subjects plus an independent research component.
programmes.countryNote: Families in this neighbourhood frequently hold the decision open into Year 11, and the cost consequence is worth naming: the Diploma route adds an independent investigation that needs scheduled support, while the A Level route concentrates the spend into examination technique. Neither is cheaper overall; they are expensive in different terms.

dubai/ib-chemistry-tutor-in-the-meadows.subjectsIntro: Chemistry is set out by the topics in the current guide, because the organising structure determines where support is needed and a tutor who cannot name it has not read the course. The subjects after it share a Diploma week with chemistry and sometimes a tutor.

subjects.name: Structure 1: Models of the particulate nature of matter
subjects.description: The mole, atomic structure, electron configuration and quantum ideas, with Higher Level extensions. This is where the quantitative spine of the whole course begins, and a weakness here reappears as a lost mark in energetics or equilibrium two terms later. The cheapest topic in the course to fix and the most expensive to leave alone.

subjects.name: Structure 2: Models of bonding and structure
subjects.description: Ionic, covalent and metallic bonding, intermolecular forces and structure-property relationships, with Higher Level work on formal charge and molecular orbital ideas. Students lose marks explaining properties qualitatively where the question wants a specific interaction named and its relative strength justified.

subjects.name: Structure 3: Classification of matter
subjects.description: The periodic table, periodicity, and the introduction to organic classification and spectroscopic identification. The organic nomenclature taught here is assumed for the rest of the course, and students who never fully secured it pay for that in Reactivity 3 at a higher rate per mark.

subjects.name: Reactivity 1: What drives chemical reactions
subjects.description: Energetics and thermodynamics, enthalpy cycles, entropy and spontaneity at Higher Level. Calculation-heavy and unforgiving about sign conventions and state symbols. Most of the lost marks here are arithmetic and presentation rather than conceptual, which makes them cheap to recover with marked practice.

subjects.name: Reactivity 2: How much, how fast and how far
subjects.description: Reaction kinetics, equilibrium and acid-base behaviour, with Higher Level work on rate laws, equilibrium constants and buffer calculations. The topic where the quantitative spine is tested hardest, and where a student who cannot handle logarithms confidently loses marks that look like chemistry marks.

subjects.name: Reactivity 3: What are the mechanisms of chemical change
subjects.description: Redox, electrochemistry and organic reaction mechanisms, with substantial Higher Level extensions. This is the part of the course where a genuine specialist is worth paying a premium for, because mechanism work rewards pattern recognition built over hundreds of examples rather than explanation.

subjects.name: Biology HL and SL
subjects.description: Shares the investigation structure and the data-analysis skills, so one tutor can cover both internal assessments competently. Content overlap is limited to biochemistry and metabolism, so the saving is real for the coursework component and modest for the written papers.

subjects.name: Physics HL and SL
subjects.description: Shares the quantitative discipline, unit handling and graph interpretation that chemistry's calculation topics depend on. A student losing marks in both subjects is often losing them for one reason, which is a case where a shared tutor saves money rather than splitting attention.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches
subjects.description: The subject that underwrites chemistry's calculation topics: logarithms for pH and rate laws, proportional reasoning throughout, and algebraic rearrangement in equilibrium work. A short maths block is frequently the cheapest route to a chemistry grade, and almost nobody buys it as such.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation
subjects.description: Workable alongside chemistry, with the caveat that the logarithmic and algebraic fluency Higher Level chemistry assumes is developed more directly in Analysis and Approaches. Students on this combination often need a targeted algebra block in the first term of Year 12.

subjects.name: The Extended Essay in chemistry
subjects.description: A 4,000-word independent research essay supervised by the school. Chemistry is a demanding choice because a question that can be investigated with available equipment and still reach the higher bands is hard to frame. A tutor's role is process coaching and feedback on the student's own drafts, never research or writing.

subjects.name: Theory of Knowledge
subjects.description: Assessed by exhibition and essay, with the natural sciences as one of the areas of knowledge. Support means explaining how the assessment works and responding to the student's own argument. It is also an hours cost that competes with the chemistry investigation in the same term.

sections.heading: What the travel premium actually buys in Emirates Living
paragraphs: Begin with the part of the Dubai rate card that confuses parents most: why an in-home chemistry hour costs more than an online one when the teaching inside it is identical. The published bands make the gap plain. In-home one-to-one visits including travel are quoted at AED 180 to 500, on Bestimate's Tutoring Cost Dubai 2026 band of AED 180 to 350 plus independent home tutors at AED 200 to 500, while a qualified online subject tutor sits at AED 150 to 300, with Unitors publishing IB from AED 200. The difference is not better chemistry. It is the tutor's travel time, priced into the hour because they cannot sell it to anybody else.

There is a second, larger thing the premium buys, and it buys it in the wrong direction. A tutor willing to drive to Meadows 7 at half past four is selected from the subset of specialists prepared to spend an hour in traffic for a sixty-minute lesson. At Higher Level chemistry, where the specialist pool is narrow in any city, that filter removes most of the people you actually want. So the in-home premium is a payment for a smaller choice of tutor, which is the opposite of what a parent paying a premium expects to receive.

The rest of the market, for completeness and with every figure attributed. Budget online tutoring runs AED 45 to 150, with EdFlik publishing AED 45 to 65 and Tutopiya from AED 33 to 52. IB, IGCSE and A Level specialists are quoted at AED 200 to 450 and above, with TutorChase at AED 270. Premium named tutors go higher, with BartyED published at AED 650. Monthly packages in circulation include AED 799 for eight online sessions and AED 1,599 to 1,799 for four two-hour in-home sessions, and Bestimate's monthly estimates for a weekly hour run AED 240 to 600 at the budget end, AED 600 to 1,200 mid-range and AED 1,000 to 2,000 or more for specialist exam-year support. All were read from the named provider's own published material in October 2026. None is an IB Gram price; we publish a free trial lesson and a consultation instead of a rate card.

sections.heading: The two-year spend profile: when a dirham buys the most
paragraphs: Chemistry spending has a value curve across the Diploma, and almost all of the money in this neighbourhood is spent on the wrong part of it. In the autumn of Year 12 the content is being taught in class, the quantitative spine can still be rebuilt cheaply, and the investigation has not yet become urgent. An hour bought here does three useful things at once. In January of Year 13 the content is delivered, the spine problem is two years old, the investigation is either finished or a crisis, and an hour can only do one thing: exam technique.

The rate card runs in the opposite direction to that curve. Demand across Dubai peaks in the second term of the final year, which is when specialists are most booked and families least able to negotiate. So the expensive hours are being bought at the point when each one is worth least, and the cheap hours are available at the point when each one is worth most. Nothing about that is anybody's fault; it is simply what happens when spending is triggered by a report rather than by a plan.

The table below sets out the profile term by term, with what the course is doing, what a dirham buys at that point, and the typical commitment. It is written to be used against your own calendar: find the term your child is in now, and compare what you are spending against what that term can actually deliver. Where the answer is that the term cannot deliver what you want, the honest move is usually to spend less now and reallocate rather than to spend more on an hour that cannot do the job.

sections.heading: Three chemistry-specific ways the money disappears
paragraphs: The first is paying for topics when the problem is the spine. Chemistry is built on the mole and everything that follows from it, and that reasoning runs through energetics, kinetics, equilibrium, acid-base work and electrochemistry. A student weak on proportional reasoning and unit handling loses marks in all of those, and each loss looks like a separate topic failure. Pay for three topics in sequence and you will have taught three topics and fixed nothing, at full specialist rates, over a full term. A two-session diagnostic aimed only at the spine costs a fraction of that and answers the question.

The second is paying for mechanism teaching when the gap is recall. Students who cannot follow organic mechanisms frequently cannot name the compounds or remember what a reagent does, and no amount of mechanism explanation fixes a nomenclature gap. The cheap version of this intervention is a fortnight of daily self-testing on nomenclature and reagents, which costs nothing, followed by mechanism practice at volume. The expensive version is twelve weeks of a specialist patiently explaining mechanisms to a student who is guessing at the starting material.

The third is paying weekly for content while twenty per cent of the grade sits untouched. The scientific investigation is worth twenty-four marks and is produced over months outside lessons, with a handful of school checkpoints. It is the only component where marks can be accumulated calmly. Families nonetheless buy a weekly content hour from November and reach the school's internal deadline with no research question, at which point the cheapest marks in the course have become the most expensive. Ask where the investigation stands before agreeing any weekly arrangement.

sections.heading: The quantitative spine, and why it multiplies every other cost
paragraphs: The spine is short to describe and expensive to ignore. It is the mole and its consequences: converting between mass, moles and concentration; reasoning proportionally through a balanced equation; handling limiting reagents and percentage yield; carrying units correctly through a multi-step calculation; and, by Higher Level, using logarithms confidently for pH, rate laws and equilibrium constants. None of it is advanced mathematics. All of it has to be automatic, because in a Paper 2 question it is the first two lines of a six-mark answer rather than the question itself.

When it is not automatic, the symptoms appear everywhere except where the cause is. A student who hesitates on concentration loses marks on a titration calculation in Reactivity 2, misreads an enthalpy cycle in Reactivity 1 because the amounts were wrong, and cannot complete an electrochemistry calculation in Reactivity 3. A parent looking at three poor topic test scores reasonably concludes there are three problems. A tutor paid by the hour to address topics will address three. The cost of that misdiagnosis is a full term at specialist rates.

The diagnostic is cheap and quick: timed calculation sets, marked for accuracy and presentation rather than discussed, across moles, concentration, unit handling and logarithms. Two sessions is usually enough to establish whether the losses share a root. If they do, the fix is short daily practice on the spine, marked twice a week, which a student can largely run alone once the routine is set. Sometimes the honest recommendation is a block of maths rather than chemistry, which is cheaper, and a chemistry tutor who says so is worth listening to on everything else.

sections.heading: Higher Level against Standard Level, priced in hours
paragraphs: The component weightings are identical at both levels: Paper 1 carries thirty-six per cent, Paper 2 carries forty-four, and the scientific investigation carries twenty. What differs is the content inside each topic and the length of the papers, and the honest way to express that difference to a parent is in hours rather than adjectives. Higher Level adds material in every one of the six topics, with the heaviest additions in thermodynamics, rate laws and equilibrium, and in organic mechanisms and electrochemistry.

In practice that means a Higher Level student needs more consolidation hours per topic, more calculation practice to keep the spine fluent against harder arithmetic, and a longer run-up on the mechanism work. It does not mean the investigation costs more: the criteria and the twenty-four marks are the same at both levels, which is one of the few genuine economies in the course. Nor does it mean Higher Level papers need a different kind of technique; they need the same technique applied to longer papers under more time pressure.

The table below sets the comparison out so you can plan hours rather than guess at them. The planning use is straightforward: if your child is at Higher Level and the arrangement is a single weekly hour starting in January, the arithmetic says the hours are insufficient for the content and the only sensible allocation is exam technique plus whatever the investigation still needs. Knowing that in advance is better than discovering it in April, and it may point towards a conversation with the school about level rather than towards buying more hours.

sections.heading: The investigation: twenty-four marks at the lowest cost per mark
paragraphs: Of all the marks in Diploma chemistry, the twenty-four in the scientific investigation are the ones most reliably earned per hour of work, because they are earned with a deadline and a plan rather than under examination conditions. They are marked against four criteria carrying six marks each: research design, data analysis, conclusion and evaluation. Twenty per cent of the final grade is settled before the student sits a single paper, which is a considerable commercial advantage to a family that treats it deliberately.

The spending pattern that captures those marks is clinics rather than weekly sessions. Place the school's internal deadline on a calendar, then four milestones backwards from it: research question agreed, data collected, analysis complete, full draft written. A session at each milestone, three to five in total, is both cheaper and more effective than a weekly hour running alongside, because the failure in this component is almost never understanding. It is that the work has no timetabled slot and therefore loses every scheduling contest it enters.

Where students typically misallocate their own hours is also worth knowing, because it tells a parent what the clinics should cover. Research design is underspent, and a vague research question caps the whole investigation regardless of what follows. Data collection is overspent, usually at the expense of uncertainty treatment within data analysis. Conclusion is often written in the final hour. Evaluation is the most underspent criterion of the four and the easiest to earn marks on with careful, specific writing about limitations and realistic improvements.

sections.heading: Organic mechanisms: the one place the premium is defensible
paragraphs: Most of the rate differences in this market are about travel, scarcity or reputation rather than teaching. There is one part of Diploma chemistry where paying for a genuine specialist is defensible on teaching grounds, and that is organic mechanism work, with electrochemistry close behind. Mechanisms are not understood and then applied. They are recognised, which means the skill is built by working through a large number of examples with immediate correction until the patterns are automatic, and a tutor who has done that with many cohorts moves faster than one who has not.

The qualification on that is the recall problem described earlier. Before paying a premium for mechanism teaching, check that your child can name the compounds, draw the functional groups accurately and say what each common reagent does. If they cannot, the mechanism sessions will be spent on nomenclature at mechanism prices. A fortnight of free self-testing first changes what the paid hours are able to do, and any tutor worth their rate will tell you to do it rather than start billing immediately.

The practical shape of a mechanism block is short and closed: four to eight sessions, built on volume of worked examples with marking, with a stated finish and a self-testing routine the student can run alone afterwards. Open-ended weekly mechanism teaching at specialist rates is where a chemistry bill quietly reaches five figures across a final year. Ask for the session count and the end point before the block starts, and ask what the student will be able to do alone when it finishes.

sections.heading: What to decline to pay for, at any rate
paragraphs: A short list, each item of which is sold to UAE families somewhere in this search. Decline to pay for a promised grade. No tutor can guarantee a 7, a grade improvement or a university place, and a provider offering one is either not serious or not honest. Decline to pay for examiner status that cannot be evidenced: being described as an IB or Cambridge examiner is a specific, checkable claim, and it should not be used to imply any access to marking, grade boundaries or paper content.

Decline to pay for syllabus documents, past papers, mark schemes or subject guides supplied as downloads. Those materials belong to the IB, Cambridge and Pearson, and reproducing or distributing them is copyright infringement; a legitimate tutor references them and links to the official source. Decline to pay for completed assessed work of any kind. At least one site ranking for these searches sells completed internal assessments to UAE families, at a price higher than months of legitimate tutoring. Submitted work that is not the student's own is a malpractice matter, and the consequence falls on the student's qualification rather than on the seller.

Decline, too, to pay for statistics without a basis. A satisfaction percentage, an average score, a star rating or a number of students served should come with a count, a date and a method, and most of the figures circulating in this market come with none of the three. On price itself, ask one plain question before paying anything: is the figure per hour or per lesson, and does it include VAT? Any provider should answer that in a sentence about their own pricing. We do not state the UAE VAT treatment of tuition fees on this page, because that requires a Federal Tax Authority citation we are not in a position to give.

sections.heading: Paying a tutor properly in Dubai, and what to ask for
paragraphs: Private tuition in the UAE runs on a permit, and the detail is worth holding because it makes an awkward question ordinary. The MoHRE private tuition work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023 and is granted free of charge for two years. Eligible applicants include teachers registered in government or private schools, employees in the government and private sectors, unemployed individuals, university students and school students aged 15 to 18. MoHRE's own service listing is Issuance of a New Work Permit - Private Tutor Licensing, with no fee and a stated two working days, applied for through its smart app, website and e-services system.

Individuals offering private tutoring without a permit are subject to fines and penalties outlined in the applicable laws. No fine schedule has been published: Khaleej Times reported that the ministry did not specify the fine amounts or detail the penalties, so any figure circulating in a parents' group should be treated as rumour rather than repeated. A related rule matters for the arrangement families most want: ADEK's professional-ethics rules bar Abu Dhabi private and charter school staff from paid private tuition of students enrolled at their own school, and the permit's code of conduct also bars serving students affiliated with the permit holder's own school. Treat that as press-reported and verify against the current policy document.

On the paperwork side, three things are reasonable to ask for and rarely refused. An invoice stating the number of sessions, the rate, the period covered and whether the figure is per hour or per lesson. A written statement of the cancellation and rescheduling terms, because unused sessions during mock weeks and travel are where package value leaks. And a stated policy on changing tutor, including whether a replacement costs anything. A tutoring operation with premises and staff in Dubai is a different legal animal and needs a KHDA Educational Services Permit for a training institute; IB Gram is not such an institute, holds no KHDA permit, and does not describe itself as approved by any regulator.

sections.heading: Starting chemistry support from The Meadows, with the bill shaped first
paragraphs: What to send: the level, which of the six topics the school has taught so far, where the scientific investigation stands, the most recent marked work you hold, and the time your child actually reaches home in your part of The Meadows. The last of those matters as much as the first: a slot set against the school bell rather than the bus arrival is the usual reason a weekly arrangement in this community quietly stops in October.

What we will probably recommend is a two-session spine diagnostic before any package, because in chemistry more than any other subject the losses across topics tend to share one root. If they do, the plan is short daily spine practice the student can largely run alone, marked twice a week, which is cheap. If the investigation has no research question, that becomes the first call on the budget regardless of what the topic marks look like. If the student is on Higher Level with a single weekly hour starting in the spring, we will say plainly that the hours do not reach the content and discuss what the money can actually buy.

The limits, before you book. Higher Level chemistry is among the narrowest specialist supply in this market, and in the weeks before the examined session it narrows further as demand across Dubai peaks together; where no UAE-based tutor covers the level and slot you need, the match may be an experienced Diploma chemistry specialist teaching from outside the UAE on the same live video format and the same Gulf Standard Time schedule, and you are told that in advance. No tutor will promise a grade. No tutor will produce any part of the investigation or the Extended Essay. No tutor will come to a villa in Emirates Living, because in-home visiting is not a service we sell in the UAE. No IB session dates appear here, because the IB's own site could not be verified for this project: confirm them with your school's coordinator. And nothing on this page claims approval, accreditation, licensing or partnership with the IB, KHDA, MoHRE or the Ministry of Education, because IB Gram holds none of them and runs no UAE office.

Twenty per cent of the grade and twenty-four marks sit in that component, and its status changes the right allocation of the next six weeks more than any topic mark does. Families who answer this question last are the ones who pay most.

process.description: Two sessions of timed calculation work across moles, concentration, unit handling and logarithms, marked for accuracy rather than discussed. If the losses across topics share one root cause, which they usually do, you have just avoided a term of paying for three topics at specialist rates.

process.title: Match the spend to the term
process.description: Find your child's stage on the two-year profile in this page and compare it against what you are considering spending. Autumn of Year 12 buys consolidation, spine repair and investigation planning at once. Spring of Year 13 buys exam technique and nothing else, whatever the rate.

process.description: Tell us which part of The Meadows you are in and what time your child actually walks through the door. Meadows 1 to 3 can often start at 4:15pm; Meadows 6 to 9 usually cannot before 5:30pm in term time, which is why weekend morning slots here are gone by mid-January.

process.title: Agree the session count and the end date
process.description: For a mechanism block or a spine block, ask for the number of sessions, the finish date and what the student will be able to do alone at the end. Open-ended specialist teaching with no end point is how a chemistry bill grows quietly across a final year without anybody deciding that it should.

process.title: Ask the three paperwork questions

whyPoints.title: The travel premium explained honestly
whyPoints.description: An in-home hour costs more because of the drive, and it narrows the pool to specialists willing to spend an hour in traffic. We say that rather than describing online delivery as convenient, because at Higher Level chemistry the narrower pool is the real cost.

whyPoints.title: Diagnosis before hours
whyPoints.description: A two-session spine diagnostic before any package, because chemistry losses across topics usually share one root cause and paying for topics in sequence fixes none of them. It is the cheapest money in the subject and the step most often skipped.

whyPoints.description: Twenty-four marks in the scientific investigation, earned with a plan and a deadline rather than under examination pressure, and settled before the papers are sat. Clinics at four milestones capture them more cheaply than a weekly hour running alongside.

faqs.question: What should a Diploma chemistry tutor cost in The Meadows, and what drives the range?
faqs.answer: Published Dubai rates read in October 2026 ran AED 45 to 150 an hour at the budget online end, with EdFlik at AED 45 to 65 and Tutopiya from AED 33 to 52; AED 150 to 300 for a qualified online subject tutor, with Unitors listing IB from AED 200; AED 200 to 450 and above for specialists, with TutorChase at AED 270; AED 180 to 500 for in-home visits including travel; and AED 650 at BartyED's premium end. The range is driven by travel time, specialist scarcity at Higher Level and reputation, in roughly that order. None of those figures is an IB Gram price.

faqs.question: Why does an in-home chemistry hour cost more if the teaching is identical?
faqs.answer: Because you are paying for the drive. In-home one-to-one visits including travel are quoted at AED 180 to 500 against AED 150 to 300 for a qualified online tutor, and the difference is time the tutor cannot sell to anybody else. There is a second cost that runs the wrong way: a tutor willing to reach Meadows 7 at half past four is drawn from the subset of specialists prepared to sit in traffic, which at Higher Level chemistry removes most of the people you want. The premium buys a smaller choice of tutor.

faqs.question: When in the two years does chemistry tutoring buy the most?
faqs.answer: The autumn term of Year 12, by a wide margin. The content is being taught in class so tutoring consolidates rather than rebuilds, the quantitative spine can still be repaired cheaply, and the investigation can be planned before it becomes urgent. One hour does three jobs. By the spring of Year 13 an hour can only do exam technique, yet that is when demand across Dubai peaks and rates sit at the top of their bands. The expensive hours are bought when each is worth least, which is the structural problem with spending triggered by a report.

faqs.question: Is stoichiometry worth paying for as a separate block?
faqs.answer: Usually yes, and it is the best value in the subject. The mole and its consequences run through energetics, kinetics, equilibrium, acid-base work and electrochemistry, so a student weak there loses marks in all of them and each loss looks like a different topic problem. A two-session diagnostic of timed calculation work, marked for accuracy, establishes whether the losses share a root cause. If they do, the fix is short daily practice the student can largely run alone, which is cheap. Paying for three topics in sequence instead is how a term disappears.

faqs.question: How many hours does the chemistry investigation actually take?
faqs.answer: Twenty to thirty hours across several months for most students, spread very unevenly and almost entirely outside timetabled lessons. It carries twenty-four marks and twenty per cent of the final grade, assessed against research design, data analysis, conclusion and evaluation at six marks each. The hours are not the problem; the absence of a timetabled slot is, because the work loses every scheduling contest it enters. Four dated milestones working backwards from the school's internal deadline, with a clinic at each, is both cheaper and more reliable than a weekly session running alongside.

faqs.question: Which chemistry marks are the cheapest to earn?
faqs.answer: The evaluation criterion in the scientific investigation, followed by the conclusion. Both carry six marks, both are typically written in the final hours before submission, and both reward careful specific writing about limitations and realistic improvements rather than additional laboratory work. Research design is close behind: a vague research question caps the whole investigation whatever follows it, so time spent framing it properly protects all twenty-four marks. By contrast the marks on Paper 2 extended responses are earned slowly, through practice volume, over many months.

faqs.question: Should we buy a monthly package or pay per session?
faqs.answer: A package is cheaper per hour and more expensive per hour actually taught, because unused sessions during mock weeks, exam leave and family travel rarely roll over. Published packages in this market include AED 799 a month for eight online sessions and AED 1,599 to 1,799 a month for four two-hour in-home sessions. Before comparing headline figures, ask what happens to a missed session and what the cancellation window is. Start with a short block rather than a term, and buy the diagnostic before either, so you know which component the hours are meant to serve.

faqs.question: Is the chemistry rate we were quoted per hour or per lesson, and is VAT in it?
faqs.answer: Ask the provider directly, because the answer varies and it changes the real figure by a noticeable margin across a year. Any provider should be able to say in one sentence whether their quoted number is per hour or per lesson and whether VAT is included in it. This page does not state the UAE VAT treatment of tuition fees as a fact, because that would require a Federal Tax Authority citation, and a tutoring page asserting a tax position it cannot source is doing a parent no favours. Put the question in writing and keep the answer with the invoice.

faqs.question: What should I refuse to pay a chemistry tutor for?
faqs.answer: A promised grade, improvement or university place: no tutor can deliver one and offering it is a warning rather than a selling point. Examiner status that cannot be evidenced. Syllabus documents, past papers or mark schemes supplied as downloads, which belong to the IB, Cambridge and Pearson and should be referenced and linked rather than distributed. Completed internal assessments, extended essays or coursework of any kind, which at least one site in this search sells and which puts the student's qualification at risk. And any statistic offered without a count, a date and a method.

faqs.question: How much more does Higher Level chemistry cost in support hours?
faqs.answer: The component weightings are identical: Paper 1 at thirty-six per cent, Paper 2 at forty-four and the investigation at twenty. What Higher Level adds is content inside each of the six topics, with the heaviest additions in thermodynamics, rate laws and equilibrium, and in extended organic mechanisms and electrochemistry. In practice that is three to five extra sessions on thermodynamics, a planned block on kinetics and equilibrium, and four to eight sessions of mechanism volume practice. The investigation costs the same at both levels, which is the one genuine economy in moving up.

faqs.question: Is organic chemistry where a specialist is genuinely worth the premium?
faqs.answer: Yes, with one condition attached. Mechanism work is recognised rather than understood and applied, so the skill is built by working many examples with immediate correction, and a tutor who has done that across several cohorts moves faster than one who has not. The condition is that your child can already name the compounds, draw functional groups accurately and say what common reagents do. If they cannot, the premium hours will be spent on nomenclature at mechanism prices, and a fortnight of free self-testing first changes what those paid hours can achieve.

faqs.question: Can a tutor supply past papers and mark schemes as part of the fee?
faqs.answer: No, and a tutor who offers to is creating a problem rather than solving one. Syllabus documents, past papers, mark schemes, grade-boundary tables and subject guides are the property of the IB, Cambridge and Pearson, and reproducing or distributing them is copyright infringement. A legitimate tutor references the material, cites the official page and links out to it, and works with whatever the school has legitimately provided. Your school's subject teacher and the official websites are the proper route to practice material, and in most cases the school already holds more of it than a tutor would.

faqs.question: What should a private tutor's invoice in Dubai actually state?
faqs.answer: The number of sessions, the rate, the period covered, and whether the figure is per hour or per lesson, with the VAT position stated one way or the other. Alongside it, ask for the cancellation and rescheduling terms in writing, because unused sessions during mock weeks and travel are where package value leaks, and ask what changing tutor costs. None of these requests is unusual and none is usually refused. It is also reasonable to ask whether the tutor holds the MoHRE private tuition work permit, which is granted free of charge for two years.

faqs.question: Do chemistry tutoring rates rise closer to the examined session?
faqs.answer: Availability tightens rather than list prices changing, and the effect on what a family pays is the same. Demand across Dubai peaks in the second term of the final year, specialists at Higher Level are the first to fill, and the sessions still available are at the upper end of the bands or at awkward times. The practical consequence is that negotiating power sits with the family in September and with the tutor in February. Securing a weekend morning slot in the autumn term costs nothing and is worth more than any later discount.

faqs.question: Can a cheaper tutor handle the calculation work and the data booklet?
faqs.answer: Frequently yes, and it is one of the few places where the budget band genuinely delivers. Spine work on moles, concentration, unit handling and logarithms is well-defined, markable and does not require deep knowledge of the Diploma's assessment structure, so a numerate tutor at AED 45 to 150 an hour can run it effectively provided somebody has diagnosed what to run. What the budget band generally does not deliver is knowledge of the criteria, the command terms and the investigation, which is where the specialist bands earn their difference.

faqs.question: What happens to our money if no Higher Level chemistry tutor is available?

intro.heading: The question behind 'Chemistry tutor near me' in The Springs
paragraphs: A Springs parent typing 'IB Chemistry tutor near me' is rarely optimising for distance. The real question is whether anyone within reach knows the actual course: the six topic blocks, which content is Higher Level only, what the investigation is marked out of, and why a student who can balance any equation still loses half the available marks on a mechanism question. Distance is a proxy for competence, and it is a bad one.

The honest answer in Emirates Living is that chemists are easy to find and Diploma Chemistry teachers are not. Dubai's private sector held 387,441 students across 227 private schools in 2024-25 with seventeen curricula licensed, and International Baccalaureate programmes accounted for seven per cent of that enrolment. That is a large absolute number of Diploma students served by a small number of people who have taught Chemistry to the current guide and marked its internal assessment. The scarcity is at Higher Level, and it tightens as a May series approaches.

So this page is written as a test rather than a pitch. It lays out what the course contains in enough detail that you can hold a conversation with any tutor, from any provider, and tell within ten minutes whether they have taught it. The eight questions in the table below are the ones a Chemistry teacher answers instantly and a well-meaning chemistry graduate answers vaguely. Use them on us as well.

On delivery, the position is fixed and stated up front. IB Gram does not send a tutor to a Springs townhouse or to any UAE address; in-home visiting is a service we run only in India. Chemistry work here is one-to-one over live video on Gulf Standard Time, with a shared screen for mechanisms, energy diagrams and marked scripts. The practical effect is that a Springs family is choosing from everyone who teaches this subject properly rather than from whoever can drive to Emirates Living by half past four.

One more thing is worth saying before the detail starts. Several providers in this market present themselves as approved by a board or a regulator. Nobody tutoring privately in the UAE holds IB or Cambridge accreditation of that kind, IB Gram included, and a page claiming otherwise is telling you something useful about itself. What a tutor can legitimately show you is a MoHRE private tuition work permit, a teaching history, and a working knowledge of the course. Ask for those three. The page then works through where Chemistry marks actually go missing for Springs students, topic by topic, and what the alternative-to-practical paper rewards when nobody is standing at a bench. Both are answered with the mark scheme rather than with reassurance. Springs parents comparing providers can use the screening questions here even if they end up hiring somebody else entirely, because every one of them has a checkable answer.

sections.heading: Eight questions that reveal whether a tutor knows IB Chemistry
paragraphs: Credentials are easy to assert and hard to check, so test the knowledge instead. The eight questions below take about ten minutes and cannot be answered from a marketing page. A Chemistry teacher answers them without hesitating. Someone who knows chemistry but has never taught the Diploma answers them in generalities, and the gap is obvious once you know what you are listening for.

The point is not to catch anyone out. It is that Diploma Chemistry has a specific architecture, and a tutor who does not hold that architecture in their head cannot aim an hour. A student with a weak Reactivity 3 and a strong Structure 2 needs a different hour from a student with the reverse, and only a tutor who thinks in those blocks will notice the difference from a marked script.

Use the same questions on any provider you are considering, including us. A provider who treats them as an insult is telling you something. A tutor who answers them and then asks to see your child's last marked paper before quoting hours is behaving the way a teacher behaves.

One note on examiner claims, which circulate widely in this market. Current examiner status cannot be verified by a parent, and it cannot legitimately be sold as access to marking, grade boundaries or paper content. If a provider leans on examiner status rather than on teaching history, treat it as a marketing position rather than a qualification, and go back to the eight questions.

sections.heading: What the current Chemistry guide actually contains, block by block
paragraphs: The course is organised under two headings rather than the traditional three branches, and that reorganisation is the single most common place a well-qualified chemist from another system reveals they have not taught it. Structure covers models of the particulate nature of matter, models of bonding and structure, and the classification of matter. Reactivity covers what drives chemical reactions, how much and how fast and how far they go, and the mechanisms of chemical change.

Higher Level is not a separate syllabus. It extends each block, which matters for planning because it means a Higher Level student cannot be taught the Standard Level course and then topped up. The extensions sit inside the same conceptual thread, so they have to be taught in place. A tutor who proposes covering Standard Level content first and adding the Higher Level material later has misread how the guide is built.

Assessment is two written papers plus the investigation. Paper 1 combines multiple-choice questions with data-based questions, Paper 2 is short and extended response, and the investigation carries a fifth of the grade. Higher Level sits longer papers across the extended content. Confirm the current timings and version for your child's cohort with the school's Diploma coordinator rather than relying on any tutoring page, including this one.

There is also a required element that carries no marks and consumes real calendar: the collaborative sciences project, a multi-subject piece of around ten hours. It is not assessed and it cannot be skipped, so it lands in the same weeks a student would otherwise be drafting the investigation. Families planning a support schedule should ask the school when it falls.

sections.heading: Higher Level against Standard Level, in content rather than adjectives
paragraphs: Most pages in this market describe Higher Level Chemistry as harder and stop there, which helps nobody choosing subjects in DP1. The useful comparison is about what the extra content demands rather than how it feels. Higher Level extends every block, raises the quantitative load, and widens the mechanism work. The papers are longer and the extended-response questions carry more marks each, which raises the cost of a weak explanation.

For a Springs student the decision is usually made on an IGCSE grade and a university plan, and the IGCSE grade is the weaker of the two signals. An Extended grade 7 in Cambridge 0620 means the student has handled a well-structured course with a generous practical component. It does not predict comfort with equilibrium algebra or with multi-step mechanisms, because 0620 does not test either at that depth.

The better predictor is mathematics. Students taking Analysis and Approaches alongside Chemistry HL generally find Reactivity 2 to be arithmetic. Students taking Applications and Interpretations alongside Chemistry HL frequently find the same material opaque, not because they cannot do chemistry but because the algebra is unfamiliar under time pressure. That gap is closeable, and it is far cheaper to close in the first term of DP1 than in the term before a series.

Dropping from Higher to Standard Level is a legitimate decision rather than a defeat, and it is a school decision with a deadline. If it is on the table, it should be discussed with the Diploma coordinator early, while the option is still open, and informed by marked evidence rather than by one bad mock. A tutor can give you that evidence; the decision belongs to the school and the family.

sections.heading: The investigation: criteria by letter, and the line a tutor does not cross
paragraphs: A fifth of the Chemistry grade sits in one report with a 3,000-word ceiling, marked out of 24 across four criteria worth six marks each: research design, data analysis, conclusion and evaluation. Knowing those four names is the minimum a tutor should bring to a conversation about it. Knowing which one students lose most on is the part that saves a Springs family money.

That criterion is research design, and the failure is nearly always the same. The student picks a question that sounds like chemistry and has no genuinely controllable independent variable, or a variable that cannot be varied enough times to produce usable data. The chemistry is fine; the design is unworkable. Caught in a first conversation, this costs one session. Caught after data collection, it cannot be fixed, because the measurements that exist cannot answer a different question.

Data analysis is the second common loss, and it is mostly about uncertainty. Students propagate uncertainties inconsistently, quote results to more significant figures than their equipment justifies, or present a graph without the error bars that would show whether the trend is real. Evaluation then suffers, because a student who has not confronted their own uncertainty has nothing specific to evaluate and writes generalities about human error.

The boundary is firm and worth having in writing before you book. A tutor may explain what each criterion rewards, question a research question, point out that an uncertainty is unjustified, ask whether a conclusion follows from the data, and read a draft the student wrote and say where the reasoning stops. A tutor may not choose the question, design the method, process the data, write any part of the report, or edit it into a different piece of work. IB Gram does not provide any of that and will not accept a booking that asks for it.

sections.heading: Organic mechanisms, equilibrium and energetics: the three that stall
paragraphs: Three parts of the course account for most of the Chemistry enquiries that come out of Emirates Living, and they fail in recognisably different ways. Organic mechanisms fail as notation. The student understands that a nucleophile attacks and cannot produce the arrows, the intermediate and the charges in the order a mark scheme expects. The cure is mechanical: drawing them live, repeatedly, narrating each step aloud, until the hand knows the sequence. Watching a tutor draw a finished mechanism does not build that.

Equilibrium fails as conflation. Students merge two separate questions, how fast a reaction goes and how far it goes, into one intuition, and then apply rate reasoning to a position-of-equilibrium question. Marks disappear in a predictable pattern across both papers. The fix is to force the two apart on paper for several weeks before letting them back together, which is slow and reliable and takes about four sessions.

Energetics fails as sign convention. A student who is otherwise strong will build a correct enthalpy cycle and lose the marks on a sign, or set the cycle up in the direction the question did not ask for. This is the cheapest of the three to fix and the most frustrating to watch, because the chemistry is already there and the arithmetic discipline is not.

Knowing which of the three a student is in matters more than the total hours booked. A marked script usually shows it within ten minutes to someone who thinks in topic blocks, which is precisely why the eight questions at the top of this page are worth asking before any hours are agreed. A tutor who cannot locate the failure will teach the course in order and bill for the whole of it.

sections.heading: Which Emirates Living schools run DP Chemistry, and what matching looks like
paragraphs: The Diploma is taught locally rather than universally. Emirates International School Meadows runs the IB continuum through to the Diploma on the edge of The Springs, and Dubai International Academy Emirates Hills runs it nearby. Several of the campuses Springs children travel to, including Regent International School and Dubai British School Emirates Hills, are British-curriculum routes through IGCSE into A Level rather than Diploma schools. That mix is why one street can contain students on three different assessment calendars.

For matching, the school matters less than the version of the course and the internal deadline calendar. Two Diploma students at different campuses can be at different points in the same guide and working to different internal dates for the investigation. A tutor who asks which school and then asks for the school's own deadline sheet is doing the job properly; one who asks only for the topic is not.

Dubai's school provision is still expanding, which affects availability rather than price. Seven new private schools open for the 2026-27 intake, four British-curriculum and three International Baccalaureate, adding 16,846 places, after six opened in 2025-26 and enrolment rose six per cent. More Diploma cohorts mean more competition for the same small group of experienced Chemistry teachers, and the pressure shows up as waiting time from January onwards.

KHDA inspects Dubai private schools annually on a six-band scale from Outstanding to Very Weak, and a published band is a reasonable thing for a parent to read before drawing conclusions about a subject department. A strong overall band does not mean every subject is strong, and a weaker band does not mean a student needs tutoring. Read the published report, ask the department directly, and use a marked script rather than a rating to decide whether to buy hours.

sections.heading: Why the Chemistry pool thins at Higher Level, and what we do about it
paragraphs: This is the part of the honest answer most providers leave out. The number of people in Dubai who have taught Diploma Chemistry to the current guide, marked its investigation, and are free on a weekday evening in February is small. For Higher Level it is smaller. Availability, not rate, is the binding constraint on a Springs family's Chemistry booking, and it tightens every year as new Diploma cohorts open.

What we do about it has two parts, and both are stated before a trial rather than after. First, the pool is not limited to people who can reach Emirates Living, because sessions run over live video. That alone widens the choice considerably compared with an in-home search. Second, when no UAE-based Higher Level Chemistry specialist is free at the hour a family needs, we say so and name the alternative: a specialist based outside the UAE working on Gulf Standard Time, identified as such, with the rate stated before the free trial.

What we will not do is match a general science tutor at a specialist rate and let a family discover the difference in a mock. That substitution is common in this market and it is expensive twice over, because the hours are wasted and the weeks are gone. A disclosed limit is worth more than an undisclosed match.

There is one practical consequence for timing. Booking in the autumn term of DP1 gets a choice of specialists and a cheaper total, because the work is preventive. Booking in the weeks before a series gets whoever is left, usually at the top of the published market band, doing corrective work against a deadline. The calendar does not negotiate.
