sections.heading: Starting Chemistry support from The Springs
paragraphs: Tell us the school, the year, the level and what the last marked piece of Chemistry said. An enquiry that reads 'Chemistry HL at Dubai International Academy Emirates Hills, 4 in the November mock, investigation question not agreed' can be matched in one pass. One that reads 'needs chemistry help' takes three, and the three cost a fortnight.

The first working session is a diagnostic rather than a lesson: a marked piece of the student's own work read against the mark scheme or the investigation criteria, producing a written list of three things to fix. Everything bought after that aims at the list. The free trial lesson sits before all of this, takes no card, and exists to test whether your child will argue with this particular person about chemistry for ninety minutes a week.

On the legal position, stated plainly because several pages in this market are vague about it. Private tutoring in the UAE runs on the MoHRE private tuition work permit, introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, granted free of charge for two years, covering school teachers, government and private-sector employees, unemployed residents, university students and students aged 15 to 18. Tutoring without it brings fines and penalties under the applicable laws, and no fine schedule has been published, so distrust any specific figure quoted at you. IB Gram holds no regulator accreditation, operates no premises in the UAE, and does not claim either.

Enquiries on this page collect a parent's name, contact details and the child's year, school, subject and level, for the single purpose of matching a tutor and arranging the trial. No grades, reports or photographs are needed to make contact, and the record can be deleted on request. The privacy notice linked from every page sets out what is held and for how long, in line with UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on personal data protection.

process.title: Say which school and which level
process.description: Chemistry HL and Chemistry SL are different bookings, and two Diploma schools around Emirates Living run different internal deadline calendars. Naming the campus and the level in the first message is what makes a single-pass match possible rather than a three-exchange negotiation.

process.title: Ask the eight questions
process.description: Use the table above on whoever you are considering, including the tutor we propose. Ten minutes of specific questions about guide structure, criteria and mechanism teaching tells you more than any credential list, and it costs nothing.

process.title: Take the free trial lesson
process.description: One lesson, no card, no commitment. It is there to test the match rather than to deliver content. A tutor who knows the course and whom your child will not interrupt with questions is the wrong tutor, however strong the chemistry is.

process.title: Get the three-item list in writing
process.description: After the diagnostic the tutor names three things to fix and roughly how many sessions each needs. You can buy part of it, argue with it, or start and review in four weeks. A plan you cannot question is not a plan.

process.title: Review, then finish
process.description: Every four to six weeks the list is checked off or rewritten against marked work. When it is empty, the sessions end rather than renewing by default. Chemistry support that runs because it is in the calendar is the most common way a Dubai household overspends.

whyPoints.title: Chemistry specialists, not general science tutors
whyPoints.description: A tutor matched here has taught the Diploma Chemistry course as currently written and marked its investigation against the four criteria. A capable chemist who has not taught it can explain the content and usually cannot say why a Paper 2 answer scored four out of seven.

whyPoints.title: You can test us with the same eight questions
whyPoints.description: The table on this page is published so it can be used on us. A provider who publishes the test it expects to be judged by is making a checkable commitment rather than an adjectival one.

whyPoints.title: The pool is wider than Emirates Living
whyPoints.description: Because sessions run over live video, a Springs student works with the right Chemistry teacher rather than the nearest one. At Higher Level, where the local pool is thinnest, that is the difference between a specialist and a substitute.

whyPoints.title: The assessment boundary is published, not negotiated
whyPoints.description: Teaching, questioning and feedback on the student's own investigation; never choosing the question, designing the method, processing data or writing. Providers in this market sell completed internal assessments. That is an academic-honesty breach and we will not take the booking.

whyPoints.title: No claimed accreditation, because there is none to claim
whyPoints.description: IB Gram holds no IB, Cambridge, KHDA or Ministry of Education approval, and says so. What a tutor can evidence is a MoHRE private tuition work permit and a teaching history, and those are the right things to ask for.

whyPoints.title: Coverage limits are disclosed before the trial
whyPoints.description: If no Higher Level Chemistry specialist is free at your hour, you are told, with the alternative and its rate named up front. No competitor page researched in this market discloses a coverage limit at all.

faqs.question: Is there an IB Chemistry tutor near The Springs who knows the current guide?
faqs.answer: Chemists are easy to find around Emirates Living; people who have taught the current Diploma Chemistry guide and marked its investigation are not. Rather than searching by distance, test by knowledge. Ask how the guide is structured, and listen for three Structure blocks and three Reactivity blocks rather than a list of traditional topic names. Ask what the investigation is marked out of, and listen for 24 marks across four criteria. Because our sessions run over live video, the search is not limited to people who can reach The Springs, which is what makes a genuine specialist findable at Higher Level.

faqs.question: How can I tell whether a Chemistry tutor really understands the Diploma course?
faqs.answer: Use the eight questions published in the table on this page. They take about ten minutes and cannot be answered from a marketing page. The strongest single question is how they would teach a mechanism: a Chemistry teacher says they would draw it live, arrow by arrow, with the student narrating each step, because that is how the skill is built. Someone who has not taught it offers to share a finished diagram and explain it. Ask the same of any provider, and ask what they will not do with your child's report.

faqs.question: What is in Higher Level Chemistry that Standard Level leaves out?
faqs.answer: Higher Level is not a separate syllabus. It extends each of the six blocks with named additional content, raises the quantitative demand across the course, and widens the mechanism work to include reasoning about intermediate stability. The papers are longer and extended-response questions carry more marks each. The practical consequence is that Higher Level content has to be taught in place rather than added afterwards, so a tutor who proposes covering Standard Level first and topping up later has misunderstood how the guide is constructed.

faqs.question: My child cannot follow organic reaction mechanisms. Is that recoverable?
faqs.answer: Usually, and faster than parents expect, because it is almost always a notation problem rather than a comprehension problem. The student understands that a nucleophile attacks and cannot reliably produce the arrows, the intermediate and the charges in the order a mark scheme wants. The remedy is mechanical: drawing mechanisms live, repeatedly, narrating each step aloud, until the hand knows the sequence. Watching someone else draw a completed mechanism does not build it. Four to six sessions of this kind of work usually changes the mark noticeably on mechanism questions.

faqs.question: How is the IB Chemistry investigation marked, criterion by criterion?
faqs.answer: It is one report with a 3,000-word ceiling, marked out of 24 across four criteria worth six marks each: research design, data analysis, conclusion and evaluation. Research design is where most marks go missing, typically because the research question has no genuinely controllable independent variable or cannot be varied enough times to generate usable data. Data analysis is lost to inconsistent uncertainty handling and over-precise results. Evaluation then suffers, because a student who has not confronted their own uncertainty writes generalities instead of specifics.

faqs.question: Which schools near The Springs teach DP Chemistry?
faqs.answer: Emirates International School Meadows runs the IB continuum through to the Diploma on the edge of Emirates Living, and Dubai International Academy Emirates Hills runs the Diploma nearby. Several campuses Springs children travel to, including Regent International School and Dubai British School Emirates Hills, are British-curriculum routes through IGCSE into A Level rather than Diploma schools. Schools are named here as context only; we have no affiliation with any of them. For matching, the version of the course and the school's own internal deadline sheet matter more than the campus name.

faqs.question: Is Chemistry HL required for medicine applications from Dubai?
faqs.answer: Chemistry at Higher Level is commonly expected on medicine and chemistry routes, but requirements are set by individual universities and they differ by country and by year. Check the specific entry requirement for each course on the university's own admissions page before committing a Diploma subject choice, and confirm with the school's university counsellor. No tutoring page should be the source for an admissions requirement, and tutoring is not a condition of meeting one. What a tutor can do is give you marked evidence about whether Higher Level is a realistic load for that student.

faqs.question: Can one tutor take Chemistry and Biology for the same student?
faqs.answer: At Standard Level this often works well, because the two courses share the same internal assessment criteria and a good deal of biochemical overlap, so one person can supervise both investigations coherently. At Higher Level it is usually better to split, since both subjects demand depth that is hard to hold at once. The deciding question is where the marks are actually being lost. If both subjects are failing in data analysis, one tutor is efficient. If one is failing on mechanisms and the other on physiology, two are cheaper in the end.

faqs.question: How are practical and data skills taught if Chemistry lessons are online?
faqs.answer: The laboratory work itself happens at school, which is where the equipment and the supervision are. What a tutor works on is everything around it: designing a question with a controllable variable, planning a data table before collection starts, propagating uncertainty consistently, choosing a graph that shows whether a trend is real, and writing an evaluation that names specific limitations rather than human error. Those are desk skills, and a shared screen handles them well. Data-based questions on Paper 1 are also pure desk work.

faqs.question: What qualifications should I ask a Chemistry tutor to show me?
faqs.answer: Three things, in this order. A MoHRE private tuition work permit, which is free, valid for two years and the legal requirement for private tutoring in the UAE. A teaching history that includes the Diploma Chemistry course rather than chemistry in general. And a working answer to the eight questions on this page. What nobody tutoring privately in the UAE can show you is IB, Cambridge or KHDA accreditation for tutoring, so a provider claiming it is telling you something useful about how carefully it writes.

faqs.question: Should I look for a tutor who has examined for the IB?
faqs.answer: It is not the signal it is sold as. Current examiner status cannot be verified by a parent, it changes from session to session, and it cannot legitimately be presented as access to marking, grade boundaries or paper content. A teacher who has taught the course for several years and marked internal assessments against its criteria is usually the more useful hire. If a provider leans on examiner claims rather than on teaching history, go back to asking about guide structure, criteria and how they would teach a mechanism.

faqs.question: How quickly can a Chemistry tutor be matched for a Springs household?
faqs.answer: For MYP sciences and IGCSE 0620, usually within a few days. For Diploma Chemistry at Standard Level, up to about a week. For Higher Level it can take longer, and from January onwards it frequently does, because the pool of people who have taught the current guide is small and the demand clusters before a May series. If nobody is free at your preferred hour we say so and name the options rather than offering a general science tutor and letting a mock reveal the difference.

faqs.question: What does DP Chemistry tuition cost per hour around Emirates Living?
faqs.answer: Published 2026 Dubai rate tables put qualified subject tutors working online at AED 150 to 300 an hour, IB and A Level specialists at AED 200 to 450 and above, and in-home one-to-one at AED 180 to 350 because travel is priced inside the hour. Those are market figures from published sources rather than our quotation. The total that matters is hours multiplied by rate, and the hours depend on whether the problem is mechanism notation, equilibrium reasoning or an unworkable investigation question. Take the free trial, then ask for an hours estimate.

faqs.question: What happens if no Higher Level Chemistry specialist is free?
faqs.answer: You are told, before any trial is arranged. Higher Level Chemistry is the thinnest part of this market in Dubai and the shortage is worst in the weeks before a May series. The options we name are waiting for a slot, moving to a different hour, or working with a specialist based outside the UAE teaching on Gulf Standard Time, identified as such with the rate stated up front. What we will not do is match a general science tutor at a specialist rate, because that wastes both the money and the weeks.

faqs.question: Does equilibrium really need a tutor, or is it just practice?
faqs.answer: It needs the right practice, which is a different thing. The usual failure is conflation: the student has merged how fast a reaction goes with how far it goes into a single intuition, then applies rate reasoning to a position-of-equilibrium question. Unsupervised practice reinforces the merge, because the student keeps answering confidently and keeps being marked down for the same reason. The fix is to force the two questions apart on paper for several weeks before letting them back together, which takes roughly four supervised sessions and then holds.

dubai/ib-chemistry-tutor-in-the-springs.closingHeading: Test the knowledge, then book the hours
dubai/ib-chemistry-tutor-in-the-springs.closingBody: The useful move for a Springs family is not to search harder by distance. It is to ask any Chemistry tutor eight specific questions about the guide, the criteria and how they teach a mechanism, and to listen for whether the answers are structural or general. Tell us the school, the level and what the last marked paper said, and we will propose a Chemistry specialist who has taught that course. The trial lesson is free and takes no card. If no Higher Level specialist is free at your hour, we will tell you that instead of filling the slot.

Each is listed by the level they teach to examination, because the Higher Level extensions in energetics and organic mechanisms are where a general science tutor stops being useful.

intro.heading: Three comparisons, and only one of them has a local answer
paragraphs: Chemistry enquiries from this part of Dubai tend to arrive carrying three comparisons at once. The family is weighing their own community against the next one over, because they have just moved or are about to. They are weighing Higher Level against Standard Level, usually because a university route is in view. And they are weighing chemistry against biology, because one of the three sciences has to go and nobody is quite sure which. All three are reasonable. Only the first has a local answer, and that answer is probably not the one the family expects.

On the neighbourhood question: for Diploma chemistry, where you live in this belt changes when a session can happen and almost nothing else. The number of people in Dubai who teach Higher Level chemistry to examination standard, including organic mechanisms and energetics at depth, is modest, and they are not distributed evenly across villa communities. The Sustainable City, Mudon, Arabian Ranches 3 and Remraam all face the same thin local supply, and a denser informal recommendation network in one of them does not change that.

On level and subject, the answers are genuinely different per student and this page gives the dimensions rather than a verdict. Higher Level chemistry extends several areas substantially and carries a heavier mathematical load than most students expect. Chemistry against biology is usually decided by whether a student prefers quantitative reasoning or volume of precise terminology, and getting that choice right is worth more than two years of tutoring to correct it.

The current Diploma chemistry course is organised around two themes, Structure and Reactivity, each with three subdivisions, and assessed through two written papers, one of which includes a data-based section, plus the scientific investigation at 20% of the grade at both levels. Courses are revised periodically, so confirm the current arrangement with your child's subject teacher rather than taking it from any website, including this one.

Delivery is online and stated plainly: IB Gram does not send tutors to homes anywhere in the UAE, and nobody will arrive at an address in The Sustainable City, Mudon or Arabian Ranches. Lessons are one-to-one over live video, with a shared whiteboard for mechanisms, calculations and diagrams. Home visits exist in our India operation only. For chemistry the format costs very little, because a mechanism drawn step by step on a shared whiteboard is clearer than one drawn upside down across a kitchen table. The format also removes the two car journeys either side of a visit, which is why a session can run while a student can still hold four steps of a cycle in mind, and why the tutor can be the person who teaches the level your child sits rather than the person who happens to live closest to it.

dubai/ib-chemistry-tutor-in-the-sustaina.programmesIntro: Chemistry is taught across three stages here, and the decisions that matter most are taken before the Diploma begins. These are the stages and what each one actually requires.

programmes.name: Middle Years sciences
programmes.description: Four assessed criteria covering knowledge and understanding, inquiring and designing, processing and evaluating, and reflecting on the impacts of science. Students who score well on knowledge and poorly on processing are building exactly the profile that struggles with the Diploma investigation, because that criterion is its direct ancestor.
programmes.countryNote: In the IB continuum school inside this community, MYP science marks feed the Diploma level conversation directly. A student aiming at Higher Level chemistry should be watching the processing and evaluating criterion rather than the knowledge one, because the Diploma assesses data handling at 20% and recall considerably less generously than MYP does.

programmes.name: Chemistry at Standard Level
programmes.description: Covers Structure and Reactivity at core depth with two written papers and the investigation at 20%. The characteristic Standard Level loss is in calculations rather than concepts: moles arithmetic under time pressure, sign conventions in energetics, and equilibrium questions answered in words when the command term asked for a number.
programmes.countryNote: Standard Level chemistry is the common choice for Dubai students heading towards biological sciences, psychology or business who want a second science. It is more quantitative than most expect, and the data-based section of the written paper assumes graph and uncertainty skills that are rarely practised deliberately.

programmes.name: Chemistry at Higher Level
programmes.description: Extends energetics, equilibrium, acids and bases, redox and organic chemistry substantially. Organic mechanisms are the area where Higher Level students most often stall, usually because they memorise arrows rather than reasoning from electron density. The mathematical load is heavier than Standard Level students realise when they upgrade.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai families usually choose Higher Level chemistry with medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, biochemistry or chemical engineering in view. Requirements differ by country and institution and are revised, so read the admissions pages of the specific universities on the shortlist, and check whether a minimum grade rather than just the subject is specified.

programmes.name: IGCSE or MYP science into Diploma chemistry
programmes.description: The step up has two components. Calculations become multi-stage rather than single-step, and explanations must reason from structure rather than recall a rule. A student who scored highly at IGCSE by learning standard answers finds the first Diploma term genuinely hard, which is a method problem rather than a capability one and resolves within a term if it is named.
programmes.countryNote: Families moving between communities in this belt often change schools and boards in the same year, so a student may arrive in the first Diploma year from a different science sequence with two or three unmet topics. A short bridging block in the first term is far cheaper than remediation in the examination year.

dubai/ib-chemistry-tutor-in-the-sustaina.subjectsIntro: What follows is the content map by area, with the specific thing that costs marks in each. An enquiry that names an area and a question type produces a better first session than one describing general difficulty.

subjects.name: Structure 1: models of the particulate nature of matter
subjects.description: Atomic structure, electron configuration, ionisation energies and the mole concept. The mole is where the whole subject either works or does not, and students who are approximate with it lose marks in every later area. Ionisation energy explanations need shielding and nuclear charge named, not implied.

subjects.name: Structure 2: models of bonding and structure
subjects.description: Ionic, covalent and metallic bonding, intermolecular forces, and shapes of molecules. The reliable loss is explaining a physical property by naming the wrong force: students attribute a boiling point to covalent bond strength when the answer is the intermolecular force being broken.

subjects.name: Structure 3: classification of matter
subjects.description: Periodicity, the periodic table's organisation, and spectroscopic identification of substances at Higher Level. Trend questions lose marks when a student states the trend correctly and gives no reason, because the reason is where most of the marks sit.

subjects.name: Reactivity 1: what drives chemical reactions
subjects.description: Energetics and thermochemistry, including enthalpy cycles and entropy at Higher Level. Sign errors are the single most common loss in the whole subject: an exothermic value entered as positive invalidates everything downstream even when the method is perfect.

subjects.name: Reactivity 2: how much, how fast and how far
subjects.description: Reaction rates, equilibrium and acid-base behaviour, with substantial Higher Level extension including buffer calculations. Equilibrium questions are frequently answered qualitatively when a numerical answer was demanded, which earns nothing regardless of how sound the reasoning is.

subjects.name: Reactivity 3: mechanisms of chemical change
subjects.description: Redox and organic chemistry, with mechanisms extended considerably at Higher Level. Mechanism marks are lost by drawing a curly arrow from the wrong species: the arrow must start at an electron pair, and students who have memorised the diagram rather than the reasoning cannot adapt it.

subjects.name: The scientific investigation
subjects.description: Twenty per cent of the grade, designed and written by the student against published criteria covering research design, data analysis, conclusion and evaluation. The usual cause of a weak mark is a research question that produces too few usable data points to analyse properly.

subjects.name: Data analysis and the data-based paper section
subjects.description: Graph work, uncertainty, and judging whether a proposed relationship is supported by the data presented. This section cannot be revised by rereading notes, which is precisely why it is the part of the paper most often left unrehearsed.

subjects.name: The mathematics inside chemistry
subjects.description: Moles, ratio reasoning, logarithms in pH calculations, rearranging before substituting, and significant figures that match the data. A meaningful share of lost chemistry marks are arithmetical, and that is a diagnosable distinction rather than a guess.

subjects.name: Biology and physics alongside chemistry
subjects.description: Most chemistry students take at least one of these, and the overlap in uncertainty treatment and data handling is direct. Tutoring two sciences in the same term is usually a mistake, and the reason sits in the section on when to engage a tutor.

sections.heading: Comparison one: this community against the next one over
paragraphs: Families in this belt move often enough that the neighbourhood comparison is usually live rather than hypothetical. For chemistry specifically, the honest finding is that the communities differ in two respects and not in the one most parents are asking about. They differ in when a session can start, which follows from the school run. They differ in what a visiting tutor would charge, which follows from the drive. They do not differ in who can teach Higher Level chemistry, because that pool is thin across the whole emirate.

The timing difference is substantial enough to matter. A student at the school inside The Sustainable City is home by mid-afternoon, which makes a 3.30pm session possible. A student commuting from Mudon or Remraam to a school in Motor City or Al Barsha is not realistically available until half past five, and for organic mechanism work — which needs sustained attention rather than quick recall — the quality of a seven o'clock session is visibly lower. That is a genuine argument for weekend blocks in commuting households.

The cohort-size difference is the one worth more attention than it usually gets. Smaller schools in this belt teach Diploma chemistry with one specialist and a modest cohort, which has advantages and one specific disadvantage: there is no second teacher inside the building offering a different explanation of the same mechanism. That is the most common legitimate reason a family here engages a tutor, and it applies in every community in this corridor equally.

sections.heading: Comparison two: Higher Level against Standard Level chemistry
paragraphs: This decision is usually made on a university requirement and should also be made on a workload calculation. Higher Level chemistry extends energetics, equilibrium, acids and bases, redox and organic chemistry substantially, and the organic extension in particular demands reasoning rather than recall. The mathematical load also rises: pH and buffer calculations use logarithms, and energetics cycles require careful sign discipline across multiple steps.

Students who upgrade from Standard to Higher Level during the first Diploma year are frequently surprised by the mechanism work rather than by the content volume. Memorising a mechanism works at Standard Level and fails at Higher Level, where unfamiliar substrates appear and the student has to reason from electron density. That shift is teachable in a few weeks if it is identified, and it is the single most common reason a capable Higher Level chemistry student stalls between the first and second year.

The level decision also interacts with what else is being taken. Higher Level chemistry alongside Higher Level biology — the common pre-medicine combination in this belt — means two scientific investigations in the same year, both due to school deadlines in the same term. That is a scheduling problem rather than an academic one, and it is solvable only if the family notices it in the first Diploma year rather than the second. sections.heading: Comparison three: chemistry, biology or physics as the science that stays
paragraphs: Most Diploma students in this belt take two sciences at most, which means one gets dropped, and the choice is frequently made on which teacher the student liked in the Middle Years Programme. That is a poor basis for a two-year commitment. The better basis is the kind of thinking each subject rewards, because a student working against their own grain spends two years producing effort without marks and usually blames themselves for it.

The distinction in practice is this. Chemistry rewards quantitative reasoning and structural logic: a student who likes working out why a property follows from a structure will do well. Biology rewards volume and terminological precision: a student who can hold a large amount of exact vocabulary and deploy it accurately will do well. Physics rewards mathematical modelling and mechanism: a student comfortable with algebra and abstraction will do well. All three reward data handling, which is why that skill transfers.

University requirements complicate the choice and should be checked rather than assumed. Medicine commonly expects chemistry and frequently biology; engineering commonly expects physics and mathematics; biochemistry and pharmacy usually want chemistry; psychology varies widely. Published requirements differ by country and institution and are revised, so read the admissions pages of the specific universities being considered. Where the requirement genuinely constrains the choice, that settles it; where it does not, the grain of the student's thinking should. A student who is genuinely unsure usually finds the answer in one honest diagnostic session on an unseen question in each subject.

sections.heading: Where chemistry marks actually go
paragraphs: Chemistry is diagnosable in a way that essay subjects are not, and the losses repeat so reliably that they are worth publishing. Four causes account for most of them: approximate moles work, sign errors in energetics, curly arrows drawn from the wrong species, and qualitative answers given to quantitative command terms. None of these are gaps in understanding the subject. They are precision failures, and precision failures are correctable in weeks rather than terms.

Sign errors deserve particular attention because of how much they cost. An enthalpy change entered with the wrong sign invalidates every downstream step in a cycle, so a student who understands the whole method perfectly can score close to nothing on a multi-mark question. The fix is procedural: write the sign convention at the top of the working every time, before any numbers appear. Students resist this as unnecessary until they see a marked paper where it cost them five marks.

The mechanism failures are different in kind, because they reveal how the student learned the material. A curly arrow must start at an electron pair, and a student who has memorised a diagram will place the arrow correctly on the familiar substrate and incorrectly on anything else. That is why a tutor should test every mechanism on an unseen substrate rather than the textbook one. sections.heading: When to engage a tutor, and what can still be influenced
paragraphs: Because the investigation is 20% of the grade and is submitted to a school deadline months before the examinations, the question of when a family starts matters more in the sciences than almost anywhere else in the Diploma. This is also the comparison nobody in this market publishes, presumably because the honest version includes a column where the answer is no longer very much. A family deciding where to spend should see it anyway.

The pattern is straightforward. In the first term of the first Diploma year, everything is still available: content, the investigation, the level decision itself. By the final term of the first year, the content and the investigation are both live but the level decision has usually closed. By the first term of the second year, the investigation is in draft and only paper technique and content repair remain fully open. By the final term, the investigation is submitted and the realistic gains are technique alone.

None of those positions is hopeless, and technique gains in the final term are real — command-term discipline, sign conventions, pacing, and the data-based section are all improvable quickly. What is not available is influence over a fifth of the grade that has already been banked. A tutor who implies otherwise in the final term is selling, and a family who understands the table below buys the right thing at the right time rather than more of the wrong thing late.

sections.heading: What chemistry tutoring costs across this belt
paragraphs: The rate follows the tutor rather than the postcode, with one exception. Published Dubai figures put a qualified subject tutor working online at AED 150 to AED 300 an hour, with one agency advertising IB from AED 200, and IB, IGCSE and A Level specialists at AED 200 to AED 450 and above, with TutorChase publishing AED 270 and one premium provider advertising AED 650 an hour. Budget online tutoring runs AED 33 to AED 65, with Tutopiya from AED 33 to AED 52 and EdFlik from AED 45 to AED 65.

The exception is travel. In-home visiting rates are published at AED 180 to AED 500 once travel is included, with Bestimate quoting AED 180 to AED 350 and independent home tutors AED 200 to AED 500. That is where the neighbourhood genuinely affects the number, because a tutor pricing an Al Qudra Road run and one pricing a trip into Arabian Ranches are pricing different journeys and both build it into the hour. Monthly packages in this market include AED 799 for eight online sessions and AED 1,599 to AED 1,799 for four two-hour home visits.

For Higher Level chemistry, the specialist tier is usually the right purchase, because what is being bought is mechanism reasoning and investigation judgement rather than general subject knowledge. Bestimate's monthly estimates for one weekly hour run AED 600 to AED 1,200 mid-market and AED 1,000 to AED 2,000 or more for specialist examination-year support. All these figures belong to the companies and rate guides that published them and were read in October 2026. IB Gram publishes no hourly list here and quotes after a free trial.

sections.heading: The honesty boundary, and what the regulators actually do
paragraphs: Chemistry makes the academic honesty question concrete, because an investigation involves data and data can be invented. A tutor may teach the underlying chemistry, explain what each criterion rewards, test whether a research question produces enough usable data points, question whether a conclusion follows from the results, teach uncertainty treatment on the student's own measurements, and comment on writing the student produced. A tutor may not design the investigation, supply or adjust data, write or redraft any part of the report, or provide a model to adapt.

One operation in this market sells completed internal assessments at AED 3,750. Buying one is academic misconduct under IB rules and the consequence falls on the candidate, whose diploma is what is at risk. On materials, IB syllabus documents, past papers, mark schemes, data booklets and grade-boundary tables are the IB's copyright; we reference and cite them and work from what the school legitimately holds. We also do not describe tutors as IB examiners without evidenced current status.

On regulators, the position is narrow and deliberate. Dubai private schools are overseen by KHDA, which u.ae describes as responsible for enhancing and overseeing the quality of private education in the emirate — 227 schools and 387,441 students in 2024-25, with the IB at 7% of enrolment. Abu Dhabi has ADEK, Sharjah SPEA, Ras Al Khaimah its Department of Knowledge, and the federal Ministry of Education covers Ajman, Umm Al Quwain and Fujairah. IB Gram holds no permit, approval or partnership from any of them, nor from the IB, and has no UAE office. An individual tutoring privately in the UAE needs a MoHRE private tuition work permit, introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023 and granted free of charge for two years.

sections.heading: Session timing compared across the belt
paragraphs: Chemistry has two kinds of work with different timing needs, which is why a single weekly slot sometimes serves a student badly. Calculation drilling benefits from frequency: two short sessions in a week beat one long one, because moles fluency improves through repetition spread over days. Mechanism reasoning and investigation work benefit from an uninterrupted block, because both involve holding several steps in mind at once and a fragmented hour wastes the setup time.

Where a family lives in this belt then decides what is practical. A student at school inside The Sustainable City can take a short weekday session at 3.30pm and a longer weekend block. A student commuting from Mudon, Remraam or Arabian Ranches 3 is realistically limited to one weekday evening slot, which usually means the weekend block carries the mechanism work. That is a genuine, if unglamorous, difference between neighbourhoods and it is the one worth planning around.

The UAE calendar does the rest. The working week runs Monday to Friday with a half-day Friday, leaving Saturday and Sunday as the only full days. During Ramadan school hours shorten and the useful window moves after Iftar, where a chemistry session is frequently better than any afternoon slot in that month. We hold slots in Gulf Standard Time, move them after Iftar with the same tutor, and pause blocks during a school's own examination fortnight rather than adding sessions that produce fatigue. We also keep the same tutor across a term rather than rotating students to fill a diary, because knowing which calculation a particular student rushes under pressure is most of what makes a later session efficient.

process.description: Higher or Standard Level, and whether the investigation is unstarted, question chosen, data collected or written up. Those two facts decide the priority order, because a fifth of the grade is attached to a school deadline that sits well before the examination timetable.

process.title: Send a recently marked paper
process.description: Chemistry losses are visible on the page. We look for whether the cause is moles arithmetic, energetics signs, mechanism reasoning or command-term reading, because those four need different kinds of session and the wrong one wastes a month of weekly hours.

process.description: Run by the tutor who would continue, using an unfamiliar question or an unseen mechanism substrate rather than a textbook example, because how a student handles the unfamiliar is the whole diagnosis. It ends with the tutor naming the first thing they would address and why.

process.description: You receive a plan naming the syllabus areas, Structure or Reactivity, and the assessed components rather than describing general improvement, with the between-session work and the date everything counts back from. Named areas mean the plan can be checked.

process.description: Each note records whether the session's errors were arithmetical, mechanistic, command-term or uncertainty related. Over a month the pattern thins or it does not. If it does not, we change the method or the tutor rather than adding hours to the arrangement.

whyPoints.description: For Higher Level chemistry the local supply is thin everywhere in this corridor, so we say that rather than claiming a local advantage. What the community genuinely changes is session timing, and that we plan around explicitly.

whyPoints.title: Mechanism reasoning, not memorised diagrams
whyPoints.description: Every mechanism is tested on an unseen substrate, because a memorised diagram works on the familiar case and fails on the examined one. Reasoning from electron density is the specific skill Higher Level organic chemistry assesses.

whyPoints.title: Precision failures treated as what they are
whyPoints.description: Moles approximation, energetics sign errors and calculator significant figures are precision failures rather than knowledge gaps, and they are fixable in weeks with enforcement. Naming the cause is what makes the next month efficient.

faqs.question: Does it matter whether a chemistry tutor lives in this community or in Arabian Ranches?
faqs.answer: For Diploma chemistry, no. The number of people in Dubai who teach Higher Level chemistry to examination standard, including organic mechanisms and energetics at depth, is modest and they are not spread evenly across villa communities. Arabian Ranches has a denser informal network, but it circulates general and primary-level recommendations rather than Higher Level specialists. What genuinely differs between these neighbourhoods is when a session can start. IB Gram delivers online one-to-one and sends no tutors to UAE addresses, so the match is made on level taught.

faqs.question: How is the current IB chemistry course organised?
faqs.answer: Around two themes, Structure and Reactivity, each with three subdivisions: Structure covers models of the particulate nature of matter, models of bonding and structure, and classification of matter; Reactivity covers what drives chemical reactions, how much, how fast and how far, and the mechanisms of chemical change. Assessment is two written papers, one including a data-based section, plus the scientific investigation at 20% at both levels. The IB revises courses, so confirm the current structure with your child's subject teacher rather than any website.

faqs.question: Why do energetics questions cost my son so many marks?
faqs.answer: Almost certainly sign conventions. An enthalpy change entered with the wrong sign invalidates every subsequent step in a cycle, so a student who understands the method completely can score close to nothing on a multi-mark question. The fix is procedural rather than conceptual: write the sign convention at the top of the working before any numbers appear, every time, without exception. Students resist it as unnecessary until they see a marked paper where it cost five marks. It is the fastest available improvement in the subject.

faqs.question: My daughter memorises organic mechanisms and still loses marks. Why?
faqs.answer: Because mechanism marks are awarded for the reasoning, not the diagram. A curly arrow must start at an electron pair and point at the species being attacked, and a student who has memorised the textbook case will place the arrow correctly there and incorrectly on anything unfamiliar. Higher Level questions use unfamiliar substrates deliberately. The fix is to rebuild the reasoning from electron density and then test every mechanism on an unseen substrate, which takes a few weeks and changes the Higher Level organic marks noticeably.

faqs.question: Should my child take chemistry or biology if only one science can stay?
faqs.answer: Decide from the kind of thinking each rewards, unless a university requirement settles it first. Chemistry rewards quantitative reasoning and structural logic — deducing why a property follows from a structure. Biology rewards holding a large volume of exact terminology and deploying it precisely. A student working against their own grain spends two years producing effort without marks. Where medicine is the target, chemistry is commonly expected and biology frequently is, but requirements differ by country and institution, so check the published pages of the specific universities.

faqs.question: How much of the chemistry grade is the internal investigation?
faqs.answer: Twenty per cent at both Higher and Standard Level, designed and carried out by the student and marked against published criteria covering research design, data collection and processing, analysis and conclusion, and evaluation. It is submitted to a school deadline months before the examinations, which means a family starting in the final terms has already lost the chance to influence a fifth of the grade. The commonest cause of a weak mark is a research question that produces too few usable data points to analyse properly.

faqs.question: Is it too late to start chemistry tutoring in the final term?
faqs.answer: Not too late to be useful, but the target must be honest. In the final term the realistic gains are technique: command-term discipline, sign conventions, pacing against marks, and the data-based section of the paper. Narrow content repair on recurring topics is also possible. What is not available is any influence over the investigation, which is already submitted and banked, or broad content coverage. A tutor who implies a two-grade lift in that window is selling, and we would rather state the target before a booking.

faqs.question: What does Higher Level chemistry add that Standard Level does not?
faqs.answer: Substantial extension in energetics with entropy and spontaneity, in acids, bases and equilibrium with buffer and logarithmic calculations, in redox, and most demandingly in organic mechanisms where unfamiliar substrates appear. The mathematical load rises with it. Students upgrading mid-year are usually surprised by the mechanism reasoning rather than the content volume, because memorisation works at Standard Level and fails at Higher Level. That shift is teachable within a few weeks once it is identified as the actual problem.

faqs.question: Can a tutor help with the chemistry investigation without crossing a line?
faqs.answer: Yes, within a boundary worth stating. A tutor may teach the chemistry, explain what each criterion rewards, test whether a research question will produce enough usable data, teach uncertainty treatment on the student's own measurements, question whether a conclusion follows from the results, and comment on writing the student produced. A tutor may not design the investigation, supply or adjust data, write or redraft any part of the report, or hand over a model to adapt. The data point matters here because data can be invented, and must not be.

faqs.question: My child takes Higher Level chemistry and Higher Level biology. Is that manageable?
faqs.answer: It is the common pre-medicine pairing in this belt and it is manageable with one specific piece of planning: two scientific investigations fall due in the same year, both to school deadlines in roughly the same term. That is a scheduling problem rather than an academic one and it is solvable only if it is noticed in the first Diploma year. Families who sequence the two investigations deliberately cope well; families who discover the collision in the second year generally compromise one of them.

faqs.question: Does online delivery work for drawing mechanisms?
faqs.answer: Better than most parents expect. A shared whiteboard shows the mechanism being drawn step by step, right way up and large enough to see, with the tutor able to stop at the exact arrow that is wrong. Compare that with a tutor drawing upside down across a kitchen table. Calculations work the same way, with the working visible as it is produced, which is the diagnostic information a tutor needs. The honest exception remains younger children, who often need an adult physically present for unrelated reasons.

faqs.question: What should we expect to pay for Higher Level chemistry support?
faqs.answer: Published Dubai figures put qualified online subject tutors at AED 150 to AED 300 an hour and IB, IGCSE and A Level specialists at AED 200 to AED 450 or more, with TutorChase publishing AED 270. For Higher Level work the specialist tier is usually the right purchase, because mechanism reasoning and investigation judgement are what is being bought. Bestimate's monthly estimate for one weekly hour runs AED 600 to AED 1,200 mid-market. These figures were read in October 2026 and belong to the companies that published them, not to us.

faqs.question: Why do you ask for a marked paper before the first session?
faqs.answer: Because chemistry losses are diagnosable from the page and not from a conversation. Looking at marked work tells us whether the cause is approximate moles arithmetic, energetics signs, mechanism reasoning or command-term reading, and those four need different sessions with sometimes different tutors. A parent's description of struggling with chemistry is honest and not actionable; four lost marks in a cycle with a correct method is actionable immediately. It usually saves a month of generalised weekly hours.

faqs.question: Do you supply IB chemistry data booklets or past papers?
faqs.answer: No. IB syllabus documents, past papers, mark schemes, data booklets and grade-boundary tables are the IB's copyright. We reference them, cite the official source, and work from what your child's school legitimately holds, with questions shown on screen during sessions. A service advertising an unlimited paper bank raises a fair question about provenance and occasionally about unreleased material. The school's own holdings are also what your child will be marked against, which makes them the better source in practice.

faqs.question: How quickly should we expect chemistry marks to change?
faqs.answer: For precision failures — moles approximation, energetics signs, significant figures — three to four weeks, because they show up directly in the next marked paper once the habit is enforced. Mechanism reasoning takes four to six weeks, since it is a change in how the material is held rather than a fact to learn. Investigation work is judged against criteria rather than marks until the school assesses it. Session notes record which error class appeared, so the trend sits in the record rather than in impressions.

dubai/ib-chemistry-tutor-in-the-sustaina.closingHeading: Level, investigation status, and a marked paper
dubai/ib-chemistry-tutor-in-the-sustaina.closingBody: Three things make the first chemistry session useful: Higher or Standard Level, whether the scientific investigation is unstarted, drafted or submitted, and a photograph of recently marked work. From those we can usually name whether the problem is moles arithmetic, energetics signs, mechanism reasoning or command-term reading, and say honestly what is still influenceable from where you are in the year. Next is a free trial lesson on an unseen question with the tutor who would continue, then a written plan naming areas and components. Lessons run one-to-one over live video into The Sustainable City in Gulf Standard Time, with no home visits anywhere in the UAE.

Each is listed by the level they teach to examination, because the Higher Level extensions in energetics, equilibrium and organic mechanisms are where a general science tutor stops being useful.

intro.heading: Two qualifications, one subject, and a decision most families make too fast
paragraphs: The Valley is a newer community on the road to Al Ain with no school inside its own boundary at the time of writing. Students here travel outward in two broad directions, and the schools at the end of those journeys include some running the IB Diploma, some running A Levels and a few offering both. The practical consequence for chemistry is that families in this community often face a genuine choice of qualification, not merely a choice of level within one.

So this page starts there. IB chemistry and A Level Chemistry both lead to medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, biochemistry and chemical engineering, and both are widely accepted. They differ in coursework, in breadth, and in how much of the grade rests on a single examination period. IB chemistry carries a scientific investigation worth 20% of the grade at both levels, submitted to a school deadline months before the papers. A Level Chemistry has no comparable coursework weighting; its grade comes from examinations.

The second comparison is what the intended degree route actually expects, which families frequently assume rather than check. Medicine commonly expects chemistry and often biology, and the specific requirements differ by country and by institution and are revised. A Valley family with a medicine ambition should be reading the admissions pages of named universities in the first Diploma year, not the second, because the subject and level combination has to be in place before it can be evidenced.

Only after those two comparisons does this page get to the chemistry itself: the two organising themes, Structure and Reactivity, each with three subdivisions, assessed through two written papers, one including a data-based section, plus the internal investigation. Courses are revised periodically, so confirm the current structure with your child's subject teacher rather than taking it from any website, including this one, and ask which components have already been submitted, because anything already banked sits outside what tutoring can reach however good the tutor is.

Delivery is stated plainly: IB Gram does not send tutors to homes anywhere in the UAE, and nobody will arrive at an address in The Valley. Lessons are one-to-one and live over video, with a shared whiteboard for mechanisms, calculations and diagrams. Household visits exist in our India operation only, and nothing on this page should be read as offering one here. For chemistry the format costs very little, because a mechanism drawn step by step on a shared screen is clearer than one drawn upside down across a kitchen table. The format also removes the two car journeys either side of a visit, which in a household where the school run has already taken an hour from the day is the difference between a session a student can use and one they merely attend.

dubai/ib-chemistry-tutor-in-the-valley.programmesIntro: Four stages, and the decisions that matter most are taken before the second Diploma year begins. These are the stages and what each one requires.

programmes.name: Middle Years sciences
programmes.description: Four assessed criteria covering knowledge and understanding, inquiring and designing, processing and evaluating, and reflecting on the impacts of science. Students who score well on knowledge and poorly on processing are building exactly the profile that struggles with the Diploma investigation, since that criterion is its direct ancestor and carries 20% later.
programmes.countryNote: Valley students reach the Middle Years at several different schools, so the timing and style of criterion-marked tasks differs between neighbours. A student aiming at Higher Level chemistry should be watching the processing and evaluating criterion rather than the knowledge one, because that is the skill the Diploma assesses most heavily outside the papers.

programmes.name: Chemistry at Standard Level
programmes.description: Covers Structure and Reactivity at core depth with two written papers and the investigation at 20%. The characteristic Standard Level loss is in calculations rather than concepts: moles arithmetic under time pressure, sign conventions in energetics, and equilibrium questions answered in words when the command term demanded a number.
programmes.countryNote: Standard Level chemistry is a common choice for Dubai students heading towards biological sciences, psychology or business who want a second science. It is more quantitative than most expect, and the data-based section of the written paper assumes graph and uncertainty skills that students rarely practise deliberately.

programmes.name: Chemistry at Higher Level
programmes.description: Extends energetics, equilibrium, acids and bases, redox and organic chemistry substantially. Organic mechanisms are where Higher Level students most often stall, usually because they memorise arrows rather than reason from electron density, and the mathematical load is heavier than Standard Level students expect when they upgrade.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai families usually choose Higher Level chemistry with medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, biochemistry or chemical engineering in view. Requirements differ by country and institution and are revised, so read the admissions pages of the specific universities on the shortlist and check whether a minimum grade rather than just the subject is specified.

programmes.name: A Level Chemistry as the alternative
programmes.description: Examined across papers with a practical endorsement assessed separately rather than contributing a weighted coursework mark, usually taken alongside two or three other A Levels rather than within a six-subject framework. Students who perform well under timed conditions and dislike extended independent writing often do better on this route.
programmes.countryNote: Several schools reachable from The Valley offer A Levels and a few offer both routes, which makes this a live decision for families here rather than a theoretical one. The choice should be made on how the student works rather than on which qualification sounds more rigorous, because both are accepted widely for science degrees.

dubai/ib-chemistry-tutor-in-the-valley.subjectsIntro: The content map by area, with the specific thing that costs marks in each. An enquiry naming an area and a question type produces a far better first session than one describing general difficulty.

subjects.name: Structure 1: models of the particulate nature of matter
subjects.description: Atomic structure, electron configuration, ionisation energies and the mole concept. The mole is where the whole subject either works or does not, and students who are approximate with it lose marks in every later area. Ionisation energy explanations need shielding and nuclear charge named rather than implied.

subjects.name: Structure 2: models of bonding and structure
subjects.description: Ionic, covalent and metallic bonding, intermolecular forces and molecular shapes. The reliable loss is explaining a physical property by naming the wrong force: attributing a boiling point to covalent bond strength when the answer is the intermolecular force being overcome.

subjects.name: Structure 3: classification of matter
subjects.description: Periodicity, the organisation of the periodic table, and spectroscopic identification at Higher Level. Trend questions lose marks when the trend is stated correctly and no reason is given, because the reason is where most of the available marks sit.

subjects.name: Reactivity 1: what drives chemical reactions
subjects.description: Energetics and thermochemistry including enthalpy cycles, with entropy and spontaneity at Higher Level. Sign errors are the single most common loss in the subject: one exothermic value entered as positive invalidates everything downstream even when the method is perfect.

subjects.name: Reactivity 2: how much, how fast and how far
subjects.description: Rates, equilibrium and acid-base behaviour, with substantial Higher Level extension including buffer calculations. Equilibrium questions are frequently answered qualitatively when a numerical answer was demanded, which earns nothing however sound the reasoning.

subjects.name: Reactivity 3: mechanisms of chemical change
subjects.description: Redox and organic chemistry, with mechanisms extended considerably at Higher Level. Mechanism marks are lost by drawing a curly arrow from the wrong species: the arrow must start at an electron pair, and a memorised diagram fails on an unfamiliar substrate.

subjects.name: The scientific investigation
subjects.description: Twenty per cent of the grade, designed and written by the student against published criteria covering research design, data analysis, conclusion and evaluation. The usual cause of a weak mark is a research question producing too few usable data points to analyse properly.

subjects.name: The data-based paper section
subjects.description: Graph work, uncertainty and judging whether a proposed relationship is supported by the data presented. It cannot be revised by rereading notes, which is precisely why it is the part of the paper most often left unrehearsed by otherwise diligent students.

subjects.name: The mathematics inside chemistry
subjects.description: Moles, ratio reasoning, logarithms in pH work, rearranging before substituting, and significant figures matching the data. A meaningful share of lost chemistry marks are arithmetical, and that is diagnosable from marked work rather than a matter of opinion.

subjects.name: Biology and physics alongside chemistry
subjects.description: Most chemistry students take at least one, and the overlap in uncertainty treatment and data handling is direct. Tutoring two sciences in the same term rarely works in a household with a long school run, because the between-session work for both goes undone.

dubai/ib-chemistry-tutor-in-the-valley.modesIntro: Three shapes for chemistry tuition, chosen by whether the obstacle is calculation, mechanism reasoning or the investigation. The commute then decides when each happens.

modes.title: Calculation discipline

sections.heading: IB chemistry against A Level Chemistry, for a family choosing
paragraphs: In most Dubai communities this comparison is academic, because the school a family has chosen settles it. In The Valley it is live, because students travel to schools offering both routes and the decision is frequently still open when a family starts looking for a tutor. Both qualifications are widely accepted for medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, biochemistry and chemical engineering, so the decision should rest on how the student works rather than on which sounds more demanding.

The structural difference is coursework weighting. IB chemistry carries a scientific investigation worth 20% of the grade at both levels, designed and written independently and submitted to a school deadline months before the examinations. A Level Chemistry assesses practical skills through an endorsement rather than as a weighted coursework mark, which means the grade rests overwhelmingly on examination performance. A student who plans and writes well banks a fifth of the grade early on one route; a student who performs best under timed conditions carries less risk on the other.

Breadth is the second difference. The Diploma requires six subjects plus Theory of Knowledge, the Extended Essay and Creativity, Activity, Service, so chemistry sits inside a wide programme with competing deadlines. A Levels usually mean three or four subjects studied more deeply, with fewer simultaneous coursework demands. Neither is better in the abstract. The honest advice is to read the student rather than the qualification, and the table below sets out the dimensions that actually decide it.

sections.heading: What the degree route actually expects
paragraphs: This is where families most often work from assumption, and it is the cheapest thing on this page to check properly. Medicine commonly expects chemistry and frequently biology, and the specific combination, level and minimum grade differ by country and by institution. Chemical engineering typically expects chemistry alongside mathematics and often physics. Pharmacy and biochemistry usually expect chemistry. Veterinary routes vary. None of that is a substitute for reading the published requirements of the specific universities on a shortlist.

The timing is what makes this a first-year task rather than a second-year one. A requirement for Higher Level chemistry can only be met if the student is registered at Higher Level, and once the second Diploma year begins a change of level usually means resetting the investigation as well as the accumulated content. A family that reads the admissions pages in the first term of the first year still has choices; a family that reads them in the second year is working with whatever is already registered.

A second UAE-specific point is worth knowing separately. Ministry of Education equivalency and university admission are different processes, and tutoring is not required for either. The British-track equivalency requirements are published and specific; the IB position should not be quoted as a points figure without a Ministry source, and any website publishing one without it should be treated carefully. Describe the process, cite the authority, and use the official channel rather than relying on a tutoring company's summary.

sections.heading: Structure against Reactivity: two halves that fail differently
paragraphs: The current course is organised around two themes, and comparing them is more useful than listing them, because they fail in different ways and need different work. Structure covers the particulate nature of matter, bonding and structure, and the classification of matter. Its characteristic losses are explanatory: a trend stated without its reason, a property attributed to the wrong force, an ionisation energy answer that implies shielding without naming it.

Reactivity covers what drives reactions, how much and how fast and how far, and the mechanisms of chemical change. Its characteristic losses are procedural and quantitative: a sign error in an enthalpy cycle that invalidates every downstream step, an equilibrium question answered in words when a calculation was required, a curly arrow drawn from the wrong species. These are precision failures rather than gaps in understanding, which is why they respond to enforcement rather than re-teaching.

That distinction matters for how a family spends. A student weak in Structure needs explanation drills: stating the reason, naming the force, using the right language about shielding and nuclear charge. A student weak in Reactivity needs procedural discipline and mechanism reasoning. A tutor who treats chemistry as one undifferentiated subject will spend the term on whichever half they prefer, which is why we ask for marked work covering both before recommending anything. The table below sets the two halves side by side with the failure each produces and the work that corrects it, and it is worth reading with a marked paper in hand rather than from memory.

sections.heading: What students think the problem is, against what it usually is
paragraphs: Chemistry produces a particular kind of misdiagnosis, because the subject feels hard in places where it is not actually failing. Students report organic chemistry as the hardest area and lose more marks in energetics. They report equilibrium as confusing and lose the marks to command-term misreading rather than to the concept. They describe themselves as bad at chemistry when a marked paper shows a consistent arithmetic pattern that has nothing to do with chemical understanding.

This matters because families buy what the student reports. A term spent re-teaching organic chemistry to a student whose actual losses are in moles arithmetic and enthalpy signs changes very little, and both parent and student conclude that tutoring does not work. The remedy is unglamorous: look at a marked paper, classify each lost mark by cause, and address the causes in order of how many marks they account for rather than in order of how difficult they feel.

The table below sets the common misdiagnoses against what the marked work usually shows. It is worth going through with the student rather than for them, because the recognition is what changes behaviour. A student who sees that nine of their fourteen lost marks were sign errors and significant figures tends to accept a fortnight of procedural enforcement, where the same student told they need to work harder at chemistry does not. That recognition is also what makes the following four weeks efficient, because the work then addresses a named cause rather than a feeling about a subject.

sections.heading: The investigation compared with an A Level practical endorsement
paragraphs: This comparison is worth making explicitly, because families moving between routes or choosing between schools often assume the practical requirement is similar. It is not. The IB investigation is an independently designed piece of work worth 20% of the final grade, marked against published criteria, and submitted once to a school deadline. An A Level practical endorsement assesses competence across a set of required activities but does not carry the same weighted contribution to the grade.

The consequence for tutoring is substantial. On the IB route, the single highest-value session in the whole subject is the one that tests whether a research question can be answered by the data a student can realistically collect, because every later criterion depends on usable data. On the A Level route, that session does not exist in the same form, and the equivalent money is better spent on examination technique because that is where the grade is decided.

What applies to both routes is the honesty boundary. A tutor may teach the chemistry, explain what each criterion rewards, question whether a method is reproducible, press on whether a conclusion follows from the results, teach uncertainty treatment on the student's own measurements, and comment on writing the student produced. A tutor may not design the investigation, supply or adjust data, write or redraft any part of the report, or hand over a model to adapt. Data can be fabricated, which is precisely why the line is drawn here.

sections.heading: What chemistry support costs on either route
paragraphs: Published Dubai figures put a qualified subject tutor working online at AED 150 to AED 300 an hour, with one agency advertising IB from AED 200, and IB, IGCSE and A Level specialists at AED 200 to AED 450 and above, with TutorChase publishing AED 270 and one premium provider advertising AED 650. Budget online tutoring runs AED 33 to AED 65, and in-home visits AED 180 to AED 500 once travel is included. Bestimate's monthly estimate for one weekly hour is AED 600 to AED 1,200 mid-market.

Where the two routes differ is in what the money should buy. On the IB route, two sessions scoping the investigation protect a fifth of the grade for a fraction of a term's cost, which is the best-value purchase in the subject and the one most often skipped. On the A Level route, the same money is better spent on examination technique, because the grade rests on the papers and there is no equivalent weighted component to protect.

Both routes share one piece of arithmetic to avoid. A student taking three sciences has three practical requirements and three sets of papers, and three tutored hours a week in a household with a long school run is more between-session work than can be completed. Sequencing by deadline order works better and costs a third as much in any given month. All figures here were read in October 2026 and belong to the companies and rate guides that published them; IB Gram publishes no hourly list and quotes after a free trial.

sections.heading: Academic honesty, materials and what we do not claim
paragraphs: Chemistry makes the honesty question concrete, because an investigation involves data and data can be invented. A tutor may teach the chemistry, explain what each criterion rewards, test whether a research question produces enough usable data, teach uncertainty treatment on the student's own measurements, question whether a conclusion follows from the results, and comment on writing the student produced. A tutor may not design the investigation, supply or adjust data, write or redraft any part of the report, or provide a model to adapt.

One operation in this market sells completed internal assessments at AED 3,750. Buying one is academic misconduct under IB rules and the consequence falls on the candidate, whose diploma is at risk rather than the seller's business. On materials, IB syllabus documents, past papers, mark schemes, data booklets and grade-boundary tables are the IB's copyright; we reference and cite them and work from what the school legitimately holds. We also do not describe tutors as IB examiners without evidenced current status.

On regulators the position is narrow and deliberate. Dubai private schools are overseen by KHDA, which u.ae describes as responsible for enhancing and overseeing the quality of private education in the emirate, with ADEK in Abu Dhabi and Al Ain, SPEA in Sharjah, the Department of Knowledge in Ras Al Khaimah and the federal Ministry of Education in Ajman, Umm Al Quwain and Fujairah. IB Gram holds no permit, approval or partnership from any of them or from the IB, and no UAE office. An individual tutoring privately in the UAE needs a MoHRE private tuition work permit, introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023 and granted free of charge for two years.

sections.heading: Scheduling chemistry around the commute
paragraphs: Chemistry has two kinds of work with different timing needs, which is why one weekly slot sometimes serves a student badly. Calculation drilling benefits from frequency: two short sessions in a week beat one long one, because moles and sign discipline improve through repetition spread across days. Mechanism reasoning and investigation writing need an uninterrupted block, because both involve holding several steps in mind at once and a fragmented hour wastes the setup time.

With no school inside this community, a secondary student is realistically home around a quarter past five and the value of an hour falls noticeably after seven. That makes the practical structure clear: short calculation work on a weekday evening, and mechanism or investigation work in a weekend block. A student doing that is running a better programme than one attempting two tired weekday hours and completing the between-session work for neither.

The UAE calendar shapes the rest. The working week runs Monday to Friday with a half-day Friday, leaving Saturday and Sunday as the only full days. During Ramadan school hours shorten and the useful window moves after Iftar, where a chemistry session is frequently better than any afternoon slot in that month. We hold slots in Gulf Standard Time, move them after Iftar with the same tutor retained, and pause blocks during a school's own examination fortnight rather than adding sessions that produce fatigue. We also keep the same tutor across a term rather than rotating students to fill a diary, because knowing which calculation a particular student rushes under pressure is most of what makes a later session efficient.
