sections.heading: What Standard Level Biology support costs in Dubai
paragraphs: Published market rates in Dubai put a qualified online subject tutor at roughly AED 150-300 an hour and an IB or A Level specialist at roughly AED 200-450 and above, from agency rate pages and Bestimate's Tutoring Cost Dubai 2026 rate table as read in October 2026. Platform rates for university-student tutors advertise from around AED 33-150. In-home visiting rates including travel are quoted at AED 180-500, and a premium named tutor is advertised at up to AED 650 an hour.

Standard Level usually sits in the lower half of the specialist band, because the pool of tutors who can teach it well is larger than the Higher Level pool. Several providers quote one International Baccalaureate rate regardless of level, so it is worth asking directly. Monthly packages visible in this market include AED 799 a month for eight online sessions and AED 1,599-1,799 a month for four two-hour in-home visits.

The more important question for a Group 4 student is total hours rather than hourly rate. A technique block of six to eight sessions at a mid-band rate costs less than a term of weekly content teaching and will usually move the grade further. A provider who recommends a term before seeing any of your child's work is recommending a revenue plan. IB Gram publishes no rate card on this page; the first lesson is free and the rate is agreed in writing before the second.

For household context, KHDA confirmed on 22 May 2026 that private school fees in Dubai would not rise for the 2026-27 academic year, under the emirate's second economic incentives package. Published monthly estimates for weekly one-hour tutoring in this market run from AED 240-600 at the budget end to AED 600-1,200 in the middle band and AED 1,000-2,000 and above for specialist support in an examination year.

sections.heading: Scheduling, coverage and the permit a paid tutor needs
paragraphs: Sessions are booked in Gulf Standard Time against the school's own week, with the mandatory UAE subject periods mapped first. For a Standard Level technique block, weekly works better than fortnightly, because each session builds on a specific drill rather than testing retention. Once the block is finished most families stop, which is the intended outcome rather than a lost customer.

Ramadan shortens the school day and moves the evening. Post-Iftar sessions are available and they work, particularly for drawing and data practice which does not require long sustained concentration. Agreeing the change before Ramadan starts is what makes it work rather than deciding in the first week. Eid is normally a clean pause, and a six-session block simply runs over eight weeks instead of six.

Coverage is disclosed before you book. A Standard Level Biology specialist in a narrow early-evening window is a more specific request than it sounds, and some weeks it cannot be met. The alternatives are a different time with the right specialist, a dated waiting period, or a tutor whose Standard Level experience is adjacent rather than exact, stated plainly so you can judge it yourself. No page reviewed in this market discloses a coverage limit at all.

On the legal position: individuals providing private tuition in the UAE need a MoHRE private tutor work permit, introduced under Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023 and granted free of charge for two years. Eligible applicants include registered school teachers, government and private sector employees, unemployed residents, university students and school students aged 15 to 18. Those tutoring without a permit are subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws, and no schedule of amounts has been published, so none is quoted here. MoHRE's own service page is the official route to apply.

process.title: Describe what goes wrong in one sentence
process.description: Not the grade, the symptom. Knows the definitions and loses marks on long questions. Blank on data figures. Drawings always marked down. That sentence places your child in a row of the question-types table, and the first session is built from it rather than from a syllabus overview.

process.title: Say what Biology is for
process.description: A Group 4 requirement and a points subject needs a different plan from a subject a university offer depends on. We ask this in the first message because the honest recommendation for the first case is often a short block, and that answer is easier to give before anything is booked.

process.title: Free 45-minute first lesson
process.description: One subject, 45 minutes, no card details taken. The student works one data question, one explain question and one drawing, which between them identify the problem. You receive a written note naming the question types to drill and an estimated number of sessions.

process.title: Run the block, then stop
process.description: Technique blocks are finite. Six to eight sessions for the assessment objectives, two or three for drawing and data, and the block closes when the drill holds. Continuing afterwards is a decision to make on new evidence, not a default.

process.title: Test it cold on an unseen paper
process.description: At the end of a block the student sits unseen questions of the same types with no warning and no revision. The mark on those is the evidence. It is more informative than asking whether the student feels more confident, which almost everyone says yes to.

whyPoints.title: Built on question types, not a content tour
whyPoints.description: Most Standard Level Biology marks are lost in application, analysis and evaluation rather than recall. Sessions drill those directly with unfamiliar contexts and unseen figures, which is the work that cannot be done by rereading a textbook at home.

whyPoints.title: Drawing marks treated as marks
whyPoints.description: Biology awards marks for clean lines, correct proportion and annotations written as sentences, and almost nobody teaches it. Two or three sessions covers the whole area, and it is the fastest visible improvement available on the course.

whyPoints.title: Short blocks when short blocks are right
whyPoints.description: A Group 4 points subject rarely needs a term. If six sessions is the honest answer, that is what gets recommended, and the block ends when the drill holds rather than when a subscription runs out.

whyPoints.title: Your school's calendar, not a generic one
whyPoints.description: The deadlines that govern a DP2 Biology student are set by their own school. This page names who controls each one and where to get it, and publishes no unverified IB examination date, because none in this project has been confirmed from the IB directly.

whyPoints.title: The mandatory UAE subjects accounted for
whyPoints.description: Arabic, Islamic Education and Social Studies occupy fixed periods in every Dubai private school week. Those are mapped before a Biology slot is chosen, which is why these bookings survive the October timetable settling.

whyPoints.title: Online, with the reason stated once

faqs.question: How much of Standard Level Biology is memorising and how much is applying?
faqs.answer: Far less memorising than students assume. The Diploma science guides set objectives covering knowledge, understanding and application, analysis and evaluation, and investigation skills, and only the first is satisfied by learning definitions. Multiple-choice items usually require a fact applied to a new case. Data questions give unfamiliar figures. Paper 2 extended responses want a mechanism in sequence, a linked comparison or a judgement. A student who can define everything and scores a 4 has banked the recall marks and missed most of the rest, which is a technique problem rather than a knowledge one.

faqs.question: Are marks really awarded for biological drawings, and how are they lost?
faqs.answer: Yes, and they are lost mostly to presentation rather than biology. Examiners expect clean single lines rather than sketchy double ones, proportions that match what was observed, and no shading. Students who have never been told this draw as they would in a notebook and lose marks with the biology entirely correct. Add the magnification and scale calculations, which go wrong on unit conversion between micrometres and millimetres more often than on method. Two or three sessions covers the whole area and it shows up on the next assessment.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a label and an annotation in a Biology drawing?
faqs.answer: A label names a structure. An annotation says something about it: what it does, a property it has, how it relates to another structure. Mark schemes specify which is wanted, and a student writing labels where annotations were required has answered a different question and scores accordingly. The practical fix is to teach annotations as sentences rather than as words, which takes about twenty minutes and then needs practising on four or five different drawings before it becomes the default.

faqs.question: My son can define everything and still scores a 4. What is going wrong?
faqs.answer: He is almost certainly answering the topic rather than the question. The commonest pattern in marked Standard Level scripts is a comparison question answered as two separate descriptions, and an evaluation question answered either by accepting the method or by listing every limitation that comes to mind. Mark schemes award for linked differences on the same axis, and for the limitations that matter to the conclusion, ranked. The content he has is sufficient; the organisation of the answer is what is costing the marks, and it is a few sessions of drilling rather than a term.

faqs.question: How much less content does Standard Level Biology cover than Higher Level?
faqs.answer: Ninety taught hours less, 150 against 240, and twenty fewer practical hours. Standard Level covers the common core of themes A to D and omits the Higher Level extensions, which cluster in cell respiration and photosynthesis in detail, neural signalling, gene expression and inheritance with linkage. Standard Level papers also run ninety minutes each rather than two hours and two and a half. The investigation is identical: same four criteria, same twenty-four marks, same share of the grade, which regularly catches families expecting something lighter.

faqs.question: What does a Standard Level Biology tutor charge in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Market rates for a qualified subject tutor working online in Dubai run roughly AED 150-300 an hour, with International Baccalaureate and A Level specialists at roughly AED 200-450 and above, from published agency rate pages and Bestimate's Tutoring Cost Dubai 2026 table as read in October 2026. Platform rates for university-student tutors start near AED 33-150. Standard Level usually sits in the lower half of the specialist band because the tutor pool is larger, and several providers quote one rate for both levels, so it is worth asking directly before accepting a figure.

faqs.question: There are three weeks until a school assessment. What is still worth doing?
faqs.answer: Triage, not coverage. Three weeks is enough to drill two or three question types and to fix drawing technique, and not enough to repair a term of content. The useful sequence is: get the assessment's stated content, identify which question types carry the most marks in it, practise those with unseen material, and explicitly abandon the rest. Writing down what you are not going to revise is the part students resist and the part that makes the plan work. One timed section should be sat before the day so pacing is known.

faqs.question: Can the Standard Level investigation use data from a database instead of a laboratory?
faqs.answer: Yes, and inside a 40-hour practical budget with shared laboratory access it is often the better choice. A database or secondary-data investigation can produce far stronger evidence than a thin wet-lab data set collected across two rushed periods, provided the data source is properly identified and all the processing and reasoning are the student's own. The criteria do not favour one approach over the other; they reward a design that can actually answer the question. This is worth deciding before the research question is finalised, not afterwards.

faqs.question: How do Arabic and Islamic Education lessons affect a Diploma student's week in Dubai?
faqs.answer: They occupy fixed periods that sit outside the six Diploma subjects. Dubai private schools teach Arabic, Islamic Education and Social or Moral Studies regardless of the international curriculum they are licensed to deliver, and KHDA requires separate classes for Arab and non-Arab students in Arabic as a first language, Islamic Education and Social Studies. Instructional time is calculated on a 40-minute lesson unit. The practical effect is that those periods determine which evenings are genuinely free, so they should be mapped before a tutoring slot is chosen.

faqs.question: Which deadlines does a DP2 Biology student actually have to meet?
faqs.answer: Mostly ones the school sets: research question approval, data collection, the investigation draft, the final internal submission, the mock examination window and the issuing of predicted grades. The IB sets the examination session and the release of results. This page publishes no IB date, because automated access to the IB's own pages is blocked and no session date in this project has been confirmed from the IB directly. Ask your Diploma coordinator in September for the school's calendar in writing, then work the autumn backwards from the draft deadline.

faqs.question: Is Standard Level Biology accepted for nursing or other health degrees?
faqs.answer: Frequently yes, but it depends entirely on the programme and the country. Nursing, nutrition, physiotherapy, public health and several biomedical routes list Biology at Standard Level as acceptable, sometimes with Chemistry alongside it. Medicine, dentistry, pharmacy and veterinary science generally require Higher Level sciences. Requirements vary between institutions and are revised between cycles, so the only reliable source is each university's current admissions page. Tutoring does not change a published prerequisite, and it is not required for any application.

faqs.question: Does a Standard Level student need to learn the statistics as well?
faqs.answer: Yes, though a smaller set than at Higher Level. Standard deviation for spread, standard error and error bars for confidence in a mean, correlation for the strength of a relationship, and the reciprocal diversity index in ecology. These appear in the data-based section of Paper 1 and in the investigation's data analysis criterion. Most marks are lost not in the calculation but in the sentence afterwards, where a student claims more than the statistic permits. One or two sessions covers what a Standard Level candidate needs.

faqs.question: Our school marks harshly. Should we worry about the predicted grade?
faqs.answer: It is worth understanding rather than worrying about. Predicted grades come from internal assessment data, and schools differ in how severely they set internal papers and how they weight components. The practical move is to ask which past papers the internal examinations were built from and how Paper 1 and Paper 2 marks were combined in the reported grade. With that known, the tutoring hours can be put where the weighting is heaviest. No tutor can promise a grade change, and a provider who offers one on a timetable is describing something they cannot control.

faqs.question: Can one tutor take both Standard Level Biology and Geography?
faqs.answer: Often, and the pairing is more sensible than it looks. Both subjects reward reading a figure, quoting a value or trend from it, and writing a conclusion that is evaluated rather than asserted. A student losing marks on Biology data questions is usually losing them on Geography resource questions for the same reason, and one block of work addresses both. Where it does not work is when one subject needs content teaching and the other needs technique, since those are different specialisms. Describe the symptom in each and the matching follows.

faqs.question: What if we need to stop after two sessions?
faqs.answer: Then you stop. Sessions here are booked as blocks or as individual hours rather than as a subscription, and nothing continues automatically. If the first two sessions show that the problem is smaller than expected, or that the fit is wrong, saying so is a reasonable outcome and the written note after each session is designed to make that judgement possible early. The free first lesson exists for the same reason: a diagnosis before a commitment, with no card details collected at that stage.

faqs.question: Does the Ministry of Education require anything particular from a Biology grade?
faqs.answer: Equivalency is a Ministry of Education process and it is not something a tutoring provider performs, influences or guarantees. For the British curriculum route the published requirement is five accredited GCSE or IGCSE subjects at no less than grade E or 3, with Arabic and Islamic education excluded from that count, plus one Advanced Level subject at no less than E or two Advanced Subsidiary subjects at the same grade. No verified International Baccalaureate points threshold has been read on the ministry's own pages, so none is published here. Confirm current requirements with the ministry directly.

dubai/ib-dp-biology-sl-online-tutor.closingHeading: Tell us the symptom, not the grade
dubai/ib-dp-biology-sl-online-tutor.closingBody: Standard Level Biology problems are usually narrower and cheaper to fix than the grade suggests. Send one sentence describing what actually goes wrong, say whether Biology is a points subject or a target subject, and take the free 45-minute first lesson. Your child works one data question, one explain question and one drawing, which is enough to name the question types to drill and the number of sessions it should take. If that number is six, you will be told six, and the block will end when the drill holds.

intro.heading: What a Biology SL tutor in Dubai costs, and what the money actually buys
paragraphs: Start with the number, because every parent in Dubai starts with the number and most tutoring sites refuse to print one. Rates read from live UAE tutoring pages in October 2026 put budget online help at AED 45 to AED 150 an hour, a qualified subject teacher at AED 150 to AED 300, an IB or IGCSE specialist at AED 200 to AED 450, an in-home visit at AED 180 to AED 500 with the drive inside the fee, and named or examiner-tier tutors above AED 500. Those are market rates from other providers, with the band and the source named, not an IB Gram price list. What IB Gram does is match a Biology SL specialist to your child and let a trial lesson settle whether the teaching is worth a block.

The spread between AED 150 and AED 450 for the same hour is not a mystery and it is not mostly brand. It is five or six concrete variables, and a Dubai family can move four of them deliberately. Session length changes the per-hour figure. The distance between your community and the tutor changes it, because an in-home hour in Arabian Ranches carries a drive from Al Barsha or Business Bay that somebody pays for. Proximity to the May session changes it, since specialist diaries in this city fill from January and a late booking buys whatever is left at the top of the band. Whether your child needs syllabus teaching or criterion-level work on the scientific investigation changes it most of all, because those are different skills and a generalist cannot fake the second one.

Dubai is also the place where this calculation matters most, because the private-school market here is the densest in the country. KHDA, the Knowledge and Human Development Authority, oversees the quality of private education in the emirate, and in 2024-25 the sector ran 387,441 students across 227 private schools offering 17 curricula. The Diploma Programme accounts for about 7 per cent of that enrolment, with UK-curriculum schools at 37 per cent, Indian at 26 per cent and American at 14 per cent. Seven more private schools open for 2026-27, three of them International Baccalaureate, adding 16,846 places. So the pool of Biology SL students is growing faster than the pool of teachers who have actually examined the course.

One more piece of local context belongs in a cost conversation. KHDA confirmed in May 2026 that private-school fees in Dubai will not rise for the 2026-27 academic year, under an economic incentives package the Dubai Media Office valued at AED 1.5 billion within a AED 2.5 billion total. That freeze is the only fixed line in a Dubai education budget this year, which is why families are reading tutoring quotes more carefully than they did in 2024. A page that answers the cost question honestly, with the band, the source and the date, is more useful than one that asks you to request a callback to find out.

dubai/ib-dp-biology-sl-tutor.programmesIntro: Three programmes feed a Biology SL result in Dubai: the Diploma Programme itself, the Middle Years Programme that is supposed to prepare students for it, and the IGCSE year that many Dubai students arrive from instead. The gap between what each one trains and what Biology SL rewards is where most of the lost marks live.

programmes.name: Diploma Programme
programmes.description: Biology at standard level runs across the two Diploma years and is assessed by two written papers and one scientific investigation. Paper 1 pairs multiple-choice questions with a data-based section and carries 36% of the grade. Paper 2 is short-answer and extended-response work at 44%. The investigation is the remaining 20%, marked out of 24 against four criteria. Standard level is not a lighter version of the same exam: it is a shorter syllabus assessed with the same command terms and the same marking severity.
programmes.countryNote: In Dubai, Biology SL is usually chosen by students whose university target is not medicine, which means the subject is competing for revision time against a higher-level science and a higher-level maths. That is the pattern a tutor has to plan around here. Sessions that try to re-teach the whole syllabus waste a Dubai student's scarcest resource. The useful plan picks the two or three topics that carry the most Paper 2 marks for that student, and treats the investigation as a separate project with its own timeline.

programmes.name: Middle Years Programme
programmes.description: MYP Sciences is assessed against four criteria: knowing and understanding, inquiring and designing, processing and evaluating, and reflecting on the impacts of science. Students arrive in DP1 fluent in inquiry language and often weak on recall under time pressure, because the MYP rarely asks for twenty marks of precise biological detail in forty minutes. The transition subject is not content, it is examination discipline.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai runs a large number of full IB continuum schools, so a significant share of Biology SL students here have never sat a terminal written paper before DP1 mocks. Families in Mirdif and Al Barsha whose children came up through an MYP school see the same symptom: strong investigation design, thin Paper 1 recall. A tutor working with that profile should spend early sessions on timed recall and command-term precision, and leave inquiry skills alone, because those are already the student's strength.

programmes.name: IGCSE and British Year 11
programmes.description: Most British-curriculum students in Dubai reach the Diploma from Cambridge IGCSE Biology 0610 or a Pearson International GCSE equivalent. Those courses reward accurate recall of defined content and a tight practical-skills set. Biology SL then asks for the same recall plus explanation across topics, plus an independent investigation designed from nothing. Students who scored a 9 or an A* at IGCSE are frequently the ones most surprised by their first DP1 Paper 2 mark.
programmes.countryNote: UK-curriculum schools hold the largest share of Dubai's private-school enrolment, which makes the IGCSE-to-SL step the single most common tutoring brief in this city. The gap to close is specific: naming a variable versus justifying its range, describing a trend versus explaining a mechanism, and writing to a command term instead of writing everything known. Six to eight focused sessions in DP1 usually close more of that gap than a year of weekly homework supervision.

dubai/ib-dp-biology-sl-tutor.subjectsIntro: Biology SL is rarely tutored alone in Dubai. The subjects below are the ones that sit next to it on a Diploma timetable here, and each carries its own failure pattern. A tutor who knows which of these is actually dragging the points total is worth more than one who simply teaches the subject you asked about.

subjects.name: Biology
subjects.description: Two written papers and one scientific investigation at both levels. Standard level drops the higher-level extension content but keeps the command terms and the 24-mark investigation. Marks are lost on explanation questions where students describe a trend rather than give a mechanism.

subjects.name: Chemistry
subjects.description: Shares the investigation structure with Biology and the same four criteria, so a student taking both can be coached once on investigation design and twice on content. Dubai students most often lose marks on energetics and equilibrium reasoning rather than on calculation.

subjects.name: Environmental Systems and Societies
subjects.description: Interdisciplinary, available as either a science or an individuals-and-societies choice. Students who found Biology SL content heavy sometimes move here in DP1. The assessment rewards systems reasoning and named case studies, which is a different writing discipline from Biology Paper 2.

subjects.name: Sports, Exercise and Health Science
subjects.description: Overlaps Biology on physiology, energy systems and data handling. A student taking both can reuse one set of statistics skills across two investigations. Marks go missing where answers stay descriptive instead of linking structure to measured performance.

subjects.name: Psychology
subjects.description: Shares the biological approach to behaviour with Biology SL, including hormones, neurotransmitters and genetics. The examination style is different: command terms demand studies, dates and evaluation rather than labelled mechanisms, and that switch catches science-strong students.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation
subjects.description: The statistics content here is what a Biology investigation actually needs: correlation, standard deviation, error bars and significance testing. Students taking Biology SL alongside Analysis and Approaches often have the weaker statistical toolkit for their own data analysis criterion.

subjects.name: Physics
subjects.description: Timetabled against Biology in most Dubai IB schools. Shares graph-skills and uncertainty treatment, which transfer directly into the Biology data-based section of Paper 1. Students lose marks there on uncertainty and significant figures, not on biology.

subjects.name: Theory of Knowledge
subjects.description: The TOK exhibition and essay sit on the same DP calendar as the Biology investigation, usually in the same term. Families who plan tutoring around one deadline and ignore the other end up paying for emergency sessions in both subjects in the same fortnight.

subjects.name: Extended Essay
subjects.description: A Biology extended essay is a separate 4,000-word project with its own supervision rules and its own research question standard. Support here is process coaching and feedback on the student's own drafts, never drafting or completion of the work itself.

subjects.name: Arabic as an additional language
subjects.description: Required in Dubai private schools alongside the licensed curriculum, with KHDA requiring separate classes for Arabs and non-Arabs. It takes real timetable space in DP1, which is why a Biology plan built for a Dubai student has fewer free evenings than one built for a student abroad.

dubai/ib-dp-biology-sl-tutor.regionsIntro: Where a Dubai family lives changes the economics of tutoring more than it changes the teaching. The six communities below cover most of our Biology SL enquiries in the emirate, and each one has a different commute problem, a different school cluster and a different realistic session time.

regions.name: Dubai Marina and JLT
regions.note: High-rise families whose children are driven out to school in The Meadows, Al Barsha or Al Sufouh. A 4pm session is unrealistic on a school-run day; 6.30pm and 7.30pm slots fill first, and an online lesson removes a tutor's 40-minute return drive from the bill.

regions.name: Al Barsha and Al Sufouh
regions.note: The densest IB cluster in the emirate, with several Diploma schools inside a few kilometres. Tutor supply is best here and in-home rates are closest to online rates, because the drive is short. It is also where sibling bookings in the same building are most common.

regions.name: Arabian Ranches, Mudon and Dubai Hills Estate
regions.note: Villa communities where an in-home tutor adds a 35 to 50 minute drive each way along Al Qudra or Hessa Street. That drive is the single clearest reason an online hour in these communities buys more teaching for the same AED figure than an in-home hour does.

regions.name: Mirdif and Al Warqa
regions.note: Served by IB continuum schools and by Diploma schools in Al Garhoud, so students here often come up through an MYP rather than an IGCSE. The usual Biology SL brief in Mirdif is recall and timed-paper discipline rather than investigation design.

regions.name: Jumeirah, Umm Suqeim and Al Jaddaf
regions.note: Established British and IB schools along the coast and one bilingual IB school inland. Afternoon traffic on Jumeirah Beach Road and Al Wasl shapes session timing far more than distance does, which is why evening online slots dominate here.

regions.name: Business Bay, Downtown and Dubai Silicon Oasis
regions.note: Apartment families with long school commutes in both directions. Students here frequently reach home after 4.30pm, so a 90-minute lesson at 6pm covers more ground than two 60-minute lessons squeezed either side of the commute.

schoolClusters.city: Jumeirah, Umm Suqeim and Al Jaddaf
schoolClusters.note: Coastal and inland schools running the Diploma alongside strong British provision. Biology SL students from this cluster are often the ones who sat Cambridge IGCSE 0610 two years earlier, which makes the recall-to-explanation gap the dominant tutoring brief.

schoolClusters.note: Villa-belt and eastern Dubai schools where the drive, not the subject, decides how tutoring is delivered. The useful question is not which tier is cheapest but which tier can do the job in front of you. A student who is three months from the May papers and losing marks on explanation questions in Paper 2 needs somebody who has marked Paper 2 answers. A DP1 student who needs weekly structure and homework accountability does not. Paying specialist rates for homework supervision is the most common way Dubai families overspend on tutoring, and paying generalist rates for criterion-level investigation work is the most common way they waste a term.

Read the band alongside two other numbers before deciding. Monthly packages visible in this market run around AED 799 a month for eight online sessions and AED 1,599 to AED 1,799 a month for four two-hour in-home sessions. sections.heading: Six things that move the AED number in this emirate
paragraphs: The gap between the bottom and the top of the Dubai band is made of six specific variables, and a family can control four of them. None of this is unique knowledge inside the industry; it is simply never written down on a tutoring page, because the page would rather you call and ask. The table sets each variable against its direction of travel and the reason it bites harder in Dubai than it would in a smaller market.

Two of the six deserve a note. The first is the drive. An in-home hour in Arabian Ranches, Mudon or Dubai Hills carries a 35 to 50 minute approach each way along Al Qudra or Hessa Street, and that time is inside the fee whether the invoice itemises it or not. At AED 300 an hour, a tutor who spends 90 minutes driving for a 60-minute lesson is being paid for 150 minutes of their day by somebody. Online delivery removes that line from the arithmetic entirely, which is why the same AED figure buys measurably more teaching in the villa communities than it does in Al Barsha.

The second is timing. Specialist diaries in Dubai close from January onwards for a May session, because every DP2 cohort in the emirate reaches the same conclusion in the same fortnight. A family booking in March is buying from whatever is left, usually at the top of the band, and often with a tutor who is not a Biology specialist at all. Booking the same support in October costs less per hour and produces more, because there is time for the work to compound. That is the one lever in the list that both saves money and improves the result.

sections.heading: Biology SL assessment: two papers, one investigation, and where the marks go
paragraphs: Biology at standard level is assessed by Paper 1, Paper 2 and one scientific investigation. Paper 1 runs for an hour and a half and splits into a multiple-choice section and a data-based section, together worth 36% of the grade. Paper 2 also runs an hour and a half, mixes short-answer with extended-response questions, and carries 44%. The investigation is worth the remaining 20% and is marked out of 24. The course structure follows the Biology guide with first assessment in 2025, and a family should confirm the exact component timings for their child's cohort with the school's Diploma coordinator, because schools sit different sessions.

The distribution tells a tutor where to work. Paper 2 is the largest single block of marks and the one most responsive to teaching, because it rewards a writing discipline rather than raw recall. The command term sets the task: state wants a fact, outline wants a brief account, explain wants a mechanism with a cause, distinguish wants a pairwise contrast, and evaluate wants a judgement supported both ways. Students who write everything they know about a topic and hope the marks are in there somewhere are the single most common profile we see in Dubai, and it is a fixable one.

The data-based section of Paper 1 is the quiet mark thief. It asks students to read an unfamiliar graph or table from real research and reason from it, which is a skill the MYP trains well and IGCSE trains narrowly. Students who came through Cambridge IGCSE Biology 0610 are often fluent on content and shaky on uncertainty, error bars and significance. Those are maths habits rather than biology knowledge, which is why a student taking Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation alongside Biology SL frequently outperforms a stronger biologist on this section.

sections.heading: The scientific investigation, criterion by criterion
paragraphs: Twenty per cent of the Biology SL grade is one piece of work the student designs, runs and writes alone, marked out of 24 against four criteria of six marks each: research design, data analysis, conclusion and evaluation. Nobody in the competitor set names a single criterion, which is strange, because the criteria are where the marks are and they are published. A parent who knows that conclusion and evaluation are twelve of the twenty-four marks will never again accept a draft that stops at a graph.

Research design is lost early and lost quietly. A research question that cannot be answered within the available time, equipment and word count is a six-mark problem disguised as enthusiasm. Dubai students with access to a well-equipped school laboratory often over-reach here, while students planning a database or secondary-data investigation under-specify their variables. The fix is a single session, before any data is collected, spent narrowing the question and writing the variables down with units and ranges.

Data analysis and evaluation are where tutoring earns its fee. Analysis wants processed data, appropriate statistics, uncertainty treated honestly and graphs that answer the question. Evaluation wants the student to name the specific weaknesses of their own method and propose realistic improvements, not generic ones about human error. Conclusion wants an answer to the original question, with reference to the data and to the accepted biology. A tutor can question, challenge and point at the criterion; the student writes every word. That boundary is the difference between legitimate support and an academic-honesty breach.

The case for video delivery in this emirate is not a compromise argument. A family in Mudon choosing in-home is choosing from tutors willing to drive to Mudon, which is a much smaller group than the set of Biology SL specialists available at 7pm Gulf Standard Time. There are real advantages on the other side, and pretending otherwise is why most comparison tables are useless. paragraphs: No competitor page in this cluster names a session, a deadline or a results date. That is the easiest gap in the Dubai market to fill, with one caution: IB session and results dates in this project are not verified, because ibo.org blocks automated checking. UAE schools sit the May session, and the milestones below are expressed as windows relative to it rather than as dates. The principle that catches families out is that entry deadlines sit months before the examinations, set by the board and administered by the school registrar rather than by the student. Counting the Cambridge June series backwards makes the gap visible: the papers themselves sit in June, forecast grades are collected well ahead of them, and final entries close earlier still, in the spring, on a date the centre receives in writing rather than one a family should assume. A school that misses the entry window has no remedy, and the candidate's next opportunity is the November series rather than a later date in the same term. Cambridge also allocates every centre to one of six administrative zones and states that it cannot accept responsibility for candidates who sit the wrong zone timetable, which is the same category of error as a missed entry: administrative, avoidable and unforgiving.

Working backwards also fixes the tutoring budget question from the previous section. If the investigation draft is due early in DP2 and mocks land before it, then the sensible order is investigation support first and paper technique second, not the reverse. Families who book in the eight weeks before the papers are buying the most expensive hours in the Dubai market to fix problems that were cheaper to fix in the autumn. The calendar, not the rate card, is what actually controls what tutoring costs a Dubai household across two Diploma years.

sections.heading: Academic honesty: what a Biology tutor may and may not touch
paragraphs: One provider in this market sells completed Internal Assessments. That is an academic-integrity breach, it triggers IB malpractice procedures, and the student carries the consequence, not the seller. A Dubai family paying for Biology SL support deserves the boundary written down, because it is the question most parents are too polite to ask directly and the one that decides whether the money spent protects the Diploma or threatens it.

Here is the line. A tutor may teach the biology, explain what a criterion rewards, ask why a variable was chosen, point out that an evaluation is generic, show how uncertainty is normally treated, read a draft the student wrote and return written feedback on it, and teach the student how to act on their teacher's comments. A tutor may not write the research question, write or rewrite any part of the investigation, supply data, produce graphs for the student to paste in, edit the text to a finished state, or draft any part of an extended essay or TOK essay. Support is teaching, questioning and feedback on the student's own work.

That boundary is also a practical test of a tutor you are considering. Ask what happens if your child sends a draft two days before the school deadline. A legitimate answer describes feedback against the criteria and the student doing the next version. An answer that promises to fix it, polish it or take care of it is describing something the IB treats as malpractice. Keep every draft and every feedback note, because a documented trail of the student's own progression is the best protection available if a question is ever raised.

paragraphs: A tutoring rate means little until it sits next to the rest of a Dubai education budget. The one fixed point this year is the fee freeze: KHDA confirmed in May 2026 that private-school fees in the emirate will not increase for 2026-27, under an incentives package the Dubai Media Office valued at AED 1.5 billion within a AED 2.5 billion total. Against a flat school fee, tutoring is the variable line, and the arithmetic below shows what each pattern of support actually adds per month at the mid-band rate.

The numbers in the table are arithmetic on the market rates in the first section, not an IB Gram price list. They assume four sessions a month, because a weekly lesson in a UAE school term is four lessons in most months. What the arithmetic shows is that the difference between one lesson a week and two is larger than most families expect across two Diploma years, and that a four-session investigation block is a much smaller commitment than a year of weekly support while addressing the component worth 20% of the grade.

Two further lines belong in the budget and are usually forgotten. The first is examination entry, which for a school candidate is administered through the school and appears on a school invoice rather than a tutoring one. The second is the cost of a late decision: specialist availability in Dubai tightens from January for a May session, so a family that waits pays the upper end of the band for the hours that remain. Planning the block in October is the cheapest version of the same support, and the one with time to work.

sections.heading: Permits, verification and what a Dubai parent can actually check
paragraphs: Private tutoring in the UAE is regulated by permit, and this is worth knowing before any money changes hands. The MoHRE private tuition work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023. It is granted free of charge for two years, and eligible applicants include teachers registered in government or private schools, employees in the government and private sectors, unemployed individuals, school students aged 15 to 18, and university students. Anyone providing private tutoring without a permit from MoHRE is subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws. No fine schedule is published, so no amount should be quoted to you as fact.

The application route is public: MoHRE's own service page is titled Issuance of a New Work Permit - Private Tutor Licensing, lists no fee and a two-working-day completion time, and is used through the MoHRE smart app, website and e-services system. A parent can ask a prospective tutor directly whether they hold the permit. A legitimate tutor will answer plainly. A provider who cannot explain the permit, or who implies tutoring is unregulated, has told you something useful about how they operate.

Two further checks are worth making. In Abu Dhabi, ADEK's professional-ethics rules for private and charter school staff prohibit teachers from paid private tutoring of students enrolled at their own school, and the MoHRE permit's code of conduct also bars serving students affiliated with the tutor's own school; treat that as press-reported and verify it against current policy. Separately, a tutoring operation with premises and staff in Dubai needs a KHDA Educational Services Permit for a training institute, which is a specific licence issued to institutions with a physical centre. IB Gram does not hold a regulator licence of that kind, does not operate a UAE centre, and makes no claim of approval or endorsement by KHDA, ADEK, SPEA, MoHRE, the Ministry of Education, the IB, Cambridge or Pearson.

faqs.question: How much does an IB DP Biology SL tutor in Dubai charge per hour?
faqs.answer: Market rates read from live UAE tutoring pages in October 2026 put an IB specialist at roughly AED 200 to AED 450 an hour online, a qualified subject teacher at AED 150 to AED 300, and budget or university-student help at AED 45 to AED 150. In-home visits run AED 180 to AED 500 because the drive sits inside the fee, and named or examiner-tier tutors advertise above AED 500. Those are other providers' published figures with the date attached, not an IB Gram price list. For our own cost, the trial lesson and the written plan that follows it are where the conversation happens, because what a student needs decides how many hours are sensible.

faqs.question: Is Biology SL easier than Biology HL, or just shorter?
faqs.answer: Shorter, not softer. Standard level drops the higher-level extension content, so there is less to learn, but the command terms, the marking severity and the investigation criteria are the same. Paper 2 still rewards mechanism over description at both levels, and the investigation is still marked out of 24 on research design, data analysis, conclusion and evaluation. Students who choose standard level expecting a gentler exam are the ones most often surprised by their first DP1 Paper 2 mark. The genuine difference for a Dubai family is timetable pressure: standard level leaves more room for a higher-level science or maths, which is usually why it was chosen.

faqs.question: How many hours of Biology SL tutoring does a Dubai student usually need before the May session?
faqs.answer: It depends on which component is losing marks, which is why a trial lesson comes before any block is quoted. Two patterns recur in Dubai. A student who needs the investigation fixed usually needs a focused block of about four sessions, placed in the term before the school's internal deadline rather than the week of it. A student whose content is sound but whose Paper 2 answers wander usually needs weekly work across a term, because writing to a command term is a habit rather than a fact. Families who start in the autumn generally buy fewer hours in total than families who start in March, because there is time for the work to compound.

faqs.question: What is the scientific investigation worth in Biology SL and how is it marked?
faqs.answer: It carries 20% of the standard-level grade and is marked out of 24 against four criteria worth six marks each: research design, data analysis, conclusion and evaluation. That split is worth knowing, because conclusion and evaluation together are half the marks and they are the two sections students most often rush. Research design is usually lost before any data is collected, through a question too broad for the time and equipment available. Evaluation is lost through generic statements about human error rather than specific weaknesses of the method actually used. Confirm current requirements and word limits with your school's Diploma coordinator, since schools sit different sessions.

faqs.question: Can a tutor help with my daughter's Biology IA without breaking IB academic honesty rules?
faqs.answer: Yes, within a clear boundary. A tutor may teach the biology, explain what each criterion rewards, question why a variable was chosen, show how uncertainty is normally handled, read a draft your daughter wrote and return written feedback she then acts on herself. A tutor may not write the research question, draft or rewrite any section, supply data, produce graphs for her to paste in, or edit the text to a finished state. One provider in this market sells completed Internal Assessments, which triggers IB malpractice procedures and puts the student's Diploma at risk. Keep dated drafts and feedback notes as evidence of her own progression.

faqs.question: Why does my son score well in Biology SL class tests but drop marks in Paper 2?
faqs.answer: Almost always because class tests reward recall and Paper 2 rewards answering the exact question asked. The command term sets the task: state wants a fact, outline wants a brief account, explain wants a mechanism with a cause, distinguish wants a pairwise contrast, and evaluate wants a judgement argued both ways. A student who writes everything he knows about respiration will score well on a recall test and lose half the marks on an explain question. This is the most common and most fixable profile we see in Dubai. It usually takes a term of marked timed questions rather than more content teaching.

faqs.question: Does IB Gram send a Biology tutor to our villa in Dubai?
faqs.answer: No. IB Gram does not send tutors to homes anywhere in the UAE, and we do not operate a centre in Dubai. Lessons for Dubai families run one-to-one over live video on Gulf Standard Time, with screen sharing so the tutor can annotate your child's own data tables, graphs and marked papers. Home visits are a service we offer only in India. The practical benefit of video delivery here is the choice it opens: instead of picking from tutors willing to drive to your community, you pick from the Biology SL specialists free at the hour you need, which for a niche requirement decides whether the right tutor exists at all.

faqs.question: Which Dubai schools teach Biology SL as part of the IB Diploma?
faqs.answer: Diploma provision in Dubai clusters in three places. Al Barsha, Al Sufouh and Dubai Hills hold the densest group, including GEMS World Academy Dubai, Dubai American Academy, Nord Anglia International School Dubai, Dwight School Dubai and Kings' School Al Barsha. Along the coast and inland sit Emirates International School Jumeirah, Swiss International Scientific School Dubai, Jumeirah English Speaking School and Deira International School. In the villa belt and eastern communities are Jumeirah English Speaking School Arabian Ranches, Uptown International School, Fairgreen International School and Greenfield International School. These names are context for where the course runs; IB Gram has no affiliation with any of them.

faqs.question: Do private Biology tutors in Dubai need a permit from MoHRE?
faqs.answer: Yes. The private tuition work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, is granted free of charge for two years, and covers teachers registered in government or private schools, government and private-sector employees, unemployed residents, school students aged 15 to 18 and university students. Anyone tutoring without it is subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws, though no fine schedule is published, so treat any quoted amount with caution. Applications go through MoHRE's own service, listed as Issuance of a New Work Permit - Private Tutor Licensing, with no fee and a stated two-working-day completion time. Ask a prospective tutor directly whether they hold it.

faqs.question: My child is moving from IGCSE Biology 0610 to Biology SL - what is the real gap?
faqs.answer: Three specific things, none of them extra content. First, explanation: IGCSE often accepts a correct description where standard level wants a mechanism with a cause. Second, independence: the investigation asks a student to design something from nothing, including the research question, which no IGCSE practical requires. Third, data handling: the data-based section of Paper 1 uses unfamiliar research graphs and expects honest treatment of uncertainty and significance. Students who scored a 9 or an A* at IGCSE are frequently the ones most surprised by their first DP1 Paper 2 mark, because the habit that produced the top IGCSE grade now actively costs marks.

faqs.question: How does Biology SL tutoring work during Ramadan in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Schedules move rather than stop. School days shorten across the UAE during Ramadan, energy levels change, and evening slots that worked in January stop working. Most families we work with move to shorter morning sessions at the weekend or to lessons well after iftar, and some pause for a fortnight and resume with a longer block. What matters academically is that Ramadan usually falls close to the mock window for a May session, so the term before should carry the heavier content teaching. Agreeing the Ramadan pattern in advance, rather than cancelling week by week, is what keeps a plan intact.

faqs.question: Is Biology SL enough for a medicine application from Dubai?
faqs.answer: Often not, and this is worth checking early rather than in DP2. Many medical schools in the UK, Ireland, Australia and the Gulf ask for Chemistry and frequently Biology at higher level, and some specify minimum higher-level points. Requirements differ by university and by intake year, so the only reliable answer is the one on the admissions page of each university your child is targeting, read this year. If medicine is the target and Biology sits at standard level, the level conversation needs to happen with the school's Diploma coordinator while a change is still possible, usually early in DP1.

faqs.question: Does an IB Diploma count for UAE Ministry of Education equivalency?
faqs.answer: Equivalency is assessed by the Ministry of Education and the rules differ by curriculum, so the honest answer is to verify your child's case on moe.gov.ae or with the emirate attestation authority. What is published for the British track is specific: five accredited subjects at GCSE or IGCSE with a grade no lower than E or grade 3, with Arabic and Islamic education excluded from that count, plus one accredited Advanced Level subject at E or two Advanced Subsidiary subjects at the same grade. No IB points threshold has been confirmed from an official source, so we do not publish one. IB Gram does not perform or guarantee equivalency; it is a ministry process.

faqs.question: How soon can Biology SL lessons start after we enquire?
faqs.answer: Usually within a few days outside the peak window, because matching is limited by specialist availability rather than by geography. From January onwards, for a May session, that changes: Diploma cohorts across the emirate compete for the same slots and specialist diaries close. If no Biology SL specialist is free in the window you need, we say so and tell you when one is, rather than putting a general science tutor in front of a Diploma student. Where a match sits outside the UAE, the time zone and the online format are stated before any booking, so there is nothing to discover afterwards.

faqs.question: What does a Biology SL lesson actually look like over live video?
faqs.answer: The tutor shares a screen, and the material on it is your child's own: a marked paper, a data table from the investigation, a graph that is not answering its question. Work goes back and forth as annotated documents rather than as slides. A typical 60-minute session runs a short diagnostic question, teaching on the specific gap it exposed, then timed practice marked against the published criteria. Sessions can be recorded by agreement so a mechanism explanation can be rewatched during revision. A short written note then goes to the parent naming what was covered and what the student owes before the next lesson.

dubai/ib-dp-biology-sl-tutor.closingBody: The cheapest Biology SL support in Dubai is the support that targets the right component. Before buying a term of weekly lessons, book one trial lesson and listen for a specific diagnosis: which of the four investigation criteria is weak, or which command terms are costing marks in Paper 2. A tutor who can name that in sixty minutes is worth the specialist band. One who talks about confidence and motivation is not, at any price. Tell us the level, the Diploma year and the deadline that is actually worrying you, and we will say plainly whether a Biology SL specialist is free in that window, what the plan would cover, and what it would leave out.

intro.heading: The price question, answered before the sales argument
paragraphs: Research for this project fetched and read some sixty competitor pages across the Dubai tutoring market. Three of the six pages ranking for queries like this one publish no price at all. One of them asks the price question in its own list of frequently asked questions and then declines to answer it. The two that do publish figures quote US dollars, which is not the currency a Dubai family pays in. That is the state of the market a parent is searching inside, and it is why this page leads with money.

Here is the honest shape of it. Market rates for IB tutoring in Dubai run from roughly AED 45 an hour at the budget end, where providers such as EdFlik advertise from AED 45-65 and Tutopiya from AED 33-52, through a qualified-subject-tutor band where Unitors publishes IB tuition from AED 200 and IGCSE from AED 150, up to an IB specialist band that Bestimate's 2026 rate table puts at AED 200-450 and above. In-home one-to-one sits higher again, at AED 180-350 in that table and up to AED 500 from independent home tutors. Premium named tutors are quoted at AED 650 by BartyED. Those are market figures published by those providers, not IB Gram's prices.

What nobody explains is why the same subject at the same level produces a range that wide. Six factors do most of the work, and four of them are specific to Dubai rather than general. Delivery format is the largest, because an in-home rate in this city absorbs a cross-town journey that can take fifty minutes at 17:00. Proximity to the May session is the second. Whether the brief includes coursework feedback is the third, because reading and scoring a research project is slower work per hour than teaching a unit. The rest are set out in a table further down.

IB Gram's own model is worth stating plainly rather than leaving to inference. Tutoring for families in Dubai is delivered online, one-to-one, over live video on Gulf Standard Time. We do not offer home visits in Dubai or anywhere else in the UAE; a tutor arriving at a residence is part of our India service only. We do not publish a headline hourly rate on these pages, because the rate depends on level, session length and whether the brief includes research-project feedback. What we do instead is give a free trial lesson with no card details, then quote a plan: a session count, a sequence and a total.

That last distinction matters more than it sounds. An hourly rate is almost useless for budgeting a two-year Diploma subject. A plan is not. 'Eight sessions on the pre-released case study across eight weeks' is a number a household can decide about. 'From AED X per hour' is an invitation to find out later.

dubai/ib-dp-business-management-home-tut.programmesIntro: Business Management is taken in the Diploma, but the students arriving in a DP1 class come from four different places and each route changes how many sessions the first term needs. The cost of a plan starts here.

programmes.name: Diploma Programme
programmes.description: Business Management is a group 3 subject at Standard or Higher Level, built on five units: introduction to business management, human resource management, finance and accounts, marketing, and operations management. Four concepts run through the course — creativity, change, ethics and sustainability. Assessment combines a paper based on a pre-released case study, a second paper on unseen material, and an internally assessed research project.
programmes.countryNote: Business Management is one of the more popular group 3 choices at Dubai IB schools, which has a cost consequence: the pool of tutors who claim it is large, and the pool who can actually teach the examinable toolkit and score a research project is much smaller. Price dispersion in this subject is wider in Dubai than in Economics for exactly that reason.

programmes.name: Middle Years Programme
programmes.description: Individuals and Societies and the design cycle both feed into Business Management, and MYP's criterion-based marking prepares students well for a research project. What it does not prepare them for is the quantitative strand: break-even, cash-flow forecasts and ratio work assume a comfort with figures that MYP assessment does not test directly.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai schools running MYP to the end of Year 11 send students into DP1 with strong investigation habits and no experience of a timed quantitative paper. The practical budgeting point is that these students usually need a short numeracy strand in DP1 term one, which is two or three sessions, not a term.

programmes.name: Career-related Programme
programmes.description: Business Management is a natural DP course inside the Career-related Programme, where it sits alongside a career-related study and the four compulsory components including a reflective project. The subject is assessed identically to the full Diploma version. The workload difference is that the reflective project and the research project frequently fall in the same term.
programmes.countryNote: Where a Dubai school runs CP with a career-related study in business, students sometimes assume the two pieces of research can share material. They cannot: each must be independently produced, and reusing work across components is an academic-honesty question rather than a time saving.

programmes.name: IGCSE Business Studies into DP1
programmes.description: Cambridge IGCSE Business Studies 0450 is the most common entry route in Dubai. It covers much of the same territory at a shallower depth and with a different reward structure: IGCSE marks clear explanation, while the Diploma marks application of a named tool to a specific organisation. Students arriving with a grade 8 or 9 at 0450 often write good IGCSE answers to Diploma questions for an entire term.
programmes.countryNote: With UK-curriculum students at 37% of Dubai's private-school enrolment in 2024-25, this handover is the standard case. The budget consequence is specific: a student from 0450 rarely needs content teaching in DP1 term one, and the money is better spent on four or five sessions converting IGCSE writing into Diploma writing.

dubai/ib-dp-business-management-home-tut.subjectsIntro: Business Management is the subject of this page. The remaining entries are the subjects Dubai Diploma students most often combine with it, listed by what each adds to the workload and therefore to the cost of a term.

subjects.name: Business Management
subjects.description: Five units plus an examinable business management toolkit. Assessment combines a paper built on a pre-released case study, a second paper on unseen stimulus material with a quantitative element, and an internally assessed research project on a real organisation. Higher Level adds extension content and extra toolkit tools. Confirm current weightings, durations and word limits in the live subject guide on ibo.org.

subjects.name: Economics
subjects.description: The closest group 3 neighbour and the most frequent pairing. Diagram discipline transfers; tool application does not. Economics students taking Business Management often write Economics evaluation into Business answers, where the command terms want an operational recommendation for a named organisation instead of a weighing of theoretical effects.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation
subjects.description: The natural mathematics partner. Descriptive statistics, regression and confident calculator use all support the quantitative strand of Business Management directly, including break-even and investment appraisal. For a Business Management student the AI route is usually the better fit unless a target degree specifies otherwise.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches
subjects.description: Chosen for university prerequisites rather than for Business Management support. Several business and finance degrees specify AA, so the choice should be checked against the named programme before DP1 subject selection closes rather than assumed from the subject title.

subjects.name: Global Politics
subjects.description: Shares the ethics and sustainability ground from a different direction, and its engagement activity trains the sourcing of evidence on a self-chosen issue. That is the same discipline a research project needs, and students who do both often produce stronger primary research than classmates who do Business Management alone.

subjects.name: Psychology
subjects.description: Directly relevant to the human resource management unit — motivation theory, leadership, organisational culture — and its experimental internal assessment teaches rigorous handling of evidence. The transferable habit is distinguishing what the data shows from what the student expected it to show.

subjects.name: Digital Society
subjects.description: Overlaps the operations and marketing units through digital business models, data and platform economics. Its inquiry process is close in shape to the research project, so students taking both have a head start on framing a researchable question rather than a topic.

subjects.name: English A: Language and Literature
subjects.description: The close-reading skill it trains is what Paper 1 rewards. A pre-released case study is a text, and the marks go to students who use its specific detail rather than general industry knowledge. Students who can quote the exact line that supports a recommendation score higher without learning more business theory.

subjects.name: Visual Arts and Design Technology
subjects.description: Common pairings for students heading towards entrepreneurship or product-led degrees. Both train iteration and justification of a design decision, which maps onto the creativity concept in Business Management and onto the operations unit's treatment of product development.

subjects.name: Arabic, Islamic Education and Social Studies
subjects.description: Dubai private schools must deliver Arabic, Islamic Education and Social or Moral Studies regardless of their licensed curriculum, under KHDA requirements. These occupy real timetable space and therefore real tutoring capacity, which is why a plan should be built from what remains of the week rather than from an ideal schedule.

sections.heading: What an IB Business Management home tutor in Dubai actually costs
paragraphs: An IB DP Business Management home tutor in Dubai, as the market uses the term, is a specialist working one-to-one with a Diploma Business Management student at a time the family chooses. Traditionally that has meant a tutor driving to a residence. IB Gram teaches the same course one-to-one over live video on Gulf Standard Time; home visits are an India-only part of our service and are not sold in the UAE at any price.

The table below is the answer to the question most parents came here with. Every figure is a market rate published by the named provider or rate table, with the year it was published. None of them is IB Gram's price. The reason for presenting it by provider model rather than as a single average is that the models buy genuinely different things: a budget online platform and an IB specialist are not the same purchase at a discount, they are different purchases.

Read the right-hand column carefully, because it contains the part that costs families money later. A rate that excludes coursework feedback will not help with the research project. A rate quoted per 45-minute session is not comparable to one quoted per hour. A marketplace rate that varies by tutor is a range rather than a price. Most disappointment in this market comes from comparing two numbers that were never measuring the same thing.

One structural note about this SERP. Competitor pricing in Dubai is frequently inconsistent on the provider's own site — research for this project found a page contradicting its own published prices in two places, and schema markup quoting a price range that differed from the visible body text. Where a figure appears below, it is the one that provider published, dated, and it is quoted for comparison of models rather than as an endorsement or a criticism of any brand.

sections.heading: The six things that move the number in this emirate
paragraphs: A range from AED 33 to AED 650 for the same nominal service needs explaining, and the explanation is not simply quality. Six factors do most of the work. Two are general to tutoring anywhere. Four bite specifically in Dubai, and those are the ones a local family can act on.

Delivery format is the largest single factor and it is almost entirely a Dubai geography problem. A 90-minute in-home session booked for 17:00 in Dubai Marina commonly occupies a tutor from around 16:10 to 19:05 once the journey is counted in both directions. That unbilled time sits inside the rate whether or not it appears as a line item, and it is why Bestimate's in-home band starts above its online band for identical teaching.

Proximity to the May session is the second. The supply of specialists who can teach the examinable toolkit and score a research project is fixed; demand from DP2 families is not, and it concentrates between January and April. A plan agreed in September costs less per session than the same plan agreed in February, and the September version also has the research project still open, which is where most of the recoverable grade sits.

The remaining four are scope, level, session length and cancellation terms. Scope is the one that catches families: a rate for teaching units is not a rate for reading and scoring a 1,500 or 1,800-word research project, because the latter is slower per hour. Level matters because Higher Level extension content and the additional toolkit tools narrow the tutor pool. Session length matters because a 45-minute session quoted against a 60-minute comparison looks 25% cheaper and is not. And cancellation terms decide what a missed school trip actually costs.

sections.heading: Where the AED actually goes: in-home against online
paragraphs: This is the comparison that decides most Dubai budgets, and it deserves a cost breakdown rather than a slogan. An in-home tutor offers things that are genuinely hard to reproduce: a person in the room, no device between tutor and student, a pen picked up mid-sentence. For a student who disengages when a screen appears, that is worth paying for and worth hiring locally for.

IB Gram does not sell that format in the UAE. A tutor travelling to a residence is part of our India operation only, and nothing on this site offers it here. A family that wants somebody in the room should hire a local tutor and should expect the in-home market band, which is higher for a specific and defensible reason rather than an arbitrary one.

The reason is set out in the table. Roughly a third of an in-home hour's cost in a city like Dubai is the journey, and the journey produces no teaching. That is not a criticism of in-home tutors; it is the economics of the format, and a tutor who did not price it would be working for less than their stated rate. What online delivery does is remove that component and redirect it, which in practice means either a lower total or a more specialised tutor for the same money.

There is a second cost that rarely appears in a comparison: the cost of the wrong tutor. Restricting the search to people who can physically reach Mirdif by 17:30 narrows the pool severely in a subject where the examinable toolkit and the research project are the parts that move grades. Paying AED 250 an hour for a nearby generalist is more expensive than paying AED 300 for a specialist if the first one spends six sessions on content the student already had.

sections.heading: Tutoring cost in context for a Dubai Diploma family
paragraphs: An hourly rate in isolation tells a family very little. What helps is seeing the tutoring line next to the other costs of a Diploma year in Dubai, and seeing what a full plan totals rather than what one hour does. The table below does that using only figures that can be attributed, with a note rather than an invented number wherever nothing could be sourced.

The most useful context comes from KHDA. Dubai's private school sector carried 387,441 students across 227 schools in 2024-25, offering seventeen different curricula, with International Baccalaureate students at 7% of enrolment. KHDA confirmed on 22 May 2026 that there would be no increase in private school fees in the emirate for the 2026-27 academic year, under Dubai's second economic incentives package valued at AED 1.5 billion within a AED 2.5 billion total. For a tutoring budget, that means the school-fee side of the household is flat this year rather than rising.

The sector is also growing, which affects tutor supply. KHDA reported that Dubai's 2026-27 intake adds seven new private schools — four UK curriculum and three International Baccalaureate — creating 16,846 new places, after six schools opened during 2025-26 and enrolment rose 6%. Three new IB schools means more Diploma students and the same specialist tutor pool, which is a supply argument for booking early rather than a marketing one.

What the table deliberately does not do is state a school fee figure or a VAT treatment. Fees vary by school and are published by each school through KHDA; quoting a band here would be a number without a source. The VAT position on tuition fees in the UAE is a question for the Federal Tax Authority, and we limit ourselves to confirming whether a quoted price includes it when we issue one.

sections.heading: What the money is buying: the assessment you are paying to improve
paragraphs: A price is only judgeable against what it is meant to change. Business Management is assessed through two written papers and an internally assessed research project, and the three components need different kinds of tutoring time, which is why a single hourly rate is a poor instrument for the whole subject.

Paper 1 is built on a case study released to schools in advance. That changes the economics of preparation completely: the organisation, the context and much of the data are known months before the examination, so preparation is specific research rather than general revision. A tutor who has read the released material and worked it against the syllabus is doing something a generalist cannot, and this is the single component where specialist time pays back fastest.

Paper 2 works from unseen stimulus material and includes a quantitative strand — break-even, cash-flow forecasting, ratio work and investment appraisal among the tools a student may be asked to apply. These are drillable and therefore cheap to fix in session terms, usually four to six focused sessions. The marks are lost to presentation and interpretation rather than arithmetic: a correct ratio with no comment on what it means for the organisation earns a fraction of the available marks.

The research project is the component families most often underestimate in cost terms, because it is slow. The student investigates a real organisation and produces a report within a word limit that differs by level. Scoring a draft properly against the published criteria takes longer than teaching a unit, and feedback has to be returned as questions rather than corrections so that the work stays the student's own. Confirm current component weightings, durations and word limits against the live subject guide on ibo.org or with your school's DP coordinator.

sections.heading: The toolkit, and why a cheap tutor often cannot teach it
paragraphs: The business management toolkit is the part of this course that separates a tutor who knows business from a tutor who knows the Diploma. It is an examinable set of analytical tools, and students are expected to select, apply and evaluate them against a specific organisation rather than describe them. A quoted rate at the budget end of the Dubai market frequently buys somebody who can explain what a SWOT analysis is, which is not what the marks are for.

The tools span the course. Situational and strategic analysis includes SWOT, STEEPLE, the Ansoff matrix and the BCG matrix. Financial tools include break-even analysis, cash-flow forecasts, financial ratios and investment appraisal. Decision tools include decision trees and descriptive statistics. Higher Level adds further tools, among them critical path analysis, force field analysis, Hofstede's cultural dimensions, Porter's generic strategies, contribution analysis and simple linear regression. Check the current list and level allocation in the live subject guide, since the toolkit is a comparatively recent addition and its contents are specified there.

What examiners reward is selection and judgement. A student who applies a BCG matrix to an organisation with a single product has chosen the wrong tool and will be marked accordingly, however neatly the matrix is drawn. A student who completes an Ansoff matrix and then recommends market development without reference to the organisation's cash position has applied the tool and not used it. These are the losses that distinguish a 4 from a 6, and they are invisible to a tutor who has only ever taught the units.

The practical consequence for a budget is uncomfortable but worth stating. The cheapest rate in the Dubai market is not usually a discount on the same service; it is a different service that may not reach the part of the grade a parent is worried about. The right way to test it before paying is to ask a candidate tutor a toolkit question in the free trial: which tool would you use here, and what would you conclude from it.

sections.heading: Hidden extras that catch Dubai parents out
paragraphs: Several costs in this market are real and are rarely in the headline figure. The first is session length. Forty-five-minute slots are common in Dubai and are often quoted against sixty-minute comparisons, which makes a rate look a quarter cheaper than it is. Convert every quote to a price per sixty minutes before comparing anything.

The second is scope creep around coursework. A rate agreed for teaching units does not usually include reading and scoring a research project draft, and families discover this in the week the first draft is due. Ask explicitly: does this rate include reading and scoring written coursework, and how many passes. The third is cancellation. A Dubai school year contains trips, long weekends, and a Ramadan schedule shift, and a loose notice period across a year costs more than a slightly higher hourly rate with a clear one.

The fourth is what happens when a tutor becomes unavailable. On an independent arrangement the answer is often that the sessions stop. A replacement policy is worth asking about before the situation arises, and worth comparing across providers, because it is the term that most often turns a cheap arrangement into an expensive gap in February.

The fifth is the one a price list cannot show: a conditional offer presented as free. 'Free trial' should always be accompanied by the conditions on the same screen — how long it lasts, whether card details are needed, and what happens afterwards. Our trial is a full one-to-one session, free of charge, with no card details taken and no automatic enrolment. If any provider's free offer takes longer than a sentence to explain, read that sentence carefully.
