sections.heading: Permits, legality and whether the cheapest tutor is a legal one
paragraphs: There is a price floor in this market that is set by law rather than by competition, and it is worth understanding before choosing on price alone. Private tutoring in the UAE is regulated by permit. The MoHRE private tuition work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, and it is granted free of charge for two years. Eligible applicants include teachers registered in government or private schools, employees in the government and private sectors, unemployed individuals, school students aged 15 to 18, and university students.

Because the permit is free, cost is not a reason for a tutor to be without one. MoHRE's own service page, 'Issuance of a New Work Permit - Private Tutor Licensing', lists no fee and a two-working-day completion time, applied for through the MoHRE smart app, website and e-services system. Individuals offering private tutoring without a permit from MoHRE are subject to fines and penalties outlined in the applicable laws. No fine schedule is published, so no amount is quoted here, and any page quoting one should be treated with suspicion.

A tutoring operation with premises and staff in Dubai is a different legal entity again and needs a KHDA Educational Services Permit for a training institute, with initial approval first, a maximum of six months to complete the permit and licence steps, and annual renewal requested at least thirty days before expiry. IB Gram operates no premises in the UAE, holds no such permit, and is not approved, accredited or licensed by KHDA, ADEK, SPEA, the Ministry of Education, MoHRE, the IB, Cambridge or Pearson.

One further rule shapes what a parent should not buy at any price. ADEK's professional-ethics rules for private and charter school staff in Abu Dhabi have been reported as prohibiting teachers from giving paid private tuition to students enrolled at their own school, and the MoHRE permit's code of conduct carries a similar bar. Treat that as press-reported and verify against the current ADEK document. The sound rule everywhere in the UAE is not to arrange paid tuition with your child's own class teacher, however convenient or cheap the arrangement looks.

sections.heading: Academic honesty: the one cost that is never worth paying
paragraphs: Research for this project found a provider in this market selling completed Internal Assessments outright, at a fixed price, as a product. That is worth naming as a cost rather than a shortcut. Submitting work that is not the student's own is malpractice under IB rules, and the sanction falls on the candidate: a Diploma can be withheld. The money saved on effort is paid for with the qualification.

The permitted boundary around a Business Management research project is wide enough to be genuinely useful. A tutor may teach the units and the toolkit. A tutor may explain the assessment criteria and what each descriptor means. A tutor may test whether a proposed research question is actually answerable with the data a student can obtain. A tutor may read a draft the student has written and score it against the criteria. A tutor may say that a section applies a tool without drawing a conclusion from it, and ask what the conclusion should be.

A tutor may not write, rewrite or complete any part of the project, supply sentences for insertion, or edit a draft until it is finished. Our working test is that feedback is given as scores and questions and the keyboard stays with the student. That boundary also applies to the Extended Essay and to TOK, and it applies to materials: published syllabus documents, past papers and mark schemes belong to the IB, Cambridge or Pearson, and are referenced and linked rather than copied or supplied as downloads.

The reason this sits on a page about cost is that price pressure is exactly what pushes families towards the services that cross the line. A completed research project is cheaper per mark than six proper feedback sessions, right up until it is caught. The honest arithmetic is that the only coursework support worth buying is the kind that leaves the work in the student's hands.
bullets: Permitted: teaching, explaining criteria, testing a research question, scoring drafts
Not permitted: writing, rewriting, supplying text, or editing to completion
Malpractice sanctions fall on the candidate, not on the provider
Official papers and mark schemes are cited and linked, never redistributed

sections.heading: How to test any quote before you pay for it
paragraphs: A free trial lesson is the only instrument in this market that tells a parent anything reliable before money changes hands, and most families use it badly — as a chemistry test between tutor and student rather than as an assessment of competence. It can do both, and the competence part is the one a price depends on.

Four questions are worth putting to any Business Management tutor, ours included, in or around that first session. Which toolkit tools are Higher Level only, and which does my child need. Have you read the case study released for the current session, and what would you do with it. How many passes would you make over a research project draft, and what would you not do to it. And what exactly does your rate include, per sixty minutes.

The answers are diagnostic. A tutor who cannot separate Higher Level toolkit tools from Standard Level ones has not taught this syllabus recently. A tutor who has not read the released case study is not prepared for the component with the highest return per session. A tutor who offers to tidy up a research project has told you something important about their boundaries. And a tutor who cannot state what a rate includes will state it later, when the first coursework deadline arrives.

After our free trial you receive a short written note: what was understood, what was not, which component the marks are coming from, and a plan with a session count and a total. No card details are taken for the trial and there is no automatic enrolment. If the note reads like a brochure rather than a diagnosis, that is a reason to decline, and we would rather you declined than paid for the wrong thing.
bullets: Use the free trial to test competence, not only rapport
Ask which toolkit tools are Higher Level only
Ask whether the tutor has read the current released case study
Ask how many coursework passes are included, and what the tutor will not do
Ask what the rate includes, stated per 60 minutes

process.description: Not an hourly rate. A plan names the component, the number of sessions, the sequence and the total cost, so the decision is a single number rather than an open commitment. Coursework feedback, if the brief includes it, is scoped and priced separately and explicitly.

process.description: A fixed slot on Gulf Standard Time, with a marked piece of work after each session so progress is checkable mid-block rather than only at the end. Research-project drafts come back scored against the criteria, with questions the student answers themselves.

process.description: A block ends. At that point the marked work is reviewed and a second block is a fresh decision, not a default renewal. Families who prefer a rolling monthly arrangement can have one, but it is chosen rather than assumed.

whyPoints.description: Every AED band on this page is attributed to the provider or rate table that published it, with the year, and marked as a market rate rather than ours. whyPoints.title: Quoted as a plan, not as a rate
whyPoints.description: A session count, a sequence and a total, so a family can decide once. An hourly rate is almost impossible to budget a two-year Diploma subject against, and the ambiguity in this market usually works against the parent rather than the provider.

whyPoints.title: Coursework scope stated before purchase
whyPoints.description: Research-project feedback is slower work per hour than teaching, so it is scoped and priced explicitly rather than assumed into a general rate. That avoids the common Dubai conversation in which a coursework deadline arrives and the quoted rate turns out not to have covered it.

whyPoints.description: Tools are taught to be selected, applied and judged against a named organisation, with Higher Level tools identified as such. That is the part of this subject where the cheapest rates in the market most often fall short of what the marks are for.

whyPoints.description: Because delivery is online, the tutor is chosen for having taught this syllabus at this level rather than for living near your community. In a city where a 17:00 crossing can take fifty minutes, that removes the largest hidden cost in the in-home model.

whyPoints.title: An honest answer on availability
whyPoints.description: Specialist supply is fixed and DP2 demand concentrates before the May session. If nobody suitable is free in the slot you want, we say so and give the next realistic start date rather than placing a generalist into a Higher Level brief and leaving the gap to emerge in March.

faqs.question: How much does an IB Business Management tutor cost per hour in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Published market figures for 2026 run from roughly AED 33-65 an hour at the budget online end, where Tutopiya advertises from AED 33-52 and EdFlik from AED 45-65, through a qualified-tutor band where Unitors lists IB tuition from AED 200 and IGCSE from AED 150, to an IB specialist band that Bestimate's rate table puts at AED 200-450 and above. TutorChase publishes AED 270 and BartyED AED 650 at the premium end. Those are market rates published by those providers, not IB Gram's prices. We quote a plan after a free trial lesson.

faqs.question: Why is there such a wide gap between the cheapest and most expensive tutors here?
faqs.answer: Because the models buy different things rather than the same thing at different prices. Six factors explain most of the spread: delivery format, which in Dubai means a cross-city journey priced into an in-home rate; the month of booking, since DP2 demand concentrates before the May session; whether the brief includes coursework feedback, which is slower work per hour; the level, since Higher Level narrows the tutor pool; session length, as 45-minute slots are often compared against hours; and cancellation terms, which decide what a missed trip costs over a year.

faqs.question: Is a home tutor in Dubai worth the extra AED per hour for Business Management?
faqs.answer: It depends on one thing: whether your child engages on a screen. If a person in the room is what makes the hour work, the premium is worth paying and you should hire locally, because IB Gram does not run home visits in the UAE. If attention holds on a shared screen, the in-home premium is buying a journey rather than teaching — roughly 40 to 60 minutes each way at 17:00 in this city — and the same budget buys a more specialised tutor online. The second hidden cost is the narrower local pool in a subject where the toolkit decides marks.

faqs.question: What should a Business Management plan cost rather than an hour?
faqs.answer: Think in blocks. A case-study block for Paper 1 is typically eight sessions over eight weeks. A quantitative block covering break-even, cash flow, ratios and investment appraisal is usually four to six. A research-project feedback cycle runs three or four passes per draft and is priced separately because reading and scoring is slower than teaching. A weekly arrangement across DP1 and DP2 is around sixty to seventy sessions. Multiplying a block by a published band gives a realistic total; we quote the actual total after a free trial lesson.

faqs.question: Does the quoted rate include feedback on the research project?
faqs.answer: Ask every provider this before comparing prices, because the usual answer is no and families find out in the week a draft is due. Reading a 1,500 or 1,800-word report and scoring it against the published criteria takes longer than teaching a unit, so most rates priced for teaching do not cover it. We scope and price coursework feedback explicitly: how many passes, what each pass checks, and what the tutor will not do to the draft. Confirm the current word limits for your child's level in the live subject guide.

faqs.question: Why is the pre-released case study worth paying specialist rates for?
faqs.answer: Because it is the one component where the material is known in advance, which changes preparation from general revision into specific research. A tutor who has read the released case study and worked it against the syllabus can prepare a student on the actual organisation, context and data that will appear. A generalist charging less will prepare them on business theory. In cost-per-mark terms this is usually the highest-return block a Dubai family buys, and it is also the component most often left until the term of the examination.

faqs.question: Which toolkit tools are Higher Level only, and does it change the price?
faqs.answer: The toolkit is examinable and Higher Level carries additional tools, which have historically included critical path analysis, force field analysis, Hofstede's cultural dimensions, Porter's generic strategies, contribution analysis and simple linear regression alongside the tools both levels share. Verify the current list and level allocation in the IB subject guide. It does affect price, because the pool of tutors who can teach selection and judgement on the Higher Level tools is smaller than the pool who can describe a SWOT analysis, and the Dubai market prices that scarcity.

faqs.question: Are 45-minute sessions standard in Dubai, and how should we compare them?
faqs.answer: Forty-five-minute slots are common here and are frequently quoted against sixty-minute comparisons without the difference being prominent. A rate of AED 200 per 45 minutes is AED 267 per hour, which changes a comparison entirely. Convert every quote to a price per sixty minutes before deciding anything. The related question is what a session includes: whether marking between lessons, preparation on a released case study, or coursework reading is inside the quoted time or outside it.

faqs.question: Do you charge for the trial lesson, and what are the conditions?
faqs.answer: The trial is a full one-to-one session over live video, free of charge, with no card details taken and no automatic enrolment afterwards. The conditions are that it is one session, with a tutor matched to your child's subject and level, and that it ends with a short written note of what was understood and what was not. We state those conditions here because a conditional free offer should always be explained on the same screen as the word free, and in this market that is not always the case.

faqs.question: What happens to our money if the tutor becomes unavailable mid-term?
faqs.answer: Ask every provider this before the situation arises, because it is the term that most often turns a cheap arrangement into a gap in February. On an independent in-home arrangement the usual answer is that sessions stop until the tutor returns. We propose a replacement matched to the same level and component, and the plan continues from where it stopped rather than restarting. Any unused sessions in a block stay unused rather than expiring quietly, and the reschedule terms are stated at the start.

faqs.question: Is private tutoring in Dubai legal, and does a permit cost money?
faqs.answer: It is legal with a permit. The MoHRE private tuition work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023 and is granted free of charge for two years. MoHRE's own service page lists no fee and a two-working-day completion time, applied for through its smart app, website and e-services system. Eligible applicants include registered school teachers, government and private-sector employees, unemployed individuals, school students aged 15 to 18 and university students. Because it costs nothing, price is no excuse for a tutor not to hold one, and you can simply ask.

faqs.question: Have Dubai school fees gone up, and does that affect what we can spend on tutoring?
faqs.answer: KHDA confirmed on 22 May 2026 that there would be no increase in private school fees in the emirate for the 2026-27 academic year, under Dubai's second economic incentives package valued at AED 1.5 billion within a AED 2.5 billion total. For a household budget that means the school-fee side is flat this year rather than rising. Fees themselves vary by school and are published through KHDA, so no band is quoted on this page. The sector is also expanding, with seven new private schools and 16,846 new places reported for 2026-27.

faqs.question: Can we buy a finished research project to save money?
faqs.answer: No, and the reason is arithmetic rather than principle. Submitting work that is not the student's own is malpractice under IB rules, and the sanction falls on the candidate — a Diploma can be withheld. Services selling completed Internal Assessments exist in this market; one was found during research for this project advertising them at a fixed price. What a tutor may legitimately do is teach the units and toolkit, explain the criteria, test whether a research question is answerable, score a draft the student wrote, and ask what a weak section is missing.

faqs.question: Which component should we spend on first if the budget is limited?
faqs.answer: Whichever one the marked work says is weakest, which is why the first conversation asks for a marked paper rather than a description. As a default, a DP1 student should spend first on the research project, because it is the only component with no time limit and it closes early. A DP2 student should spend on the pre-released case study, because the material is known in advance and the return per session is highest. The quantitative strand is cheapest to fix and should rarely be the first purchase.

faqs.question: Do session times and prices change during Ramadan and the school holidays?
faqs.answer: Times change; the plan price does not. During Ramadan the UAE school day shortens and sessions usually move to post-Iftar timing rather than pausing, because a paused DP2 spring does not return the weeks it loses. Over the winter and spring breaks families who travel often keep sessions at a shifted hour, since live video follows the student, while those staying in Dubai use the break for the longer blocks research-project work actually needs. Rates in the wider market do tend to rise closer to the May session as specialist supply tightens.

dubai/ib-dp-business-management-home-tut.closingHeading: Ask for a total, not a rate
dubai/ib-dp-business-management-home-tut.closingBody: If you are looking for an IB DP Business Management home tutor in Dubai, the most useful thing you can do before paying anybody is ask for a total rather than an hourly rate: which component, how many sessions, what it includes per sixty minutes, and what happens to coursework feedback. We answer those four questions in writing after a free trial lesson, which is a full one-to-one session over live video with no card details taken and no automatic enrolment. Send the marked work the school has already given you and the first conversation can be about the specific component rather than about a price range.

dubai/ib-dp-business-management-online-t.tutorsIntro: The tutors listed below teach Business Management at Diploma level. Each has worked a pre-released case study through a full teaching year, marked timed Paper 2 responses against published criteria, and supervised research projects that stayed inside the word limit without losing their argument.

intro.heading: Start with the number, because nobody else in this search will give you one
paragraphs: Three of the six pages currently ranking for Business Management tutoring in Dubai publish no price at all. One of them asks the question in its own list of frequently asked questions and then declines to answer it. The two pages that do quote prices quote them in US dollars, which is not the currency a Dubai family pays in. A parent trying to work out whether AED 180 an hour is a bargain or AED 400 an hour is a rip-off currently has nothing to compare against, and that is the gap this page exists to close.

So the first substantial section here is a rate table built only from figures somebody has actually published, each one attributed. The second explains why the hourly rate is the least useful number in the decision, and what to put in its place: cost per term, cost per marked script, and cost per mark of recoverable loss. A family who books eleven hours at AED 200 and receives no marked work has spent AED 2,200 on conversation. A family who books six hours at AED 300 and receives six annotated scripts has bought something they can audit.

Business Management has a cost shape of its own, which is why a generic tutoring rate card misleads. Two of its three assessed components can be prepared long in advance and therefore cheaply. The pre-released case study arrives at schools well before the paper that uses it, which means a student with foresight can spread that preparation across months of low-intensity work instead of buying emergency hours in April. The research project is capped at 1,800 words and rewards a narrow, answerable question; the expensive version is the one where a student drafts 2,600 words around an unanswerable question and then needs paid hours to dismantle it.

The third component, the second written paper, is where hourly spend concentrates for most Dubai families, because it is unseen, it ranges across all five units, and it rewards applied analysis under time pressure. The honest version of a tuition plan prices that explicitly: a given number of timed papers, marked and returned, over a stated number of weeks. Anything vaguer than that is unpriceable, and an unpriceable plan is how a term of tutoring quietly reaches AED 6,000 without anyone deciding to spend it.

Everything below carries its source. The AED bands come from named competitor price pages and from Bestimate's Tutoring Cost Dubai 2026 rate survey. The regulatory material comes from u.ae, KHDA and MoHRE. Where a figure could not be verified, including every IB examination and results date, this page says so rather than guessing, because an unsourced number repeated across a large set of pages is simply a large set of liabilities. Read the tables, then decide what an hour is worth to your household.

dubai/ib-dp-business-management-online-t.programmesIntro: Business Management is a Diploma course, but the spend decision usually starts earlier. What a student brings from MYP or from IGCSE Business Studies decides whether the first block of tuition is remedial or strategic, and that changes the budget by a factor of two.

programmes.name: Middle Years Programme
programmes.description: MYP Individuals and Societies builds investigation and argument against four criteria rather than business frameworks. Students arriving in DP1 from MYP are usually comfortable with extended writing and unfamiliar with applying a named analytical tool to a specific organisation. That is a cheap gap to close: tool application is teachable in a handful of sessions once the writing is already there.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai's full-continuum schools send students straight from MYP 5 into DP1, so a large share of the emirate's Business Management intake has never sat a timed business paper. Budgeting one short block in the first term of DP1 costs far less than buying crisis hours in DP2.

programmes.name: Diploma Programme Business Management
programmes.description: The current guide is built on five units: introduction to business management, human resource management, finance and accounts, marketing, and operations management. A toolkit of situational and decision-making frameworks runs across all of them, with several reserved for Higher Level. Assessment is a pre-released case study paper, an unseen paper, and a business research project capped at 1,800 words.
programmes.countryNote: Business Management is among the larger group three cohorts in Dubai's IB schools, which means plenty of classmates to revise with and very little individual marking time from the class teacher. The spend that pays is marking, not re-teaching content the student already has in a textbook.

programmes.name: IGCSE Business Studies as the pre-Diploma route
programmes.description: Cambridge IGCSE Business Studies 0450 covers business activity, people in business, marketing, operations and finance, and it rewards accurate recall of definitions applied to short scenarios. The Diploma asks for something different: analysis of a specific organisation using named tools, with a recommendation. Strong IGCSE performers often need the fewest hours and the sharpest redirection.
programmes.countryNote: British-curriculum schools hold the largest share of Dubai's private enrolment, so IGCSE Business Studies is the commonest entry route into Diploma Business Management in the emirate. For this group, the first paid hour is usually best spent on a timed Diploma-style question rather than on revision of content already secure.

programmes.name: Career-related Programme
programmes.description: The Career-related Programme combines two or more Diploma courses with a career-related study, a reflective project, personal and professional skills, service learning and language development. Business Management is the most frequently chosen Diploma course inside a business-oriented CP, and the assessment load for that one course is identical to the full Diploma version.
programmes.countryNote: Fewer Dubai schools run CP than the full Diploma, so a CP student taking Business Management may be one of very few in their year sitting the paper. The budget question changes shape there: with no class to revise alongside, weekly one-to-one does work a cohort would otherwise do for free.

dubai/ib-dp-business-management-online-t.subjectsIntro: Families rarely buy one subject. The list below is costed by how much marking each subject generates, because marking time is what drives an honest hourly figure more than teaching time does.

subjects.name: Business Management
subjects.description: Three components: a paper built on a pre-released case study, an unseen paper spanning all five units, and a research project capped at 1,800 words. Higher Level sits a longer case study paper. Marking load is heavy, because applied analysis cannot be marked from an answer key.

subjects.name: Economics
subjects.description: Extended response and data response papers plus a portfolio of three short commentaries. Diagram accuracy drives a large share of the marks. A student taking both Economics and Business Management needs the two evaluation styles kept apart, which is cheaper to teach than to repair.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation
subjects.description: Carries the statistics that Business Management finance and operations questions assume: percentage change, break-even arithmetic, forecasting and interpretation of tables. Weak AI statistics shows up as lost marks in the finance and accounts unit rather than in the mathematics paper.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches
subjects.description: The route most business and economics degrees prefer at entry. Algebraic fluency and calculus dominate. Worth checking target university pages before subject choices close, because the mathematics route named in an offer is more often the blocker than the group three subject is.

subjects.name: Psychology
subjects.description: Research methods and empirical evaluation, assessed partly through an experimental internal assessment. Shares with Business Management the discipline of judging evidence rather than describing it, which is why the two subjects often improve together.

subjects.name: Global Politics
subjects.description: Engagement activity and oral components alongside written papers, built on contested concepts such as power and legitimacy. For a Business Management student the transferable habit is weighing stakeholder interests, which is exactly what a recommendation paragraph has to do.

subjects.name: Digital Society
subjects.description: Replaces the old information technology course and overlaps Business Management on operations, data and change. Assessed through written papers and an inquiry project, so the marking rhythm is similar and one tutor can sometimes hold both.

subjects.name: English A: Language and Literature
subjects.description: Guided analysis, comparative essay and oral components. The relevant transfer for Business Management is timed paragraph construction, which is where most unseen-paper answers lose structure in the final twenty minutes.

subjects.name: Computer Science
subjects.description: Written papers plus a solution-development internal assessment. The scheduling cost matters: a student taking Computer Science and Business Management meets two internal deadlines in the same term of DP2, and that collision is the single commonest cause of emergency bookings.

modes.title: Timed paper block before the series
modes.description: The expensive shape, and sometimes the right one: weekly timed papers across the final term, each marked and returned with mark allocations written against each paragraph. Price this by the number of marked scripts you will receive, not by the number of hours spoken, because the marked script is the deliverable.

sections.heading: What an hour of Business Management tuition in Dubai costs, with sources
paragraphs: A direct answer first. On published figures, a qualified online subject tutor in Dubai charges roughly AED 150 to 300 an hour, and a Diploma or IGCSE subject specialist roughly AED 200 to 450 and above, as of October 2026. In-home one-to-one is quoted higher, around AED 180 to 500, because travel sits inside the rate. Budget online tutoring, usually delivered by university students, starts far lower. Every one of those bands traces to a named source in the table below.

The table is deliberately organised by delivery format rather than by brand, for two reasons. Comparing models tells a parent something durable, whereas comparing brands tells them about one week's pricing. And quoting a competitor's rate alongside its name without the date and the source would be unfair to the competitor and useless to the reader. Each row therefore carries the publisher of the figure and the approximate monthly implication of one session a week.

What the bands do not tell you is what the hour contains. Marking a timed Business Management paper properly takes a specialist a meaningful fraction of the lesson length, because applied analysis cannot be marked against an answer key. A provider at AED 180 an hour who does not mark, and a provider at AED 320 an hour who returns an annotated script every week, are selling different products at prices that look comparable. Ask the question explicitly before booking.

IB Gram does not publish a fixed price list on these pages, and the figures above are not ours. The model here is a free trial lesson followed by a quoted plan, so a family sees the specialist, the session plan and the price together before any commitment. What this page commits to is the comparison: you can see the market, the sources, and what the hour should include, and you can hold any provider in Dubai to that standard, including this one.

sections.heading: Why the hourly rate is the least useful number in the decision
paragraphs: Two providers quote AED 220. One delivers sixty minutes of explanation and sets no work. The other delivers fifty minutes of teaching, sets a timed question, marks it against the published criteria, and returns it annotated before the next session. The second is roughly twice the product at the same headline price, and no rate card in Dubai distinguishes between them. This is why the hourly figure, on its own, is close to meaningless as a basis for comparison.

A better unit is cost per marked script. Over a twelve-week term, a family paying AED 250 a week receives AED 3,000 of service. If that produced ten annotated scripts, the family paid AED 300 per piece of individual assessment feedback on their child's actual work, which is a number they can judge. If it produced none, they paid AED 3,000 for conversation that a textbook and a willing classmate could partly have supplied. The question to ask on the enquiry call is simply: how many marked scripts will I have by half term?

The second useful unit is cost against the component weighting. Business Management splits across a case study paper, an unseen paper and a research project, and they do not reward the same kind of spending. The case study is prepared months ahead at low intensity, so hours bought early are cheap hours. The research project is bounded at 1,800 words, so the money goes on question selection rather than on drafting marathons. The unseen paper is where emergency hours cluster, because it is the component that cannot be prepared in advance.

The third thing worth pricing is the thing nobody prices: the cost of a bad match. Four weeks with a tutor who turns out to be a general business graduate rather than a Diploma specialist costs the fees plus the four weeks. That is the real argument for making the first session a free diagnostic with a written output, and for reviewing the file at six weeks rather than at the end of the year. A decision point built into the plan is worth more than a discount.
bullets: Ask how many marked scripts you will receive by half term
Ask whether marking time is inside the hourly rate or billed on top
Ask whether the quoted price is per hour or per session, and what a 90-minute booking costs
Ask what happens to a session the family cancels with 24 hours' notice
Ask for the cancellation and replacement policy in writing before the first payment

sections.heading: The five units, and what each one costs in tutoring hours
paragraphs: Tutoring cost in Business Management is not spread evenly across the course. Some units are expensive to repair because they are quantitative and compound: a student who never understood contribution per unit will fail every downstream break-even and investment appraisal question, and the repair is sequential rather than parallel. Other units are cheap to repair because the content is accessible and the lost marks come from answer structure rather than from understanding.

The table maps that. Read the fourth column as the reason for the cost, not as an opinion about difficulty. Finance and accounts is the expensive unit in almost every Dubai cohort we see, because its numerical chains cannot be short-cut and because students who avoid it in DP1 arrive in DP2 with a two-term deficit. Human resource management is usually the cheapest to improve, because the content is intuitive and the marks are lost in application rather than in comprehension.

This matters for budgeting because it lets a family buy hours against a diagnosis rather than against the calendar. A student losing marks across marketing and operations needs structure work, which responds quickly to marked practice. A student who cannot calculate a break-even point needs teaching, which takes longer and should be bought earlier. Spending the same amount of money in the right order is the whole of cost control in subject tutoring.

The toolkit of analytical frameworks runs across all five units and deserves separate budget. Situational tools and decision-making tools are both examinable, several of them are reserved for Higher Level, and students who deploy them decoratively rather than analytically lose marks in both papers. Teaching a tool to the point where it changes a recommendation takes one session per tool and pays back across every unit.

sections.heading: The pre-released case study: the one component you can prepare a year out
paragraphs: One of the two written papers is built on a case study issued to schools in advance of the examination series. That single fact is the biggest cost lever available to a Dubai family, and almost nobody uses it. A student who reads the organisation carefully over several months, researches its industry, maps the relevant tools onto its actual circumstances and rehearses the likely decision questions walks into that paper with prepared material. A student who meets the case study three weeks before the paper buys expensive hours to do compressed work.

The preparation is also unusually suitable for low-intensity online sessions. Thirty minutes a fortnight spent interrogating the organisation, with reading set between sessions, accumulates into deep familiarity without disrupting anything else. Over video, the case study document sits on a shared screen and gets annotated collaboratively, which is more effective than reading it alone and considerably cheaper than crisis tutoring in the final term.

What the preparation cannot do is predict the questions, and any tutor implying otherwise should be treated with scepticism. The value is in knowing the organisation well enough that no question is spent on comprehension, so the whole of the writing time goes on analysis and recommendation. Higher Level students sit a longer version of this paper, which typically includes additional unseen stimulus material alongside the familiar case, so familiarity with the organisation buys even more there.

There is an academic-honesty boundary in this work that is worth naming. A tutor may teach the frameworks, question the student's reading of the organisation, and comment on practice answers. A tutor may not supply pre-written answers to be reproduced in the examination room, and a student who memorises someone else's paragraphs is both cheating and likely to misfire, because the question will not match. The preparation that is permitted is also the preparation that works.

sections.heading: The research project, the 1,800-word ceiling, and where the money goes
paragraphs: The internally assessed component is a research project on a real business issue, capped at 1,800 words and supported by evidence the student gathers. The word ceiling is the discipline, and it is also the budget. A tight, answerable question built on evidence the student can genuinely obtain fits inside 1,800 words with room for analysis. A broad question about a large organisation's overall strategy does not, and the hours spent cutting an over-length draft are the most wasteful hours in the whole subject.

So the paid time that pays for itself sits at the start. Testing a question for answerability takes one session and saves several. The test is mechanical: name the evidence that would answer this question, say where the student will get it, and check whether an analytical tool can be applied to it meaningfully. A question that fails any of those three should be changed in week one rather than defended in week nine. Dubai students often start from a family business or a well-known local organisation, which is a good instinct provided the access to evidence is real rather than assumed.

Draft feedback is the second legitimate spend, and it has firm boundaries. A tutor may read a draft, identify where the analysis thins out, point to a tool used decoratively, note that a recommendation has been asserted rather than justified, and ask what evidence supports a claim. A tutor may not author any part of the submission, supply paragraphs for insertion, or edit prose until the voice has changed. The student is the author of every word, and a record of what changed between drafts is worth keeping for exactly that reason.

A closing cost note on supervision. Any provider offering to supply finished assessed work, at any price, should be refused. One operator in this search results page sells completed internal assessments outright, which is an academic-integrity breach that triggers IB malpractice procedures, and the consequence falls on the student rather than the seller. The cheapest possible outcome in this subject is the one where nothing has to be withdrawn and resubmitted.
bullets: Test the research question for answerability before any research is done
Keep the draft inside 1,800 words from the outline stage, not by late cutting
Use each analytical tool to change a conclusion, never as decoration
Feedback arrives as questions and observations; the student does every revision

sections.heading: Cost in context: Dubai school fees, exam entry and the 2026-27 fee freeze
paragraphs: A tutoring invoice reads differently once it sits beside the other education costs a Dubai household already carries. Dubai's private school sector served 387,441 students across 227 private schools in 2024-25, offering seventeen different curricula, with UK curriculum schools at 37 per cent of enrolment, Indian at 26, US at 14 and International Baccalaureate at 7. The Diploma is therefore a minority curriculum in a very large market, which is part of why specialist Diploma tutors command the upper rate bands.

The timing is unusually favourable for budgeting. KHDA confirmed on 22 May 2026 that there would be no increase in private school fees in Dubai for the 2026-27 academic year, under the emirate's second economic incentives package. A family planning two years of Diploma support is therefore working against a flat school fee rather than a rising one. Dubai's 2026-27 intake also adds seven new private schools, four UK curriculum and three International Baccalaureate, creating 16,846 new places.

The table below places a tutoring line item against the other numbers in the same household budget. Figures that are published are marked as such; figures that vary enormously by school, including fees themselves, are described as bands rather than invented as points. No entry here is a quote from this platform, and school fees should always be read from the school's own KHDA-published fee listing rather than from any third party.

One further context point. Group revision classes at a tuition centre cost less per student per hour than one-to-one, and for a student who is broadly secure and needs pace they can be good value. For a student with a specific diagnosable weakness, group provision does not include individual script marking, which is the thing that actually moves the mark. Cheap provision that cannot deliver the mechanism is not a saving, which is the one place where the lowest number on a rate card is the wrong choice.

sections.heading: Who may legally charge you for private tutoring in the UAE
paragraphs: Private tutoring in the UAE operates under a permit regime, and the cost question and the legality question are connected: a provider quoting an unusually low cash rate is sometimes a provider operating outside it. The private tuition work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, is issued through MoHRE, and is granted free of charge for two years. There is no fee for the tutor to pass on, so no rate should be justified by the cost of the permit.

Eligible applicants include teachers registered in government or private schools, employees in government and private sectors, unemployed individuals, university students, and school students aged 15 to 18. MoHRE's own service page for it is titled issuance of a new work permit for private tutor licensing, lists no fees, states a two-working-day completion time, and is applied for through the MoHRE smart app, website and e-services system. Individuals offering private tutoring without a permit are subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws; the ministry has not published a fine schedule, so no amount appears here.

A tutoring operation with premises and staff in Dubai is a different legal animal from an individual tutor. That requires a KHDA Educational Services Permit for a training institute, with initial approval first and annual renewal requested at least thirty days before expiry. IB Gram does not hold that permit, does not operate premises in the UAE, and nothing on this page should be read as a claim to any regulator's approval or endorsement. Delivery here is live video, one to one, from tutors working remotely.

There is one more boundary worth knowing before you pay anyone. In Abu Dhabi, ADEK's professional-ethics rules bar private and charter school staff from paid private tutoring of students enrolled at their own school, and the MoHRE permit's code of conduct also restricts serving students affiliated with the tutor's own school. That is press-reported rather than taken from the current policy text, so verify it with ADEK if it bears on a decision. The underlying principle holds across the UAE: paying the person who marks your child's internal work is a conflict of interest, whatever the rate.

sections.heading: Scheduling a Business Management session into a Dubai week
paragraphs: The free hours in a Dubai Diploma student's week are fewer than the subject list implies, and a session booked into a slot that does not really exist is money spent on cancellations. KHDA requires Arabic, Islamic Education and social or moral studies in all Dubai private schools regardless of the licensed international curriculum, with those requirements to be implemented by the start of the 2025-26 academic year, or April 2026 where the school year begins in April. Instructional time for them is calculated on a 40-minute lesson unit.

KHDA also requires separate classes for Arabs and non-Arabs in Arabic as a first language, Islamic Education and Social Studies, and combined classes are prohibited because curriculum expectations and the language of instruction differ. More discrete timetable blocks means less timetable slack, and a family that picks one fixed weekly slot and protects it loses fewer paid sessions than a family that arranges each week by message. For the mandatory subjects, additional or different content without prior Ministry permission is not permitted, which is a genuine constraint on how any Arabic or Islamic Education support can be described.

Ramadan moves the whole pattern later, and a post-Iftar slot is a normal arrangement that costs nothing extra over video. Internal deadlines cluster in DP2, so a student taking Business Management alongside a science and a language will meet several internal submissions inside a few weeks. Mapping those at the start of DP1 is unglamorous and it prevents the emergency bookings that cost the most per hour.

On examination timing, this page publishes no IB dates. The IB's own website blocks automated checking, so no session or results date here is confirmed from the IB directly; UAE schools sit the May session and some candidates sit November, and the exact windows belong to the school's Diploma coordinator or ibo.org. For families also sitting Cambridge or Pearson papers, the published pattern is instructive, because those boards run two series a year in this region and the choice between them is a real one. A Cambridge candidate in the UAE sits June as the main series and November as the resit route; a Pearson Edexcel International GCSE candidate chooses between May/June and November in the same way, and Pearson's November 2026 timetable ran to 19 November 2026 with results reaching students the following January. Both boards close entries months ahead of the papers, which is why the school registrar files them and why leaving the administration to the student is how an entry gets missed.

process.title: Say which component and which unit
process.description: Business Management, finance and accounts, unseen paper, nine weeks to go is a brief that can be priced. Needs help with business is not. Naming the component and the unit determines which specialist fits and how many hours the work genuinely requires, which is what makes a quote honest.

process.title: Free trial lesson with a written output
process.description: The first session costs nothing and produces something: a short timed question attempted live, marked, and returned with the specific habits it exposed written down. That document is what you judge the match on, before any money moves. A trial that produces only a conversation has told you nothing.

process.title: Get the plan and the price in writing together
process.description: Before a block starts, you should have the session count, the frequency, the units to be covered, how many marked scripts you will receive, the per-session price, and the cancellation terms. Every item on that list is a cost driver, and anything absent from it tends to be absent in practice too.

process.title: Weekly or fortnightly sessions with work returned marked
process.description: Sessions run over live video at a fixed slot in Gulf Standard Time. Set work comes back annotated against the published criteria before the next session, so each paid hour starts from a named weakness rather than a general review. Fortnightly is the cheaper shape and often the right one in DP1.

process.title: Review at six weeks against what you received
process.description: Count the marked scripts, read the feedback, and decide: continue, change frequency, change tutor or stop. If no Business Management specialist is free in your window, you are told at the enquiry rather than matched with a general business graduate and charged specialist rates for it.

whyPoints.title: Published rates, attributed, in AED
whyPoints.description: Every figure on this page names the provider or survey that published it. That is uncommon in this market: three of the six pages ranking for these searches quote no price, and the two that do quote in dollars. You can hold any Dubai provider to the bands in the table above, including this one.

whyPoints.title: No travel cost in either direction
whyPoints.description: Delivery to UAE families is live video, so there is no travel time inside the rate and no commute at the student's end. In-home quotes in Dubai sit at AED 180 to 500 an hour partly because somebody is driving. Removing that cost is a real saving, not a marketing line.

whyPoints.title: Marked scripts as the deliverable
whyPoints.description: The unit worth comparing is cost per annotated script, not cost per hour of talking. Timed work marked against published criteria and returned before the next session is what changes a Business Management answer, and it is what the quoted plan commits to in writing.

whyPoints.title: The cheap hours bought early
whyPoints.description: The pre-released case study can be prepared at low intensity across months, which makes fortnightly DP1 sessions the best value in this subject. A plan that front-loads cheap preparation and reserves intensive work for the unseen paper costs less across two years than crisis booking does in one term.

whyPoints.title: Honest limits on what can be promised
whyPoints.description: No grade guarantee, no fabricated statistics, no claim of KHDA, MoHRE or IB approval, which this platform does not hold. No offer to produce assessed work at any price. Where availability for a component is thin, that is said at the enquiry rather than discovered in week three.

whyPoints.title: Specialists chosen on subject, not drive time
whyPoints.description: Because sessions run over video across the UAE, the match is made on depth in Diploma Business Management rather than on who lives near your community. A family in Dubai Investments Park gets the same pool as a family in Al Barsha, which is not true of any in-home arrangement.

faqs.question: What should an IB DP Business Management online tutor in Dubai cost per hour?
faqs.answer: On published Dubai figures as of October 2026, a qualified online subject tutor sits at roughly AED 150 to 300 an hour and a Diploma subject specialist at roughly AED 200 to 450 and above. Unitors publishes IB rates from AED 200, TutorChase publishes AED 270, and Bestimate's 2026 Dubai rate survey puts specialist exam-year work in the AED 200 to 450 and above band. Those are market rates from the sources named, not a price list for this platform. The more useful question is what the hour contains, because a rate that excludes marking is a different product at the same headline number.

faqs.question: For Business Management, does a monthly package beat an hourly booking in Dubai?
faqs.answer: It can be, and the condition attached is what decides it. Packages seen on the Dubai market include around AED 799 a month for eight online sessions and AED 1,599 to 1,799 a month for four two-hour in-home visits. The effective hourly rate inside a package is usually below the equivalent single-session rate, which is the point of it. What to check is what happens to unused sessions, whether a cancelled session rolls forward, and whether the package includes marking of timed work. A cheaper rate that quietly forfeits two sessions a month is not cheaper.

faqs.question: Which Business Management unit takes the most tutoring hours to repair?
faqs.answer: Finance and accounts, in almost every cohort. Its content is sequential, so a student who never secured contribution per unit will mis-handle break-even, cash flow forecasting, ratio interpretation and investment appraisal downstream, and those cannot be fixed in parallel. Repair therefore takes teaching time rather than practice time, which is slower and more expensive. Human resource management and the introductory unit are usually the cheapest to improve, because the content is intuitive and the lost marks come from answer structure, which responds quickly to marked timed practice. Diagnose before buying hours, and buy the expensive repair early.

faqs.question: How far in advance does the Business Management case study reach schools?
faqs.answer: The case study used for one of the two written papers is released to schools ahead of the examination series, well before the paper itself. Confirm the exact release and the version your child's school holds with the Diploma coordinator, since this page publishes no IB dates: the IB's own site blocks automated checking, so nothing here is confirmed from the IB directly. What matters commercially is the implication. Months of low-intensity preparation on the organisation costs a fraction of compressed work in the final term, which makes early fortnightly sessions the best-value shape available in this subject.

faqs.question: How long is the business research project allowed to be?
faqs.answer: The project is capped at 1,800 words in the current guide, and the ceiling should shape the question rather than the editing. A narrow question with identifiable evidence fits inside the limit with room left for analysis and a justified recommendation. A broad question about a large organisation's whole strategy does not, and cutting an over-length draft back is the most wasteful work in the subject. The practical sequence is to test the question for answerability first, agree where the evidence comes from, then outline to the word budget. Confirm the current limit with the school's coordinator before drafting begins.

faqs.question: Does Higher Level sit a longer case study paper than Standard Level?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Higher Level version of the case study paper runs longer and typically carries additional unseen stimulus material alongside the familiar organisation, which is why deep familiarity with the case pays back more at Higher Level than at Standard Level. The written paper spanning all five units and the research project are common to both levels. For a family budgeting, the implication is that Higher Level students get more value from early low-intensity case study preparation, and that the extra paper length is a reason to practise under full timing rather than on single questions.

faqs.question: Is a group revision class a cheaper way to prepare for the written papers?
faqs.answer: Per student per hour, yes, and for the right student it is genuinely good value. Group provision works when a student is broadly secure and needs pace, structure and the discipline of a timetable. It does not work when the problem is a specific diagnosable weakness, because group formats almost never include individual script marking, and individual marking is the mechanism that moves an applied-analysis mark. Paying less for a format that cannot deliver the mechanism is not a saving. Diagnose first, then choose the format that matches the diagnosis rather than the budget.

faqs.question: What does the management toolkit actually add to an answer?
faqs.answer: A tool earns marks when it changes the conclusion and loses marks when it decorates the answer. A student who draws a framework, labels it correctly and then recommends what they would have recommended anyway has spent writing time for nothing. A student who uses the same framework to show which option survives scrutiny has used it analytically. The toolkit splits into situational and decision-making frameworks, with several reserved for Higher Level. Teaching each tool to the point where it alters a recommendation takes about one session per tool and pays back across both written papers.

faqs.question: Do tutoring rates in Dubai rise as the examination series approaches?
faqs.answer: Availability tightens and rates firm up rather than soften, which is a reason to plan early rather than a reason to panic. Specialist Diploma tutors fill their best slots first, so the family booking in February for an April start is choosing from a thinner pool at the top of the published bands. The counter-move is the cheap-hours strategy: fortnightly sessions through DP1 on case study preparation and foundational units, then a short intensive block for timed papers. That shape costs less across two years than any single term of emergency booking does.

faqs.question: Does the quoted hourly rate include marking a timed paper?
faqs.answer: Ask, because the answer varies and it is the largest hidden variable in Dubai tutoring pricing. Marking a Business Management response properly takes a specialist a meaningful share of a lesson's length, since applied analysis cannot be checked against an answer key. Some providers include it, some bill it separately, and some simply do not do it. A rate card gives no clue either way. Get the answer in writing alongside the session count, the units to be covered and the cancellation terms, and compare providers on cost per marked script rather than on the headline hourly figure.

faqs.question: Can one tutor cover both Business Management and Economics for the same student?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, and it is worth checking rather than assuming. The two subjects reward different answers: Economics wants diagram accuracy and theoretical chains of reasoning, Business Management wants application to a specific organisation using named tools. A tutor strong in one and merely competent in the other will improve one grade and leave the other alone. Where a genuine specialist in both is available, a single tutor reduces cost and keeps the two evaluation styles deliberately separate, which students taking both subjects frequently confuse. Where they are not, two specialists beat one generalist at the same combined price.

faqs.question: Is Business Management a weaker Diploma choice than Economics for a business degree?
faqs.answer: Entry requirements rarely turn on which group three subject was taken, and more often on the mathematics route and the overall points. Some courses name Higher Level Mathematics or a specific mathematics option; few name Business Management or Economics specifically. The reliable method is to read the admissions pages of three or four target universities before subject choices close at the end of DP1, and to note whether Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretation is specified. No tutoring page, this one included, is a source for an admissions requirement.

faqs.question: What should a Dubai family budget for two years of Business Management support?
faqs.answer: Work from a shape rather than a single number. A fortnightly session across DP1 at the mid band, a short research project supervision block, and a weekly timed-paper block in the final term is the pattern most families settle into. Using Bestimate's published monthly bands, mid-market weekly sessions run roughly AED 600 to 1,200 a month and specialist exam-year work roughly AED 1,000 to 2,000 and above. Fortnightly roughly halves the monthly figure. Build the estimate from the frequency you actually need in each term, then hold the provider to the marked-script count.

faqs.question: Who in the UAE is allowed to charge for private tutoring?
faqs.answer: Private tutoring is permit-regulated. The private tuition work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, is issued through MoHRE, and is granted free of charge for two years. Eligible applicants include registered school teachers, government and private-sector employees, unemployed residents, university students and school students aged 15 to 18. MoHRE's service page lists no fee and a two-working-day completion time. Tutoring without a permit attracts fines and penalties under the applicable laws, and no fine schedule has been published, so no amount is quoted here. A business with premises needs a KHDA training-institute permit instead.

faqs.question: Are there cheaper options than one-to-one for a student only slightly behind?
faqs.answer: Yes, and they are worth trying first. A student who understands the content and loses marks to structure can often be fixed by past papers marked by their own teacher, a study group working through the case study together, and the published assessment criteria used as a self-check list. That costs nothing. One-to-one earns its rate when the weakness is specific, when individual marking is the missing mechanism, or when nobody at the school has capacity to read the student's own work closely. Spending money before exhausting the free options is the commonest avoidable cost in this market.

dubai/ib-dp-business-management-tutor.tutorsIntro: The tutors below teach IB Diploma Business Management at Standard and Higher Level, including research project supervision and work on the pre-released case study. Each profile names the units they teach most often. Take the free first lesson, then change tutor at no charge if the fit is wrong.

intro.heading: Buy a plan with a number on it, not an hour with a rate on it
paragraphs: Ask what a Business Management tutor costs in Dubai and the answers you get are all technically true and none of them useful. Rates published in this emirate run from AED 33 to 52 an hour at Tutopiya's budget end and AED 45 to 65 at EdFlik's, through AED 150 to 300 for a qualified subject tutor, to the AED 200 to 450 specialist band on Bestimate's 2026 Dubai table, with BartyED quoting AED 650 for premium named tutoring. Every one of those numbers is the market. None of them tells you what your child's situation will actually cost, because the hourly rate is the smallest variable in the calculation.

The variable that matters is how many hours the plan needs, and that depends on three things a rate card cannot see: when you start, which components are weak, and whether the research project has been begun. A DP1 student who needs one unit closed and a project question approved is buying twelve to eighteen hours across two years. A DP2 student six weeks from the papers with no project draft and a 4 in the mocks is buying twenty-five hours in a fortnight, at a higher rate, for a smaller movement. Same subject, same emirate, same tutor quality, four times the invoice.

Business Management also prices differently from a science or a mathematics course because of where its marks sit. A substantial share of the grade comes from a written response to a case study the school receives in advance, and another large share from a research project the student designs around a real organisation. Neither is content you can cram. Both reward work done early, which is why in this subject specifically the cheapest tutoring is bought in the first year and the most expensive tutoring is bought in the last term.

One more thing to settle before any money changes hands: what the tutor will not do. The research project has to be the student's own work, built on data the student gathered or sourced. A provider who offers to hand over a finished project is selling an academic-honesty finding that attaches to your child's Diploma, not to their invoice. Legitimate support is slower and duller, and it is the only kind worth paying for. The boundary belongs in writing before the first session, not in a conversation after a problem.

So read this page in that order. The first section prices three plans a Dubai family might realistically buy, with the hours and the totals stated at the published market bands. The sections after it explain what those hours are spent on: the command-term ladder that mid-band scripts keep failing to climb, the organisation choice that decides whether the research project works, and the difference the Higher Level extension makes to both. Then the practical layer: permits, VAT, trial conditions, and how many evenings a Dubai Year 12 week actually leaves free.

dubai/ib-dp-business-management-tutor.programmesIntro: Business Management is a final-two-year subject, but the skills it is marked on are built across the whole IB continuum: reading a stakeholder's position, using a tool rather than naming it, and handling evidence without exaggerating it. Here is what each IB programme a Dubai school runs contributes.

programmes.name: Middle Years Programme
programmes.description: There is no MYP business course. The groundwork arrives through Individuals and Societies and through the MYP personal project, which is the first time most students scope a piece of independent work, keep a process journal and meet a word limit. That is closer to the Diploma research project than anything else in the continuum, and students who took it seriously arrive able to plan a timeline.
programmes.countryNote: Many Dubai Diploma candidates come from an MYP cohort on the same campus, and departments here report the same inheritance each year: students who can discuss a company's decisions fluently but cannot apply a named management tool to a specific problem. The repair is technical rather than conceptual and takes two or three sessions per tool.

programmes.name: Diploma Programme
programmes.description: Business Management sits in Group 3 and runs across both years at Standard or Higher Level. Candidates sit a written paper based on a case study released to schools in advance, a second written paper built on unseen data, and submit a business research project built around a real organisation within a stated word limit. Confirm the current component weightings and limits in the IB subject guide at ibo.org.
programmes.countryNote: Business Management is one of the most frequently chosen Group 3 subjects in Dubai Diploma schools, often running alongside Economics in the same block so students pick one. KHDA inspects these schools annually on a six-band scale and its published reports name subject-level strengths, which is worth reading before deciding whether a mid-term grade reflects teaching or workload.

programmes.name: Career-related Programme
programmes.description: The Career-related Programme combines Diploma courses with a career-related study, a reflective project and a personal and professional skills course. Business Management is a common pairing because the career-related study often sits in the same field. A CP student sits the same Business Management papers and submits the same project, so the subject support required is identical to a Diploma student's.
programmes.countryNote: A handful of Dubai schools run the Career-related Programme, which means a CP student taking Business Management is frequently the only one in the building on that route. The practical consequence is scheduling: the reflective project and the career-related study compete for the same evenings as the business research project, usually in the first term of the second year.

dubai/ib-dp-business-management-tutor.subjectsIntro: Business Management is five units plus a set of analytical tools, assessed through two written papers and one research project. Below is what a tutor works through with a Dubai candidate, and where the marks most often go missing in each part.

subjects.name: Unit 1: Introduction to business management
subjects.description: Business types, sectors, objectives, stakeholders, growth and the external environment. It reads as background and carries real marks, because almost every extended answer in the subject requires a stakeholder position and most candidates assert one instead of justifying it from the case material.

subjects.name: Unit 2: Human resource management
subjects.description: Organisational structure, leadership, motivation theory, industrial relations and change management. The commonest deduction is theory recited rather than applied: a candidate who explains a motivation theory in general terms without connecting it to the named employees in the case loses the application marks entirely.

subjects.name: Unit 3: Finance and accounts
subjects.description: Sources of finance, costs and revenues, break-even, final accounts, ratio analysis and cash-flow forecasting. This is where Dubai candidates most often need teaching rather than technique, and where a calculation shown without a unit or a conclusion scores the method mark and loses the rest.

subjects.name: Unit 4: Marketing
subjects.description: Market research, segmentation, the marketing mix, branding and international marketing. Students enjoy this unit and over-write it. The marks go to answers that choose between options and justify the choice with case evidence rather than listing every element of a mix the examiner already knows.

subjects.name: Unit 5: Operations management
subjects.description: Production methods, quality management, location, supply chain, research and development and crisis management. It is the unit most often rushed at the end of DP2 and the one that appears most reliably in unseen data questions, which makes it the highest-risk gap to leave open.

subjects.name: The pre-released case study
subjects.description: A case study reaches schools well before the examination, and preparation for it can begin the moment it arrives. Candidates who treat it as reading material rather than as a research task arrive knowing the story and not the numbers, the stakeholders or the tools the case invites.

subjects.name: The unseen data paper
subjects.description: Short and extended responses built on stimulus material and quantitative extracts never seen before. The skill is reading quickly, extracting the right figure, and spending the writing time on the evaluative part rather than on describing the business in the opening paragraph.

subjects.name: The business research project
subjects.levels: Internal assessment, Standard and Higher Level
subjects.description: An independent investigation into a real organisation and a real issue, within a stated word limit and marked against published criteria. Most lost marks come from a question that cannot be answered with the data available, which is a problem created in week one and discovered in month four.

subjects.name: The management toolkit
subjects.levels: Both papers, with Higher Level additions
subjects.description: SWOT, Ansoff, BCG, decision trees, force-field analysis, the business plan and more, with some tools reserved for Higher Level in the current guide. Examiners reward a tool used to reach a judgement, not a tool drawn and left unexplained beside the answer.

subjects.name: Command terms and the mark ladder
subjects.description: Define, describe, apply, analyse, discuss and evaluate carry different expectations and different mark allocations. Practising the same stem under two different command terms in one session is the fastest way to show a student why their long answers are scoring in the middle.

dubai/ib-dp-business-management-tutor.regionsIntro: For a Business Management student, the practical effect of where you live in Dubai is two-fold: when a weekday session can start, and which organisations are close enough to approach for primary research. Below are the communities the enquiries come from, with both in mind.

regions.name: Business Bay, Downtown Dubai and DIFC
regions.note: Apartment living with short school runs and an unusual advantage for this subject: a dense concentration of small businesses, head offices and service firms within walking distance, which makes a primary-research interview genuinely arrangeable rather than theoretical.

regions.name: Al Barsha, Barsha Heights and Emirates Hills
regions.note: The deepest band of Diploma provision in the emirate, where Business Management usually runs as a full class at both levels. Requests here are weighted towards the pre-released case study and towards marking, because the five units are generally covered on schedule.

regions.name: Dubai Marina and Jumeirah Lakes Towers
regions.note: Two schools inside the district and several more one interchange away, so a 4.30pm start works most days. The retail and food-service businesses at ground level in both towers clusters are the commonest subjects of research projects from this area.

regions.name: Mirdif, Al Warqa and Al Qusais
regions.note: Bigger households and later bus arrivals push a realistic session start towards half past six. Smaller Diploma cohorts here sometimes mean Business Management is taught alongside another Group 3 subject by the same teacher, which shows up as thin coverage of finance and accounts.

regions.name: Dubai Hills Estate and Al Quoz
regions.note: Short runs to several Diploma schools, and families who tend to buy ninety-minute sessions because a timed paper and its read-back will not fit into sixty minutes. The Al Quoz industrial and creative district next door is useful for an operations-focused project.

regions.name: Arabian Ranches, The Springs and Motor City
regions.note: Inland communities where the school run can take forty minutes each way at the wrong hour, which is why online tuition was normal here before it was normal elsewhere. Weekend morning sessions are more popular in this band than anywhere else in Dubai.

schoolClusters.city: The Al Barsha and Emirates Hills Diploma band
schoolClusters.note: Where Business Management is most reliably offered at both levels with a dedicated teacher. Families in this band usually want case-study preparation and marked papers rather than content teaching, and they tend to start asking in the first term of DP2 once the case study has arrived.

schoolClusters.city: Deira, Mirdif and the Festival City corridor
schoolClusters.note: Smaller cohorts, where Business Management is sometimes taught by a teacher covering two Group 3 subjects. The common request from this corridor is finance and accounts taught properly from the start, plus supervision of a research project that has not yet found a usable question.

sections.heading: Three realistic plans, priced against what the Dubai market publishes
paragraphs: A plan is the only unit of purchase that can actually be compared between providers, so here are three, costed at the published bands rather than at any price of ours. The first starts in DP1 and keeps the subject from going wrong. The second starts after the DP2 mock examinations and repairs specific components. The third starts in the final six weeks and does what can still be done. The hourly rate is similar in all three. The totals are not remotely similar.

Notice what the table shows about timing. The DP1 plan uses more calendar and fewer hours, because a unit closed in the week it is taught takes two hours and the same unit rebuilt in April takes five, alongside five other subjects competing for the same evenings. The final-term plan is not bad value per hour; it is expensive because it is buying technique under a clock, usually at two sessions a week, and because by then the research project is either finished or a crisis.

Use these as a template for interrogating any quote you receive. Ask the provider to state the number of sessions, the length of each in minutes, whether marking between sessions is included, and what the total comes to. If they cannot or will not put a total next to a plan, you are not being sold a plan. You are being sold an open-ended hourly arrangement with your family's exam calendar as the only thing limiting it.
