sections.heading: The scientific investigation: 24 marks, four criteria, and the line a tutor holds
paragraphs: The scientific investigation is 20% of the Higher Level Chemistry grade and is marked out of 24 across four criteria of six marks each: research design, data analysis, conclusion and evaluation. The report has a word ceiling, and the time allocation inside the course is about ten hours. Those are the facts that should shape any paid support, because they tell you that the criteria are weighted equally and that a weak evaluation costs exactly as much as a weak research design.

What a tutor may do is teach and give feedback. That means explaining what a controlled variable has to look like in a rate experiment, showing worked examples of uncertainty propagation, asking why a particular graph was chosen, and commenting against a criterion so the student knows which of the six marks are not yet earned. The comments go back as a sheet. The student then revises their own report in their own words.

What no tutor may do is author any part of the report, supply text for it, or hand back a version with sentences inserted. IB academic-honesty rules make the authorship of coursework the student's own responsibility, and a breach is a malpractice matter for the candidate, not an administrative one. Pages in this market that offer finished investigations for a fee are selling something that puts the student's Diploma at risk. We say that plainly because the distinction is the whole value of paid support here.

In practice the honest version is also the more useful one. A student who has had the evaluation criterion explained once and then written their own evaluation can do it again for the next subject's internal assessment. A student handed a finished evaluation has learned nothing transferable and has a file note waiting for them if anyone looks.

sections.heading: What Higher Level Chemistry support costs in Dubai, and what the money buys
paragraphs: Three of the six best-ranking pages in this market publish no price at all, and the two that do quote in US dollars. The table below gives the AED bands with the source of each named, as of October 2026. These are market rates, not an IB Gram price list: the first lesson here is free and the rate is confirmed in writing before the second one.

What moves a Dubai quote is not mysterious. Higher Level costs more than Standard Level because the tutor pool is smaller. The weeks before the May session cost more than October because demand rises. Marking a full paper outside the session is chargeable time with some providers and included with others, and that single difference can be worth more than the headline hourly rate. Ask what a quoted hour includes before comparing two numbers.

Context helps too. KHDA confirmed on 22 May 2026 that private school fees in Dubai would not rise for the 2026-27 academic year, under the emirate's second economic incentives package. Against a fee bill that is flat, a weekly Higher Level Chemistry hour is a smaller decision than it looks in isolation, and published monthly estimates for weekly one-hour sessions in this market run from AED 240-600 at the budget end to AED 1,000-2,000 and above for specialist support in an examination year.

The honest answer to what a family should spend is that it depends on the residual list. A student with one weak Additional Higher Level area and sound technique needs six to eight hours. A student who needs bonding rebuilt, mechanisms drilled and an investigation rescued needs a term. The diagnostic in the free first lesson is what tells you which of those you are looking at, and it costs nothing to find out.

sections.heading: KHDA reports, predicted grades and reading your school's own evidence
paragraphs: Dubai private schools are overseen by KHDA, the Knowledge and Human Development Authority, which is responsible for enhancing and overseeing the quality of private education in the emirate. Inspection outcomes are published on a six-band scale from Outstanding down to Very Weak. A band is a judgement about a school, not about your child's chemistry, and it is worth reading at the level of the subject commentary rather than the headline.

The document that matters more to a Higher Level Chemistry candidate is the predicted grade. Schools generate it from internal assessment data, and it drives university applications long before the May session. A prediction built on a weak Paper 2 performance in January will follow the student through the whole application cycle, which is why the term before mocks is the highest-leverage place to put tutoring hours.

Ask the school three things: which past papers the internal examinations were built from, how the Paper 1 and Paper 2 marks were weighted in the reported grade, and what the investigation mark currently stands at out of 24. Those three answers tell a tutor more than any general description of how your child is doing, and schools answer them readily when asked specifically.

Arabic, Islamic Education and Social Studies run alongside the Diploma for the relevant students in Dubai private schools regardless of the curriculum the school is licensed to teach, and KHDA requires separate classes for Arabs and non-Arabs in Arabic as a first language, Islamic Education and Social Studies. That matters for the timetable rather than for chemistry, but it is one more fixed block to plan a weekly Chemistry slot around.

sections.heading: Scheduling in Gulf Standard Time, Ramadan, and what happens when no specialist is free
paragraphs: Every session is booked in Gulf Standard Time and confirmed against your child's school timetable, not against a tutor's convenience. Most Dubai Diploma families start with one weekday slot between 4pm and 7pm and add a weekend block in DP2, when timed papers need ninety uninterrupted minutes. The slot is held for the term, because a Higher Level science improves with regularity more than with volume.

Ramadan changes the day rather than the plan. School hours shorten, energy patterns shift, and many families move sessions to after Iftar. That is available and it is normal; it needs to be agreed in advance so the tutor's week is built around it. The weeks of Eid are usually paused outright, and the twelve-week block simply becomes a fourteen-week one. Summer works the other way: students who have fallen behind often do their most useful chemistry in July, with no school competing for attention.

Coverage is the thing most providers in this market do not disclose. Higher Level Chemistry with investigation support in a specific evening slot is a narrow request, and there are weeks when no suitable specialist is free. When that happens you are told before you book, not after. The options are a different time with the right specialist, a waiting period with a date attached, or a tutor whose Higher Level experience is in a neighbouring area of the syllabus, stated plainly so you can judge it.

Private tutoring in the UAE is permitted work. Individuals providing private lessons need a MoHRE private tuition work permit, introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, which is granted free of charge for two years. Anyone offering private tutoring without that permit is subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws; no schedule of amounts has been published, so none is quoted here. A parent can ask any tutor whether they hold the permit, and a straight answer is a reasonable expectation.

process.title: Send the last marked paper
process.description: Upload or photograph your child's most recent Chemistry script with the teacher's marks still on it, and name the school and the term each topic was taught. A marked script tells a tutor more in five minutes than a phone call does in thirty, and it means the first lesson starts from evidence.

process.title: Free 45-minute first lesson
process.description: One subject, 45 minutes, no card details required. The student works a Paper 2 question under time while the tutor watches, then the two of them mark it together. You receive a short written note afterwards setting out what was lost and which of the three loss categories it fell into.

process.title: Agree the twelve-week shape
process.description: Slot, frequency and topic order are fixed in writing before the second lesson, along with the rate and what it includes. Most Higher Level Chemistry families start at one 60-minute session a week and add a second in the term before the May session rather than at the start.

process.title: Evidence after every session
process.description: Each lesson ends with a marked artefact and a paragraph you can read the same evening: what was worked on, what the mark was, what changes next week. There is no portal to log into and no progress percentage, because neither of those is evidence of anything.

process.title: Review at week six
process.description: At the halfway point the mark log is compared with where it started. If the loss profile has not moved, the tutor or the plan changes. That conversation is scheduled in advance rather than left for you to request, and it is the point at which most families decide whether to continue.

whyPoints.title: Matched by component, not by subject label
whyPoints.description: A request for a Chemistry tutor is too coarse to match on. Paper 1B uncertainty work, Paper 2 extended response and investigation data analysis are three different specialisms. The marked script you send decides which one your child is matched to.

whyPoints.title: Market rates quoted with their source
whyPoints.description: Every AED figure on this page is attributed to the published rate card or survey it came from, with the month it was read. Most pages in this market publish no price at all, and two of the ranking ones quote in a currency UAE families do not transact in.

whyPoints.title: The honesty line is written down
whyPoints.description: A tutor teaches, reviews and comments against criteria. No part of an internally assessed report is authored by anyone but the student, and each checkpoint leaves a written record your school can see. That is a standard this market does not uniformly meet.

whyPoints.title: Gulf Standard Time, including Ramadan
whyPoints.description: Sessions are scheduled against your child's timetable in local time, with post-Iftar slots during Ramadan and a planned pause over Eid. The twelve-week block stretches to fit the UAE calendar rather than the calendar bending to the plan.

whyPoints.description: Higher Level Chemistry in a narrow evening slot is a specific request, and some weeks it cannot be filled. You are told that before payment, with the alternatives spelled out. No competitor page found in this market discloses a coverage limit at all.

whyPoints.title: Online because of the tutor pool, not the logistics
whyPoints.description: IB Gram does not offer home visits in Dubai; home visits are a service we run only in India. For a Higher Level science the online format is what makes a mechanisms specialist reachable from any community in the emirate rather than only from the nearest few.

faqs.question: What evidence will we actually see after a month of Chemistry HL sessions?
faqs.answer: Four marked artefacts and a mark log. By the end of a month a weekly student has sat and had marked at least one timed Paper 2 question, one Paper 1B data set and one rewrite, with each mark recorded by question reference, marks available, marks awarded and loss category. You also hold four short written notes, one per session. The useful part is the pattern: if three of four entries show marks lost to command terms rather than content, the next block is technique work. That conclusion is visible to you in the log rather than something you have to take on trust.

faqs.question: How do you work out which Chemistry HL topic is costing my child the most marks?
faqs.answer: By marking real scripts and categorising each lost mark. A timed question is sat under conditions, marked against the published criteria in the session, and every missing mark is labelled as knowledge, command term or presentation. After three scripts the categories have enough entries to show a pattern. A student losing marks across unrelated topics usually has a technique problem; a student losing them in clusters has specific content gaps. The approach matters because the two need opposite plans, and guessing between them is how a term of tutoring gets spent in the wrong place.

faqs.question: Is Chemistry Higher Level genuinely harder than Standard Level, or just longer?
faqs.answer: Both, but the difficulty is the part that matters. Higher Level runs to 240 taught hours against 150 at Standard Level, and the extra content is concentrated in areas that ask a student to combine two ideas: a rate law with a mechanism, an equilibrium constant with Gibbs free energy, an electrode potential with a feasibility judgement. Standard Level questions more often test one idea at a time. A student who was comfortable at Standard Level content and stalls at Higher Level has usually met the join rather than a knowledge wall, and the join responds well to drilling.

faqs.question: My son gets the multiple choice right and loses marks on Paper 2. Why?
faqs.answer: Because the two components reward different things. Paper 1A rewards fast recognition of a correct statement. Paper 2 rewards chemistry written to a command term, with the reasoning visible, in a quantity the mark allocation implies. A student with strong recall can read a four-mark explain question, write three correct sentences of description, and score one. The fix is not more content revision. It is sitting extended-response questions, marking them against the scheme, and rewriting them until the structure of a four-mark answer is automatic.

faqs.question: Which Chemistry HL topics need the most one-to-one hours?
faqs.answer: In marked Dubai scripts the heaviest users of tutoring time are chemical equilibrium with its link to Gibbs free energy, proton transfer with pH curves and buffers, and the organic mechanisms. Each typically takes four to six one-to-one hours to move, assuming the Standard Level groundwork is secure and the student practises between sessions. Rate laws and electrode potentials sit a little lower at three to five hours. Spectroscopic identification is the cheapest win: two or three sessions of combining mass spectrometry, infrared and NMR evidence usually settles it.

faqs.question: How much does an online Chemistry Higher Level tutor cost per hour for a Dubai family?
faqs.answer: Market rates in Dubai for a qualified subject tutor online run roughly AED 150-300 an hour, and for an IB or A Level specialist roughly AED 200-450 and above, according to published agency rate pages and Bestimate's Tutoring Cost Dubai 2026 table. Budget platform rates start far lower, from around AED 33-150, and a premium named tutor is advertised at up to AED 650. Those are market figures rather than ours. Ask any provider what the hour includes, because marking a full paper outside the session is chargeable with some and included with others.

faqs.question: Can a tutor mark my daughter's past paper and show the examiner's reasoning?
faqs.answer: Yes, and that is the core of how these sessions run. A past paper is sat under time, then marked against the published criteria with the mark allocation written beside each line of the answer. The tutor says which word in the question triggered which requirement and where the answer stopped short. Published mark schemes and papers are referenced and linked rather than reproduced or supplied as downloads, since those documents belong to the board. What your daughter keeps is her own script, annotated, plus the log entry.

faqs.question: Does the data booklet mean my child does not need to memorise anything?
faqs.answer: It removes the constants, standard equations and spectroscopic reference data from memory work for both papers, which is a real help. It does not remove the need to know which relationship applies, how to rearrange it, or what the result means chemically. The commonest failure in marked scripts is a student who finds the right equation in the booklet, substitutes correctly, and then cannot say what the answer implies about the reaction. The booklet shifts the difficulty from recall to selection and interpretation, and tutoring hours should follow that shift.

faqs.question: How long before the May session should Higher Level Chemistry revision start?
faqs.answer: The highest-leverage window is the term before the February mock examinations, because that is when predicted grades are set. A twelve-week block started in October or November produces a changed mark profile in time to influence the prediction, and leaves the spring free for paper practice. Starting after the mocks still works for technique and for the two-topic questions where Higher Level marks concentrate, but it is too late to rebuild DP1 content. The IB session dates themselves should be confirmed with your school's Diploma coordinator rather than taken from any tutoring page.

faqs.question: What is a tutor allowed to do with my child's Chemistry investigation draft?
faqs.answer: Read it, ask questions about it, and comment against the four criteria so your child knows which of the twenty-four marks are not yet earned. A tutor can show worked examples of uncertainty propagation, explain what an evaluation has to weigh rather than list, and point out that a graph choice does not support the conclusion. What a tutor cannot do is author any part of the report or hand back a version with sentences inserted. The student revises their own text, and each checkpoint leaves a written record the school can see.

faqs.question: Will Chemistry Higher Level be enough for a medical degree application from Dubai?
faqs.answer: Chemistry at Higher Level is the usual core requirement for medicine, and most medical schools ask for a second science alongside it, commonly Biology. Specific grade requirements and the admissions tests vary by country and by university, and they change year to year, so the only reliable source is the admissions page of the universities your child is applying to. Tutoring does not alter a prerequisite and is not required for any application. What it can do is move a Higher Level mark profile in the term before predicted grades are issued.

faqs.question: Our school predicted a 5 in Chemistry HL. Can that prediction move?
faqs.answer: Predictions come from internal assessment data, so they move when that data moves. The practical route is to find out which papers the internal examinations were built from and how Paper 1 and Paper 2 marks were weighted in the reported grade, then put the tutoring hours where the weighting is heaviest. Since Paper 2 is 44% of the final grade, a student whose internal Paper 2 mark improves usually sees the prediction follow at the next reporting point. No tutor can promise a grade, and anyone who does is selling something they cannot deliver.

faqs.question: Does an online lesson work for a subject with as much practical work as Chemistry HL?
faqs.answer: For the assessed parts, yes. Papers 1 and 2 are written, and the practical skills they test are data handling, uncertainty, graph work and evaluation, all of which work well on a shared screen with the student's own results in front of both people. The hands-on laboratory work happens at school, where the equipment and the supervision are, and that is where it should happen. Sessions support the design and the analysis around it. A shared whiteboard handles mechanisms better than most classrooms do, because every arrow can be drawn, erased and redrawn.

faqs.question: Can lessons run after Iftar during Ramadan for a Chemistry HL student?
faqs.answer: Yes, and a large share of Dubai Diploma families move to that pattern. School hours shorten during Ramadan and afternoon concentration drops, so a post-Iftar slot often produces better work than the usual 5pm one. The change needs agreeing in advance so the tutor's week is built around it rather than squeezed. Most families pause outright over Eid, which stretches a twelve-week block to fourteen weeks. The plan absorbs that; the one thing that does not work is leaving the decision until the first week of Ramadan.

faqs.question: What happens if no Chemistry Higher Level specialist is free in our preferred slot?
faqs.answer: You are told before you book rather than after. Higher Level Chemistry with investigation support in a narrow weekday evening window is a specific request, and in some weeks it cannot be filled. The options offered are a different time with the right specialist, a waiting period with an actual date attached, or a tutor whose Higher Level experience sits in a neighbouring area of the syllabus, described plainly so you can judge whether it fits. No page found in this market discloses a coverage limit, which is why it is stated here.

faqs.question: Does a Chemistry Higher Level grade matter for Ministry of Education equivalency in the UAE?
faqs.answer: Equivalency is a Ministry of Education process and it is not something a tutoring provider performs or influences. For the British track the published requirements are five accredited GCSE or IGCSE subjects at no less than grade E or 3, with Arabic and Islamic education excluded from that count, plus one Advanced Level subject at no less than E or two Advanced Subsidiary subjects at the same grade. No verified International Baccalaureate points threshold has been read on the ministry's own pages, so none is published here. Check the current requirement with the ministry directly.

dubai/ib-dp-chemistry-hl-online-tutor.closingBody: The useful first step is not a conversation about goals. It is a script. Send your child's most recent Higher Level Chemistry paper with the teacher's marks still on it, say which school and which term the topic was taught, and book the free 45-minute first lesson. Your child sits one question under time, the tutor marks it with them, and you receive a written note the same evening naming what was lost and why. If the diagnosis is six hours of work, that is what you will be told. If it is a term, you will be told that too, with the residual list attached.

dubai/ib-dp-chemistry-hl-tutor.tutorsIntro: The tutors below teach IB Diploma Chemistry at Higher Level for Dubai students. Each quotes against a stated session length and a stated amount of marking, so a family can compare the arrangement with the market bands set out further down this page rather than with an advertisement.

intro.heading: Why two Chemistry HL quotes in Dubai can differ by a factor of ten
paragraphs: A Dubai parent who asks three providers what Higher Level chemistry support costs will get three incompatible answers. One quotes AED 45 an hour. One quotes AED 270. One quotes AED 650 and declines to say what the hour contains. None of the three is lying. They are selling different things under the same word, and the unit of comparison that would make the difference visible is almost never published.

The useful unit is not the hour. It is the hour plus whatever happens between hours. A tutor who teaches for sixty minutes and leaves is selling contact time. A tutor who marks a timed Paper 2 question against the published scheme before the lesson, spends the lesson on the script, and writes a note afterwards is selling diagnosis, and the diagnosis is what moves a chemistry grade. Two families spending the same AED 1,200 a month can be buying entirely different products, and the cheaper-per-hour arrangement is frequently the more expensive one per mark recovered.

Higher Level chemistry raises the stakes because the course is large. It runs to roughly 240 taught hours against 150 at Standard Level, across the same six themes, with a longer Paper 1 carrying more multiple-choice items, a longer extended-response Paper 2, and the same 24-mark scientific investigation. The additional content is not evenly difficult. Organic mechanisms, acid-base calculations with buffers and pH curves, energetics including entropy and spontaneity, electrode potentials and rate equations derived from data account for most of the hours a Dubai family ends up paying for. Spotting that early is worth more than any discount.

Context helps too. KHDA confirmed on 22 May 2026 that there would be no increase in private school fees in Dubai for the 2026-27 academic year, under Dubai's second economic incentives package valued at AED 1.5 billion. The emirate's sector keeps growing: seven new private schools open for 2026-27, four UK curriculum and three International Baccalaureate, creating 16,846 new places, after six opened during 2025-26 and enrolment rose 6 per cent. Tutoring is the one education cost in this market with no regulator setting a ceiling, which is exactly why a family should price it deliberately.

What follows is a cost analysis rather than a brochure. Six provider models with their published AED bands. What an hour includes at each tier. Tutoring measured against school fees and examination entry. The arithmetic of a pair or a small group. Four spending patterns that reliably waste money. The Higher Level topics that justify one-to-one rates and the ones that do not. What can and cannot be bought around the scientific investigation. And what a parent can verify before paying anyone. The aim is that a family finishes this page able to price a quote rather than simply react to one.

dubai/ib-dp-chemistry-hl-tutor.programmesIntro: Cost behaves differently at each stage of an IB school career, because what a family is buying changes. The three programmes below are where Dubai spending on chemistry support actually occurs.

programmes.name: Diploma Programme

Chemistry HL is the most commonly bought science support at this stage because it is both large and a prerequisite for several competitive degrees, which concentrates demand into the two Diploma years.
programmes.countryNote: In Dubai, Diploma spending clusters in two places: the winter of DP1, when the investigation and the Extended Essay collide, and the spring of DP2 before the written papers. Rates do not formally rise in the exam term, but availability tightens, and the specialist slots at a given price fill first. A family that books a recurring slot in September is buying at a different effective price from one booking in March.

programmes.name: Middle Years Programme
programmes.description: Five years of criterion-assessed study with optional eAssessment. Science support bought at this stage is cheaper per hour and tends to be about study habits and scientific writing rather than examination technique, because there is no external paper to prepare for in most settings.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai families often underspend in Year 10 and Year 11 and then overspend in DP2. Money put into algebraic fluency and laboratory write-up discipline during MYP is the cheapest chemistry support available in this market, because it removes the two faults that later need specialist rates to repair.

programmes.name: Career-related Programme
programmes.description: DP courses alongside a career-related study and a personal and professional skills course. A CP student taking Chemistry HL sits the same papers and submits the same investigation as a Diploma candidate, so the support required, and its cost, is identical.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai's CP offering is small and usually tied to business, aviation or health pathways. Where chemistry appears in a CP timetable it is often for a health-science destination, which means the grade carries an admissions consequence and families treat the spend as non-discretionary. Placement blocks push the tutorial to weekends, where availability is scarcer and the effective price is higher.

dubai/ib-dp-chemistry-hl-tutor.subjectsIntro: Chemistry HL is this page's subject. Families comparing costs usually want to know which other subjects can share a weekly arrangement, because two subjects with one tutor is the one genuine discount available in this market.

subjects.name: Chemistry
subjects.description: Six themes across structure and reactivity, assessed by a split Paper 1, an extended-response Paper 2 and a 24-mark investigation. The Higher Level extensions that absorb paid hours are organic mechanisms, buffers and pH curves, entropy and spontaneity, electrode potentials and rate equations.

subjects.name: Biology
subjects.description: Four themes with the same assessment architecture. Chemistry and biology share enough molecular content that one tutor can often cover both, which is where a genuine reduction in total spend comes from rather than from a package discount.

subjects.name: Physics
subjects.description: Five themes assessed on the same model. The overlap with chemistry is measurement: uncertainty propagation, significant figures and graph linearisation are marked in both subjects, so paying twice to learn them once is a common and avoidable cost.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches
subjects.description: Paper 1 is sat without a calculator. Chemistry HL students taking AA usually handle logarithmic pH work and rate-equation manipulation faster, which reduces the number of chemistry hours needed on the calculation-heavy topics.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation
subjects.description: Technology-active and statistics-heavy. AI students taking Chemistry HL frequently need extra time on logarithms and on rearranging equilibrium expressions, and that time is cheaper bought inside a chemistry session than as separate mathematics tuition.

subjects.name: Sports, Exercise and Health Science
subjects.description: Assessed with a scientific investigation on the same four criteria as chemistry. Where a student takes both, investigation feedback can be sequenced so one block of sessions serves two internal assessments rather than two blocks serving one each.

subjects.name: Environmental Systems and Societies
subjects.description: An interdisciplinary course counting as a science or a humanities subject. Its data-handling and systems content overlaps with chemistry's quantitative work, and students taking it alongside Chemistry HL rarely need separate support for the numerical sections.

subjects.name: Psychology
subjects.description: Approaches, options and an internal assessment based on a simple experimental replication. The statistical treatment in that report is the usual reason a Dubai psychology student asks for science or mathematics help, and it is a short block rather than an ongoing cost.

subjects.name: Design Technology

sections.heading: Six ways to buy Chemistry Higher Level help in Dubai, and what each model charges
paragraphs: Comparing an IB DP chemistry HL tutor in Dubai against another provider is only possible once the models are separated. There are six on offer in this emirate, and their economics differ more than their advertising suggests. A specialist agency matches a subject expert and takes a margin for doing so. An international marketplace lists independent tutors and charges a platform fee, usually quoting in dollars. A freelance tutor found through a community group sets their own rate with no intermediary. A tuition centre with premises runs small groups at a per-student rate. School-run support, where a school offers extra sessions, is sometimes included in fees. And a parent-arranged study group costs nothing but a timetable.

Published rates read in October 2026 place these roughly as follows. Budget online providers advertise from AED 33 to AED 65 an hour. Qualified online subject tutors are commonly quoted at AED 150 to AED 300. In-home one-to-one visits run AED 180 to AED 500 including travel. IB and A-Level specialists sit at AED 200 to AED 450 and above. Premium named tutors have been advertised as high as AED 650. Monthly packages in the market include about AED 799 for eight online sessions and AED 1,599 to AED 1,799 for four two-hour in-home sessions. Bestimate's Dubai rate table puts monthly spend for weekly one-hour sessions at AED 240 to AED 600 at budget level, AED 600 to AED 1,200 mid-range, and AED 1,000 to AED 2,000 and above for specialist exam-year support.

The variable that most changes value is not the model but whether the price includes a marked script. A specialist at AED 300 who returns a marked Paper 2 question before each lesson is producing a diagnosis. A freelance tutor at AED 120 who teaches from a textbook is producing contact time. For a course as large as Chemistry HL, the diagnosis is what decides which of 240 taught hours need revisiting, and buying it is cheaper than revisiting all of them.

We quote our own arrangement against a stated session length and a stated amount of marking, and we do not publish a rate card on these pages because the honest answer depends on both. The first lesson is free and no card details are taken for it. Any provider, ours included, should be willing to say in writing what an hour contains before a family commits to a term.

sections.heading: What the AED number is paying for, line by line
paragraphs: An hour of chemistry support contains up to six distinct pieces of work, and the gap between a cheap arrangement and an expensive one is which of them are present. The contact hour itself is the visible part. Behind it sit script marking against the published scheme, preparation keyed to the school's current unit rather than a generic sequence, a written session note, resource work such as question sets built around a specific weakness, and administration including matching and rescheduling.

Pricing a tutor by the contact hour alone therefore compares a complete arrangement with an incomplete one. A family paying AED 150 for an hour of contact time with nothing around it is paying AED 150 for an hour. A family paying AED 300 for an hour that includes a marked question, a tailored question set and a note is paying for perhaps ninety minutes of a tutor's working time. The second figure is higher and the rate per unit of actual work is lower.

There is a further asymmetry in Higher Level chemistry specifically. Marking a chemistry extended-response answer properly takes time, because the marks are distributed across method, state symbols, significant figures, and the explanation itself, and a marker has to show the student where each went. A provider who includes marking at a low rate is usually either doing it quickly or not doing it at all, and a returned script with a number on the top and no annotation is the tell.

The practical move for a parent is to ask for the breakdown in writing before booking. Which of the six lines are included? How long is the marking turnaround? Does the note come to the parent or only to the student? Those three questions separate providers faster than any rate comparison, and most providers in this market have never been asked them.

sections.heading: Tutoring cost in context: Dubai school fees, the 2026-27 freeze and examination entry
paragraphs: Tutoring is rarely the largest education line in a Dubai household budget, and seeing it beside the others changes how families decide. Dubai's private school sector enrolled 387,441 pupils across 227 schools in 2024-25, offering 17 curricula, with International Baccalaureate programmes accounting for 7 per cent of enrolment. On 22 May 2026 KHDA confirmed there would be no increase in private school fees in the emirate for the 2026-27 academic year, under Dubai's second economic incentives package valued at AED 1.5 billion within a total of AED 2.5 billion.

That freeze matters to a tutoring decision in a specific way. School fees for 2026-27 are a known quantity, which makes the discretionary education spend easier to plan than in a year when both numbers are moving. The sector is also expanding: seven new private schools open for 2026-27, four UK curriculum and three International Baccalaureate, creating 16,846 new places, after six opened during 2025-26 and enrolment rose 6 per cent. More IB provision means more Chemistry HL candidates, and demand for specialist support in a single subject at a single level tends to tighten availability before it moves price.

Examination entry is the other context line, and it is one families routinely forget. Entry for IB candidates is handled by the school, which registers candidates and passes on the cost within fees or as a separate charge depending on the school. A student sitting as a private candidate, which occasionally happens after a mid-year move, faces a different arrangement entirely and should ask the school and the examination centre directly. Cambridge and Pearson publish their own entry deadlines well ahead of each series, and in the UAE those series are June and November for Cambridge and May/June and November for Pearson Edexcel International GCSE. Pearson's published November 2026 timetable ran to 19 November 2026, with entries closing long before it opened; for the Cambridge June papers, entries close in the spring and the exact date comes to the centre rather than circulating as folklore. A private candidate has to find a centre willing to enter them inside one of those windows, which is a second reason to start the conversation a term early rather than in the term the papers fall.

Set against those, a tutoring decision is more tractable than it feels. The question is not whether AED 1,000 a month is a lot in the abstract. It is whether that spend, with marking included, produces a mark log that changes a predicted grade in a subject that gates a degree application. Where it does not, the right answer is to stop paying, and we would rather write that in a six-week review than keep a slot filled.

sections.heading: One-to-one, a pair, or a small group for Chemistry HL
paragraphs: The arithmetic of sharing looks compelling and holds only under conditions that are rarer than parents expect. Two students sharing a 90-minute session at a combined rate below two separate sessions is a genuine saving, and for some work it costs nothing in quality. Teaching a mechanism, walking through a mark scheme, or working an equilibrium calculation at the board are all fine with two students present. The saving collapses the moment the two students need different things, which in Higher Level chemistry happens quickly.

The conditions for a pair to work are narrow: the same level, the same school or at least the same point in the scheme of work, and similar current attainment. Two DP2 students at the same school both losing marks on buffer calculations are an excellent pair. A DP1 and a DP2 student are not, even as siblings, because the second will spend half the session waiting. A student at grade 4 and a student at grade 6 in the same class are usually not either, since the first needs the mechanism re-taught and the second needs harder questions.

Tuition centres in Dubai advertise group classes at per-student rates well below any one-to-one figure, and for broad revision of a theme that can be reasonable value. What a group cannot do is diagnose. The marks a specific student is losing on a specific question type are invisible in a class of eight, and the pace is set by the median. Families often use both deliberately: a centre class for content coverage and a small number of one-to-one hours for script work. That combination is frequently the cheapest route to a mark log.

Where siblings are involved we ask about the investigation before agreeing to a shared arrangement. Two students in the same house working with the same tutor on scientific investigations creates an authorship question nobody needs, and the simplest answer is separate tutors for that component even where the teaching is shared.

sections.heading: Four spending patterns that waste money in Higher Level chemistry
paragraphs: The first is paying for coverage a student already has. A family that books a term of general chemistry sessions because a report said grade 5 is buying a re-teach of 240 hours, most of which are intact. Without a marked script nobody knows which themes are weak, so the tutor starts at theme one and the student sits through material they knew. Two months later the grade has not moved and the conclusion drawn is that tutoring does not work. The conclusion that should be drawn is that undiagnosed tutoring does not work.

The second is buying hours instead of marking. The cheapest available hour almost never includes a marked script, and in a subject where marks are distributed across method, state symbols, significant figures and explanation, the script is the only honest record of where they went. A family spending AED 600 a month on four unmarked hours is usually getting less than one spending AED 600 on two hours with marking.

The third is starting the exam-term intensive late. Availability tightens in the spring, specialist slots at a given price fill first, and the pattern a family wanted at AED 250 is often only available at a higher figure or at an unusable time. The same arrangement booked in September costs the same per hour and comes with two terms of mark log behind it. Nothing about the rate changes; the effective price of waiting is paid in availability.

The fourth is paying for reputation that cannot be evidenced. Premium rates in this market are sometimes attached to examiner branding. Where a tutor's current examining status cannot be evidenced, the premium is being paid for a claim, and examiner status in any case gives no access to marking, boundaries or paper content. A marked script and a mark log are evidence. A description on a profile is not.

sections.heading: Where Higher Level chemistry hours convert into marks, topic by topic
paragraphs: Not every part of Chemistry HL rewards one-to-one time equally, and a family spending deliberately should know which parts do. The Higher Level course runs across the same six themes as Standard Level, covering models of the particulate nature of matter, bonding and structure, classification of matter, what drives chemical reactions, how much and how fast and how far, and the mechanisms of chemical change. The extensions sit inside those themes rather than beside them.

The areas that reliably absorb paid hours are the ones where a student cannot self-check. Organic mechanisms are first: a student can write a plausible-looking arrow-pushing sequence and have no way of knowing it is wrong, and the marks are awarded for specific features including charges, curly arrow origins and intermediates. Acid-base work is second, because pH curves, buffer calculations and logarithmic arithmetic compound errors silently. Energetics including entropy and spontaneity is third, where sign conventions decide whole answers. Electrode potentials and rate equations derived from experimental data complete the list.

The areas that reward self-study at least as well are the descriptive and recall-weighted parts: periodicity trends, bonding types, classification, and the factual content of the structure themes. A well-organised student with past papers and the data booklet can make progress there alone, and paying specialist rates to be told what a table in a textbook already says is poor value. We say this plainly at the first session, because a parent who knows which half of the course to buy help for spends less and gets more.

Spectroscopy sits in between. Interpreting mass spectra, infrared spectra and proton nuclear magnetic resonance data is highly coachable and quick to improve, often in two or three sessions, after which the student can practise independently. That is the shape to look for: short blocks with a visible end, rather than an open arrangement that quietly becomes the default.

sections.heading: Paying for work on the scientific investigation, and the line that cannot be bought
paragraphs: The scientific investigation is 20 per cent of the Chemistry HL grade, marked out of 24 across four criteria of six marks each, and capped at 3,000 words. The criteria are research design, data analysis, conclusion and evaluation. Because the component is worth a fifth of the grade and is produced over months rather than in a hall, it is where families spend most readily and where the market behaves worst.

What can legitimately be paid for is teaching and feedback. A tutor may explain how each criterion is read, comment on a draft the student has produced, point out that an evaluation names human error rather than a specific instrument effect, and teach uncertainty propagation on separate data that the student then applies to their own results. That work has real value: investigation marks are commonly lost on structure and on evaluation specificity rather than on chemistry, and both respond to criterion-referenced feedback.

What cannot be bought is authorship. The investigation is submitted as the student's own work and the school certifies it on that basis. A tutor may not choose the research question, process the student's data, restructure the document or supply text. There are providers in this market selling completed internal assessments, at figures around AED 3,750 in one documented case. Buying one puts a student at risk of a malpractice finding and the loss of the Diploma, and the money is the smallest part of what is lost.

The practical safeguard we use costs nothing: a dated record of every draft received and every comment returned. If a school ever raises an authorship question, that timeline is the only useful evidence anyone can produce. We suggest families keep their own copy, whoever they work with, and we suggest asking any provider to commit to the same practice in writing before paying for investigation support.

sections.heading: Medicine and pharmacy from Dubai: what the Chemistry HL grade is being bought for
paragraphs: Most Dubai families paying specialist rates for Chemistry HL are doing so because of where the grade leads. Medicine, dentistry and pharmacy programmes commonly specify chemistry, frequently at Higher Level, and often a second science. Those requirements are published by each university for each programme and they move between admissions cycles, which is why a decision taken on a two-year-old forum post is an expensive mistake.

The honest framing is that the grade is a gate rather than a purchase. No amount of tutoring guarantees a chemistry grade, and anybody presenting a spend as a route to an offer is selling something they cannot deliver. What spending can do is produce evidence early enough to change a plan: if a marked mock in the autumn of DP2 shows a grade 5 against a requirement of 6, a family has time to adjust the application list, add a foundation route, or concentrate the remaining hours on the two topics costing most. That is worth paying for. A term of undiagnosed sessions in the spring is not.

Separately, the UAE Ministry of Education runs an equivalency process for secondary certificates, and it is not the same thing as a university prerequisite. For the British track the documented requirement is five accredited GCSE or IGCSE subjects at no less than grade E or grade 3, with Arabic and Islamic education excluded from the five, plus one A-Level at no less than E or two AS-Levels at the same grade. For the American track, English proficiency requires 5 in IELTS academic, 61 in TOEFL iBT, or 450 in the SAT reading and writing section, with at least 450 in SAT Math. No IB points threshold should be quoted unless it has been read on the Ministry's own site.

None of this requires tutoring, and no provider performs or guarantees equivalency. The process belongs to the Ministry and the family, and any page suggesting otherwise is manufacturing urgency around a regulatory procedure.

sections.heading: Checking what you are paying for: permits, agreements and unused sessions
paragraphs: Before money changes hands there are three things a Dubai parent can verify, and most families verify none of them. The first is the permit. Private tutoring in the UAE requires a MoHRE private tuition work permit, introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, granted free of charge for two years. Eligible applicants include teachers registered at government or private schools, employees in the government and private sectors, unemployed residents, university students, and school students aged 15 to 18. The route is MoHRE's own private tutor licensing service, which lists no fee and a two-working-day completion time through the smart app, website and e-services system. Individuals tutoring without a permit are subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws, and because no fine schedule is published, any specific figure quoted to you is unverified.

The second is the status of the organisation. A tutoring operation with premises and staff in Dubai needs a KHDA Educational Services Permit for a training institute, with initial approval first, a maximum of six months to complete the permit and licence steps, and annual renewal requested at least 30 days before expiry. That permit is a specific thing issued to a specific kind of business. IB Gram does not hold it and does not operate premises in the UAE, which is why these pages describe online delivery and nothing else. Any provider describing itself as approved by a UAE authority should be able to produce the permit number.

The third is the agreement. Four questions settle most disputes before they happen: what does the hourly figure include, what notice is required to move a session, what happens to a session paid for and not used, and what happens if the tutor is not the right match. Written answers to those four are worth more than any discount. We state ours before the first paid session, and the first session itself is free with no card details taken.

On data, lead forms on these pages collect information about a minor, and the UAE Personal Data Protection law applies. We collect the student's year group, subject, level and school timetable because the match depends on them, we do not ask for grades, photographs or identity documents at enquiry stage, and a privacy link sits on every page with a route to deletion.

Organic mechanisms come first, because a plausible-looking arrow-pushing sequence can be wrong in ways a student cannot detect, and marks sit in charges, arrow origins and intermediates. Acid-base work with pH curves and buffers is second, since logarithmic arithmetic compounds errors silently. Energetics with entropy and spontaneity is third, where sign conventions decide whole answers. Electrode potentials and rate equations from tabulated data follow. Periodicity, bonding types and classification reward organised self-study with past papers and the data booklet, and paying specialist rates for them is poor value.

faqs.question: Can we pay for help with the chemistry investigation?
faqs.answer: You can pay for teaching and feedback, which is often the highest-value spend in the course, and you cannot pay for authorship. The investigation is 20 per cent of the grade, marked out of 24 across research design, data analysis, conclusion and evaluation, and capped at 3,000 words. A tutor may explain how each criterion is read, comment on drafts the student has produced, note that an evaluation is generic, and teach uncertainty propagation on separate data. A tutor may not choose the research question, process the student's results, restructure the document or supply text. Providers selling completed internal assessments put the Diploma itself at risk.

faqs.question: What does a medical-school application mean for Chemistry HL spending?
faqs.answer: It raises the stakes and should change the timing rather than the total. Medicine, dentistry and pharmacy programmes commonly specify chemistry, frequently at Higher Level, with a second science, and those requirements are published per programme and change between cycles. No tutoring can promise a chemistry grade, so what the spend buys is early evidence: a marked mock in the autumn of DP2 showing a grade 5 against a requirement of 6 gives a family time to adjust the application list, consider a foundation route, or concentrate hours on the two costliest topics. A term of undiagnosed sessions in the spring buys none of that.

faqs.question: How do we check that a tutor may legally be paid in the UAE?
faqs.answer: Ask for the permit rather than for reassurance. Private tutoring in the UAE requires a MoHRE private tuition work permit introduced under Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, granted free of charge for two years. Eligible applicants include registered school teachers, government and private-sector employees, unemployed residents, university students and school students aged 15 to 18. The application route is MoHRE's own private tutor licensing service, listing no fee and a two-working-day completion time. Tutoring without a permit attracts fines and penalties under the applicable laws, with no published schedule, so any quoted fine amount is unverified. An operation with Dubai premises needs a separate KHDA permit.

faqs.question: What should a tutoring agreement say about replacement and cancellation?
faqs.answer: Four things, in writing, before the first paid session. What the hourly figure includes, broken down into contact time, marking, preparation and notes. What notice is required to move a session and whether that notice differs in the exam term. What happens to a session paid for and not used. And what happens if the tutor turns out not to be the right match for the level and the course. Written answers to those four prevent most disputes in this market and cost nothing to obtain. We state ours before any payment, and the first lesson is free with no card details taken.

faqs.question: Are monthly chemistry packages better value than paying by the hour?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, and the test is flexibility rather than headline price. Packages advertised in Dubai include about AED 799 a month for eight online sessions and AED 1,599 to AED 1,799 a month for four two-hour in-home sessions. Eight sessions a month is a high cadence for Chemistry HL and suits a student rebuilding several topics; it suits a student who needs three or four targeted blocks much less well. Before committing, check whether unused sessions expire, whether sessions can move during mock weeks, and whether marking is included. A package that locks a family into a cadence they cannot use is not a discount.

faqs.question: Does an examiner-branded tutor justify the higher rate?
faqs.answer: Only where the status can be evidenced, and even then the advantage is narrower than the branding implies. Premium rates in this market reach AED 650 an hour. Current examining status gives no access to marking, grade boundaries or paper content, and any suggestion otherwise should be treated with real scepticism. What actually predicts progress is a marked script, a mark log by topic and command word, and a tutor who has taught this course at this level recently. Those are checkable. A description on a profile is not, and we would rather a family paid mid-band for evidence than top-band for a label.

faqs.question: How much should a Dubai family budget for exam-term chemistry revision?
faqs.answer: Working from the Bestimate Dubai rate table, specialist exam-year support runs around AED 1,000 to AED 2,000 and above a month for weekly one-hour sessions, and a two or three session weekly intensive sits above that. The more useful budgeting move is to fix the duration. An exam-term intensive with a stated end date and full timed papers marked each week has a known total; an open arrangement does not. Booking the slot in the autumn costs the same per hour and secures availability that tightens in spring, which is the real price of waiting rather than any change in rate.

faqs.question: Does an online Chemistry HL hour cost less than a visiting tutor's hour?
faqs.answer: Usually yes, and the reason is travel. In-home rates in Dubai run roughly AED 180 to AED 500 an hour including the drive, against AED 150 to AED 300 for a qualified online subject tutor and AED 200 to AED 450 and above for a specialist. The larger difference is not price but pool. An in-home arrangement narrows the choice to tutors who can reach your community on a weekday evening, which for one named subject at one level is a poor trade. IB Gram does not make home visits in Dubai; in-home tutoring is offered only in India, and Dubai families are taught online instead.

dubai/ib-dp-chemistry-hl-tutor.closingHeading: Price the hour, then price what the hour contains
dubai/ib-dp-chemistry-hl-tutor.closingBody: The market bands on this page exist so a Dubai family can judge any Chemistry HL quote, ours included, against something other than the next advertisement. Ask what an hour includes, what notice moves a session, and what happens to one that is paid for and unused. Then book the free first lesson, which is spent on one marked timed question rather than on a sales conversation, and read the note that follows. If it says your child needs three topic blocks rather than a two-year arrangement, that is what it will say. Lessons run one-to-one over live video in Gulf Standard Time.

intro.heading: Work out what is wrong before you work out what to spend
paragraphs: A Dubai parent whose child has come home with a 4 in Standard Level Chemistry is usually offered one product: weekly tuition, for a term, at a rate between AED 150 and AED 300 an hour. Sometimes that is exactly right. Often it is an expensive answer to a question nobody asked properly. A 4 in Chemistry SL can mean at least six different things, and only two of them are solved by weekly chemistry lessons.

Here are the six. The student has a content gap from a specific strand, usually stoichiometry or energetics, and everything built on top of it is unstable. The student understands the chemistry and cannot write it to the command term, so answers that describe when they should explain lose method marks. The student's mathematics is the limiting factor, and every chemistry hour is spent working around rearrangement and logarithms. The student is not revising in any structured way, so lessons land and leach away by Friday. The student has a confidence problem with timed papers specifically and performs fine on untimed work. Or the student is coasting, in which case tuition becomes an outsourcing of effort and the grade moves nowhere.

Each of those has a different price. The content gap is the most expensive at four to eight sessions. The command-term problem is cheap, often two sessions, because it is a writing habit rather than a knowledge deficit. The mathematics problem is not a chemistry purchase at all and buying chemistry hours for it wastes every dirham. The revision problem needs one session on method and then nothing. The timed-paper problem needs marked papers rather than teaching. And the coasting problem needs a conversation at home that no provider can sell you.

This is why we run a free diagnostic session before quoting anything. Not a sales call with a tutor profile at the end, but a working session over live video in which a specialist looks at your child's actual marked work, identifies which of the six it is, and writes it down. You keep the written finding whether you buy anything or not, and it is useful on its own: a parent who knows the problem is command-term discipline can ask the school to focus on it for nothing.

Standard Level matters to the arithmetic, because it is a smaller course than families assume. Chemistry SL is 150 taught hours and it excludes most of what makes Higher Level expensive: the mechanism-heavy organic work, combined spectroscopic determination, buffers and solubility products, entropy and Gibbs free energy, and electrode potentials beyond the simple cases. A tutor quoting a Standard Level brief as though it were Higher Level is charging for content that is not on the syllabus. One thing to be clear about before anything else: IB Gram does not send tutors to homes in Dubai or anywhere in the UAE, so nothing below describes a visit. Home visits are part of our India service only.

dubai/ib-dp-chemistry-sl-home-tutor.programmesIntro: Standard Level Chemistry is sat inside the Diploma, but the decision about how much help it needs depends heavily on what came before it. Below are the three stages Dubai students pass through, and what each leaves behind.

programmes.name: Diploma Programme
programmes.description: Six subjects with three at Higher Level, plus Theory of Knowledge, the Extended Essay and CAS. Chemistry at Standard Level is 150 taught hours across six strands, assessed by two written papers and one internally marked scientific investigation. For many students it is a Standard Level choice made to satisfy the sciences requirement rather than a passion, which changes what good support looks like: efficiency, not enrichment.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai Diploma students typically carry Chemistry SL alongside two or three Higher Levels that matter more to them, which makes it the subject that gets the least independent study time in the household. The practical implication is that Dubai families should buy fewer, sharper chemistry hours and protect the student's own revision time for the Higher Levels, rather than adding a weekly commitment that competes with them.

programmes.name: Middle Years Programme
programmes.description: Four assessment criteria, integrated sciences, no timed papers in the Diploma sense. Students leave MYP strong on investigation design and weak on quantitative chemistry, because the mole has rarely been drilled. For a Standard Level student that gap is narrower than for a Higher Level one, and two or three focused sessions on quantities usually close it entirely.
programmes.countryNote: Where a Dubai school runs MYP directly into the Diploma, the Standard Level chemistry class can contain students with very different quantitative backgrounds sitting side by side. If your child is the one who came through MYP and the class is pitched at ex-IGCSE students, the symptom looks like a chemistry problem and is actually a sequencing problem, which a short block fixes rather than a term.

programmes.name: IGCSE and the British route
programmes.description: Cambridge or Pearson IGCSE Chemistry, or Combined Science, to Year 11. A student with separate IGCSE Chemistry at grade 7 or above should find Standard Level comfortable and may need no paid support at all. A Combined Science background is the single most common reason a Dubai Standard Level student struggles, because the depth assumed in DP1 was never taught.
programmes.countryNote: The IGCSE grade is also the piece of evidence most Dubai parents already have and rarely use. Pull out the actual IGCSE paper breakdown rather than the overall grade: a student who scored well on the multiple-choice paper and badly on the structured one has a writing problem that will repeat in the Diploma, and knowing that before DP1 starts is worth more than a term of lessons after it goes wrong.

dubai/ib-dp-chemistry-sl-home-tutor.subjectsIntro: Standard Level Chemistry sits in a six-subject timetable, and the honest question is often which subject genuinely needs the money. Below is what each of the common Dubai Diploma companions assesses, so you can rank them rather than defaulting to the one with the worst grade.

subjects.name: Chemistry
subjects.description: Six strands across 150 taught hours: the particulate model, bonding and structure, classification of matter, what drives reactions, how much and how fast and how far, and reaction mechanisms at introductory depth. Two written papers and one investigation. Marks leak at quantities, sign conventions and command-term precision.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation
subjects.description: Modelling, statistics and technology-assisted methods. The subject most often responsible for a chemistry symptom. If a student can describe a trend but cannot rearrange an equation to find a constant, chemistry hours will keep hitting the same wall until the algebra is addressed.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches
subjects.description: Calculus, functions, algebra and trigonometry. Carries the logarithmic work that pH and rate questions depend on. A diagnostic worth running before any chemistry purchase: give the student a bare rearrangement task with no chemistry context and see what happens.

subjects.name: Biology
subjects.description: Unity and diversity, form and function, interaction and interdependence, continuity and change. Shares the command-term problem with chemistry almost exactly, which means one session on the difference between outline, explain and discuss pays off across two subjects at once.

subjects.name: Physics
subjects.description: Mechanics through to nuclear and quantum physics. Overlaps chemistry at energetics and atomic structure. Students taking both often find that fixing uncertainty treatment and graph interpretation once improves the data-based section of both subjects' Paper 1.

subjects.name: Environmental Systems and Societies
subjects.description: Ecosystems, biodiversity, pollution, climate and resource use, counting for either the sciences or the individuals and societies group. A route some Dubai students take when Standard Level Chemistry is not working and no university requirement depends on it. A coordinator conversation, not a tutoring one.

subjects.name: Business Management
subjects.description: Organisational structure, marketing, finance and operations, with a written assessment task. Common in Dubai timetables next to a Standard Level science. Mentioned here because families often discover the chemistry grade matters less to the application than they assumed once they check the actual requirements.

subjects.name: English A: Language and Literature
subjects.description: Textual analysis, the individual oral and written papers. The reason it belongs on this list is the command-term overlap: a student whose chemistry answers describe when they should explain usually has the same habit in essay subjects, and the fix transfers.

subjects.name: Arabic and the UAE mandatory subjects
subjects.description: Arabic, Islamic Education and Social Studies are required in all Dubai private schools regardless of the licensed curriculum. They occupy real timetable hours, which is a practical constraint on when chemistry support can be scheduled and a reason some Dubai weeks have no spare evening at all.

sections.heading: Six symptoms, six causes, six prices
paragraphs: The table below is the core of this page. It takes the way a Standard Level chemistry problem actually presents itself in a Dubai household, names the cause that usually sits behind it, and attaches a realistic number of sessions and an AED range using the published market band of roughly AED 150 to 300 an hour for a qualified online subject tutor. Unitors publishes IB tuition from AED 200 within that band and EdFlik advertises from AED 45 to 65 at the budget end.

Notice how uneven the prices are. Two of the six cost almost nothing to address and one cannot be addressed with tutoring at all. That asymmetry is the single most useful thing a Dubai family can know before they start spending, because the default product on offer, weekly lessons for a term, is priced for the most expensive case and sold to everyone. If your child's problem is that they describe when the question says explain, you are being quoted ten times what the fix costs.

Use the table as a conversation structure rather than a lookup. Take your child's last two marked chemistry papers and ask which row the lost marks sit in. If the marks went on questions the student had the knowledge for and answered loosely, it is the command-term row. If they went on multi-step calculations where the chemistry was right and the algebra collapsed, it is the mathematics row. If the student lost marks on content never properly taught, it is the content row, and that is the one worth a term.

sections.heading: What Standard Level chemistry does not contain, and why that matters to the bill
paragraphs: Families routinely overpay for Standard Level Chemistry because they do not know how much smaller it is than Higher Level. The Standard Level course runs 150 taught hours. It covers the three Structure strands and the three Reactivity strands, and it stops well short of the Higher Level extensions. That is a genuinely different brief, and it should be priced as one.

Specifically, Standard Level does not require mechanistic organic chemistry at Higher Level depth, so the curly-arrow work that makes Higher Level tutors expensive is largely absent. It does not require structural determination by combining mass spectrometry, infrared and nuclear magnetic resonance data. It does not require buffer calculations, pKa and pKb work or solubility products. It does not require entropy and Gibbs free energy. It does not require electrode potentials beyond simple cells. Each of those is a specialist teaching skill, and none of them is what your child needs.

The practical consequence is a question you can ask any prospective tutor in one sentence: which parts of the syllabus does my child's Standard Level course not include? A specialist answers it immediately. Someone quoting Higher Level rates for a Standard Level brief will be vague, because the vagueness is the business model. Confirm the boundary against the subject guide your child's school is actually teaching, since schools adopted the current guides on different timetables and a few Dubai students sat transitional arrangements.

There is a second use for the boundary, which is revision triage. A Standard Level student in the final term has limited hours and often a textbook or an online resource written for both levels. Knowing which chapters and which worked examples belong to Higher Level only saves that student real time, and it stops the demoralising experience of failing at a question that was never on their course. Mark the exclusions in the textbook early, and the revision plan writes itself.

sections.heading: When revision actually happens in a Dubai school year
paragraphs: Buying tutoring without looking at the calendar is how Dubai families end up paying for sessions in weeks when no learning is possible. The Dubai academic year typically runs from late August to late June, which puts the Diploma examination session at the far end of a long year. Between those points sit the things that actually determine when revision can happen, and three of them are specific to this country.

The first is Ramadan. School days shorten during the holy month, timings shift, and a teenager fasting through a school day is not going to absorb new chemistry content at five in the afternoon. Ramadan moves roughly eleven days earlier each Gregorian year, so check the official UAE calendar for the year you are planning rather than assuming last year's pattern. What works is moving sessions to post-Iftar timings and switching the content from new teaching to consolidation and marked-paper review. The second is the Eid breaks, which arrive at a point in the spring when families travel and continuity breaks. The third is the internal deadline stack: the scientific investigation, the Extended Essay and Theory of Knowledge components all have school-set deadlines, and Dubai schools cluster them.

Counting backwards from the examination session is the exercise almost nobody does, and it changes decisions. The table below lists the milestones without attaching dates, deliberately. IB session and results dates are set by the IB and we do not publish them here, because they must be confirmed against the official source or your child's Diploma coordinator rather than taken from a tutoring page. What the table gives you is the order of events and who controls each one, which is the part that does not change.

sections.heading: Does a chemistry grade matter for UAE Ministry of Education equivalency?
paragraphs: This is the question Dubai parents ask late and should ask early, and almost no competitor page in this market addresses it at all. Equivalency is the process by which the UAE Ministry of Education recognises a foreign secondary certificate so a student can use it domestically. It matters for students planning to study at a UAE institution or needing the certificate recognised locally, and it is a regulatory process run by the Ministry, not something any tutoring provider performs, guarantees or influences.

For the British track the requirements are published and specific. A student must show one accredited subject at Advanced Level with a grade of no less than E, or two accredited subjects at Advanced Subsidiary Level at the same grade, and must pass five accredited subjects in GCSE or IGCSE certificates with a grade of no less than E or grade 3. Arabic and Islamic education are not included among those five required subjects. That last detail is worth noting because at least one well-ranking competitor page states that UAE candidates must take six IGCSE subjects, which is not what the published rule says.

For the American track, English proficiency requires a score of 5 in the IELTS academic test, 61 in the TOEFL iBT, or 450 in the reading and writing section of the SAT, and mathematics requires at least 450 in the SAT Math test. For the International Baccalaureate, no points threshold is published that we have been able to read on the Ministry's own pages, so this page does not state one. Verify your own child's position on moe.gov.ae or with the emirate's attestation authority. And note the obvious corollary: tutoring is not a requirement for equivalency, university admission or school progression, and any page implying otherwise is manufacturing urgency.

sections.heading: The investigation at Standard Level: the same twenty per cent, a smaller job
paragraphs: The scientific investigation is worth twenty per cent of the grade at Standard Level, exactly as it is at Higher Level, and it is the same single piece of individual research. That makes it the highest-value component per hour of support on a Standard Level course, because the written papers reward accumulated knowledge while the investigation rewards a handful of decisions made in the first fortnight.

The decision that matters most is the research question. A Standard Level student under time pressure from three Higher Levels will reach for something safe, which usually means measuring a relationship that is already established and leaves nothing to analyse. That report can be immaculate and still score in the middle band, because the criteria reward analysis and evaluation that a trivial question cannot generate. One session spent killing a weak question and building a better one is the single best use of money on this course.

After that, the useful support is narrow: a check that the planned range of the independent variable will actually produce a usable relationship, and a reading of the draft that names where the evaluation is thin or the conclusion has run past its uncertainties. What is never part of a session is text. A tutor does not supply sentences, rewrite paragraphs into better English, or hand over a method to be copied. The report must be the student's own work in their own words. Providers in this market do sell completed reports at around AED 3,750, and that transaction is an academic-integrity breach which puts the student's Diploma at risk, not the seller's.

sections.heading: Who may legally be paid to tutor in Dubai
paragraphs: Before you pay anyone in this market, it is worth knowing that private tutoring here is a permitted and regulated activity rather than an informal one. The private tuition work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023 and is issued through the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation. It is granted free of charge for two years, so no legitimate tutor needs to recover a permit fee from you because there is not one.

Eligibility is broader than most parents expect. It covers teachers registered in government or private schools, employees in the government and private sectors, unemployed individuals, university students, and school students aged 15 to 18. MoHRE's service page for it is titled 'Issuance of a New Work Permit - Private Tutor Licensing', lists no fees, states a two-working-day completion time, and runs through the MoHRE smart app, website and e-services system. Individuals tutoring without the permit are subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws; no fine schedule has been published, so any specific amount quoted to you should be treated as unverified.

Two further points apply in Dubai specifically. A tutoring business operating from premises with staff is a different legal entity from an individual tutor and requires a KHDA Educational Services Permit for a training institute, with initial approval first and annual renewal at least thirty days before expiry. And do not ask for your child's own subject teacher as a paid tutor. In Abu Dhabi, ADEK's professional-ethics rules bar private and charter school staff from paid private tuition of students at their own school, and the permit's code of conduct also bars serving students affiliated with the tutor's own school. Beyond the rules, it compromises the person who will mark your child's investigation.
